seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI ہُند معیار چھُ وَنان زِ لیدُر پوڈرس منٛز پَزِ نہٕ کانٛہہ رَلاونہٕ آمُت رنگ آسُن، لیڈ کرومیٹ تہِ نہٕ، تہٕ نہٕ بیٚیہِ کُنہِ چیزُک نشاستہٕ۔ اَمِیُک جانچہٕ مینوئل چھُ وَنان زِ انسپکٹر کیا کیا چھِ لیدرس منٛز وُچھان: میٹانِل یلو ہِوۍ رَلاونہٕ آمٕتۍ رنگ، سیسہٕ کیٛن نمکن، تہٕ چاک پوڈر۔
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: FSSAI's standard says that turmeric powder should not have any added colour, not lead chromate either, and not starch of any other thing. Its testing manual says what inspectors look for in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: یِمن منٛزٕ ہیٚکِو کیٛنہہ پنٕنِس باورچی خانس منٛز جانچِتھ، تہٕ کیٛنہہ ہیٚکہِ صرف لیب ژھانڈِتھ۔ یہ گائیڈ چھُ دۄشوَنُے مُتعلق، سٟتۍ زٕ مشہوٗر ٹیسٹ تہِ یِم لیدرس پیٹھ کام چھِنہٕ کران۔ یِم آزماوِو کُنہِ تہِ لیدرس پیٹھ یُس تۄہۍ ہیٚیِو، سون تہِ۔
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Of these you can check some in your kitchen, and some only a lab can detect. This guide is about both, along with two famous tests too which do not work on turmeric. Try these on any turmeric that you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: لیدرٕچ جانچ پتہٕ آبٕکۍ زٕ گلاس۔ کھوٚور: ہلکہٕ زرد آب، پوڈر تَلس پیٹھ بیٖٹھِتھ۔ دۄچھُن: گاڑھ زرد آب، پوڈرٕ پیٹھہٕ بۄن کُن وَسان زرد لکیرہٕ۔
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: light yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: dark yellow water, yellow streaks flowing downward from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧آبٕچ جانچ⟦/1⟧کھوٚور: پوڈر چھُ بیٖٹھمُت تہٕ آب چھُ ہلکہٕ زرد۔ دۄچھُن: بۄن وَسنہٕ وِزِ نیرِ پوڈرٕ پیٹھہٕ گاڑھ زرد لکیرہٕ، تہٕ آب گوٚو گاڑھ زرد۔ اَمِیُک لیب ٹیسٹ کرناوُن گژھِ ٹھیک۔
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is light yellow. Right: while sinking, dark yellow streaks came out of the powder, and the water became dark yellow. Getting a lab test of this one done would be right.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: اَکِس گلاس آبس پیٹھ ژھٕکٲوِو اَکھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر تہٕ ہِلاونہٕ ورٲے دِیِو بیٖہنہٕ۔ لیدُر چھُ بۄن وَسان تہٕ آب چھُ ہلکہٕ زرد روزان؛ یُس آب فوراً گاڑھ زرد گژھِ، سُہ چھُ رَلاونہٕ آمتِس رنگس کُن اِشارٕ۔ یہ جانچ ہیٚکہِ نہٕ لیڈ کرومیٹ یا چاک ژھانڈِتھ، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ پَکہِ جوابہٕ خٲطرٕ کرٲوِو فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیبس منٛز جانچ۔ آیوڈین ٹیسٹ مہٕ کٔرِو: لیدرس منٛز چھُ برونٛہہ پیٹھے نشاستہٕ آسان۔
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. The turmeric sinks and the water stays light yellow; water that becomes dark yellow immediately, that is a sign toward added colour. This check cannot detect lead chromate or chalk, therefore for a sure answer get a check done in a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric already has starch.

seg.9b20e15186d4.t: FSSAI کیا کیا چھُ لیدرس منٛز جانچان
seg.9b20e15186d4.back: What FSSAI checks for in turmeric

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: میٹانِل یلو ہِوۍ، یُس پھیکہٕ لیدرس زیادٕ چمکہٕ دار ہیٚکہِ ہاوِتھ۔ FSSAI چھُ نہٕ لیدرس منٛز رنگ رَلاونٕچ اِجازت دِوان۔
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Like metanil yellow, which can show dull turmeric as more shiny. FSSAI does not give permission for adding colour to turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: لیڈ کرومیٹ تہٕ سیسہٕ کیٛن بیٚیہِ نمکن
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: لیڈ کرومیٹ چھُ اَکھ زرد رنگ یُس پینٹس منٛز ورتاونہٕ یِوان چھُ۔ سٹینفورڈٕچ رہنمٲیی منٛز 2019 تہٕ 2024 منٛز چھپیمژن تحقیقن منٛز ملیوو یہ جنوبی ایشیاہٕچن کیٛنژن حصن ہٕنٛدِس لیدرس منٛز۔ FSSAI چھُ نہٕ لیدرس منٛز اَمِیٚچ بالکل اِجازت دِوان۔
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour which is used in paint. In studies published in 2019 and 2024 under Stanford's leadership it was found in the turmeric of some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not give permission for it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: اَکھ سَستہٕ سفید پوڈر یُس وزن ہُرراوان چھُ۔
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder which increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: بیٚین فصلن ہُند اوٚٹ یا نشاستہٕ۔ FSSAI ہُند معیار چھُ یہ تہِ منع کران۔
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. FSSAI's standard forbids this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: اَکھ شفاف گلاس بٔرِو کمرٕچ حرارتس وٲلِس آبہٕ سٟتۍ۔
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clear glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: پیٹھ کِنۍ ژھٕکٲوِو اَکھ برابر بٔرِتھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر پوڈر۔ مہٕ ہِلٲوِو۔
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: On top sprinkle one level-filled small spoon of turmeric powder. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: گۄڈنیُک اَکھ مِنَٹ وُچھِو پوڈر بۄن وَسان۔ وُچھِو زِ اَتھ پیٹھہٕ چھا رنگہٕ دار لکیرہٕ بۄن وَسان۔
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: For the first one minute watch the powder sinking. See whether coloured streaks are flowing down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: یہ ترٲوِو 15 پیٹھہٕ 20 مِنَٹن خٲطرٕ۔ پتہٕ تھٲوِو گلاس سفید دیوارِ یا کاغذٕ کِس ورقس برونٛہہ کنہِ تہٕ وُچھِو بیٖٹھمتِس پوڈرس پیٹھ کُن آب۔
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.t: ہلکہٕ زرد آب، پوڈر تَلس پیٹھ
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.t: رَلاونہٕ آمتِس رنگُک کانٛہہ نِشان نہٕ۔

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: گاڑھ زرد لکیرہٕ، یا کیٛنژن مِنَٹن منٛز گاڑھ زرد آب
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Dark yellow streaks, or dark yellow water in a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: ہیٚکہٕ رنگ آسہِ رَلاونہٕ آمُت۔ تَتھ بیچس منٛزٕ لیدُر ورتاوُن کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ کرٲوِو اَمِیٚچ جانچ۔
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Maybe colour has been added. Stop using turmeric from that batch and get a check of it done.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧یہ کیازِ چھُ کام کران۔⟦/1⟧ لیدرُک پنُن زرد رنگ، کرکیومن، چھُ آبس منٛز مُشکلے گلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھُ پوڈر بۄن وَسان تہٕ آبس صرف ذرا رنگ دِوان۔ میٹانِل یلو ہِوۍ رنگ چھِ آسٲنی سان گلان تہٕ آبس جلدی رنگ دِوان۔
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves in water only with difficulty, therefore the powder sinks and gives the water only a little colour. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and give the water colour quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧یہ کیا چھُ نہٕ ژھانڈان۔⟦/1⟧ لیڈ کرومیٹ تہٕ چاک تہِ چھِ نہٕ آبس منٛز گلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ ہیٚکہِ یِمن سٟتۍ رَلاونہٕ آمُت لیدُر تہِ یَتھ جانچہِ منٛز پاس گٔژِھتھ۔ صرف لیب ٹیسٹ ہیٚکہِ وَنِتھ زِ یِم چھِنہٕ اَتھ منٛز۔
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not detect.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, therefore turmeric adulterated with them can also pass in this check. Only a lab test can tell that these are not in it.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: واریاہ باریک پوڈر ہیٚکہِ آب کیٛنژس کالس گَدلہٕ تھٲوِتھ۔ گَدلہٕ آسُن چھُ ٹھیک؛ وُچھُن یہ چھُ زِ آب چھا شفاف تہٕ گاڑھ زرد۔
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; what to see is whether the water is clear and dark yellow.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: جانچ 2: اگر تۄہۍ سالِم لیدُر ہیٚیِو
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: ہۄکھمتِس لیدرٕچ اَکھ گَنٛڈ پھٹٲوِو وچہٕ منٛزٕ۔ لیدُر چھُ اندرٕ تام زرد نارنجی آسان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ پَزِ اندرِم حصہٕ نیبرِم حصس ہیوٗ باسُن۔ اگر نیبرِم چھلکہٕ چمکہٕ دار زرد آسہِ تہٕ اندرِم حصہٕ ہلکہٕ یا پھیکہٕ، تیٚلہِ ہیٚکہٕ پیٹھ کِنۍ رنگ آسہِ لاگنہٕ آمُت۔ کِنن وٲلِس پرٛژھِو اَمِیُک متعلق، یا کرٲوِو جانچ۔
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a knob of dried turmeric from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange up to the inside, therefore the inner part should look like the outer part. If the outer skin is shiny yellow and the inner part light or dull, then maybe colour has been applied on top. Ask the seller about it, or get a check done.

seg.c62fa16e1d5f.back: Two tests which you should not do

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: آیوڈین چھُ نشاستس سٟتۍ مِلنہٕ پتہٕ نیٖل کرٛہُن گژھان، تہٕ اکثر چھُ لیدرس منٛز اوٚٹ ژھانڈنہٕ خٲطرٕ اَمِیُک مشورٕ دِنہٕ یِوان۔ مگر لیدرس منٛز چھُ پانہٕ نشاستہٕ، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھُ یہ پرٛتھ حالس منٛز نیٖل کرٛہُن گژھان۔ اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھُ FSSAI ہُند پنُن مینوئل آیوڈین ٹیسٹ لیدرٕ ورٲے بیٚین پیٖہمٕتین مسالن خٲطرٕ ورتاوان۔
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine becomes blue-black after meeting starch, and it is often advised for detecting flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, therefore it becomes blue-black in every case. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for other ground spices except turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: لیدرس منٛز سیسہٕ، میٹانِل یلو تہٕ چاک ژھانڈنہٕ خٲطرٕ FSSAI کیٛن ٹیسٹن منٛز چھُ گاڑھ ہائیڈروکلورک یا سلفیورک تیزاب ورتاونہٕ یِوان۔ یِم تیزاب چھِ ژَمہِ تہٕ اَچھن زالان۔ یِہنٛز جاے چھےٚ لیب، باورچی خانہٕ نہٕ۔
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: In FSSAI's tests for detecting lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric, concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid is used. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is the lab, not the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: پَکہِ جوابہٕ خٲطرٕ: فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیب
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL سٟتۍ منظوٗر شُدہ فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیب ہیٚکہِ لیدرس منٛز سیسہٕ تہٕ رَلاونہٕ آمتین رنگن ہٕنٛز جانچ کٔرِتھ۔ لیبس پرٛژھِو زِ کوٚتُت نمونہٕ چھُ ضروٗری، پوڈر تھٲوِو اَمِیٚکِس بنٛد پیکس منٛز یا اَکِس صاف بنٛد تھیلہِ منٛز، تہٕ پیکس پیٹھ چھاپنہٕ آمُت بیچ نمبر لیٚکھِو۔ FSSAI چھُ پنٕنِس ویب سائٹس پیٹھ نوٹیفائیڈ فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیبن ہٕنٛز فہرست شائع کران۔
seg.1883beca4d73.back: A NABL-approved food testing lab can do a check of lead and added colours in turmeric. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its closed pack or in a clean closed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI لائسنس یا رجسٹریشن نمبر۔ یہ ہیٚکِو تۄہۍ FSSAI ہٕنٛزِ FoSCoS ویب سائٹِ پیٹھ وُچھِتھ۔
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can see this on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: یَمہِ یہ بنوو یا پیک کوٚر، تَمہِ سُنٛد ناو تہٕ پتہٕ۔
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: نیٹ مقدار، MRP، بیچ یا لاٹ نمبر، تہٕ بیسٹ بیفور تٲریخ۔
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: یہ کتہِ چھُ کاشت کرنہٕ آمُت۔ اَلگ اَلگ علاقن ہٕنٛدِس لیدرس چھُ اَلگ رنگ آسان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ علاقُک ناو آسنہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ اَکہِ ہِوین چیزن ہُند مُقابلہ کرُن آسان گژھان۔
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was cultivated. Turmeric of different areas has different colour, therefore with the area's name present, comparing similar things becomes easy.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: پیکُک زِپ تھٲوِو بنٛد، یا پوڈر کڈِتھ تھٲوِو اَکِس ہۄکھ، ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز۔
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or take the powder out and keep it in a dry, airtight jar.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: ہۄکھ چَمچ ورتٲوِو۔ تَر چَمچ چھُ لیدرس منٛز ڈَلہٕ بناوان۔
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A wet spoon makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: یہ تھٲوِو سیود تاپھہٕ نِشہِ دور، تاپھہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ رنگ پھیکہٕ گژھان۔
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep this away from direct sunlight, with sunlight the colour becomes dull.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: کیا واریاہ چمکہٕ دار زرد لیدُر چھُ خراب نِشان؟
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very shiny yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: صرف اَمہِ سٟتۍ نہٕ۔ رنگ چھُ قِسمہِ، کاشتٕچ جایہِ، تہٕ ہۄکھناونہٕ تہٕ پیٖہنہٕ کِس طریقس سٟتۍ بدلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھُ لیدرن منٛز واریاہ فرق آسان۔ وُچُن چھُ یہِ زِ رنگ چھا پاؤڈرٕ منٛزٕ واریاہ آسانی سان نیران، یِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ آبٕچہِ جانچہِ منٛز۔
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by this alone. Colour changes with variety, place of cultivation, and the method of drying and grinding, therefore there is a lot of difference among turmerics. What to see is whether the colour comes out of the powder very easily, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: کیا آبٕچ جانچ ہیٚکہِ ہٲوِتھ زِ لیدرس منٛز چھُنہٕ سیسہٕ؟
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: نہٕ۔ لیڈ کرومیٹ چھُ نہٕ آبس منٛز گلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ ہیٚکہِ نہٕ آبٕچ جانچ یہ وُچھِتھ۔ یہ چھُ صرف لیب ٹیسٹ سٟتۍ پتاہ لگان۔
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, therefore the water check cannot see it. This is found out only with a lab test.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.t: لیدرس منٛز کیازِ چھِ ڈَلہٕ پیوان؟
seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: نَمی۔ تَر چَمچ یا کھولمُت پیک چھُ پوڈرس آب ہیٚنہٕ دِوان۔ ڈَلہٕ پھٹٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ تہٕ پیک تھٲوِو بنٛد۔
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an opened pack lets the powder take water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: اگر کانٛہہ جانچ ٹھیک نہٕ باسہِ، تیٚلہِ کیا کرو؟
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If some check does not seem right, then what should we do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: تَتھ بیچس منٛزٕ لیدُر ورتاوُن کٔرِو بنٛد، پیک تھٲوِو، تہٕ بیچ نمبرس سٟتۍ کٔرِو کِنن وٲلِس سٟتۍ رابطہٕ۔ تۄہۍ ہیٚکِو FSSAI ہٕنٛزِ Food Safety Connect ایپ ذریعہٕ اَمِیٚچ شکایت تہِ کٔرِتھ۔ اگر یہ سون آسہِ، تیٚلہِ سوٗزِو اَسہِ پیکٕچ تہٕ گلاسٕچ فوٹو WhatsApp پیٹھ۔
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using turmeric from that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain about it through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If this is ours, then send us a photo of the pack and the glass on WhatsApp.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: یِم جانچہٕ کٔرِو سانہِ لیدرس پیٹھ تہِ۔ اگر کینٛہہ ٹھیک نہٕ باسہِ، تیٚلہِ پیکس پیٹھ لیٚکھتھ بیچ نمبرس سٟتۍ اَکھ فوٹو ⟦1⟧اَسہِ کٔرِو WhatsApp⟦/1⟧۔
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too. If something does not seem right, then ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number written on the pack.

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: کوڈی کورا چھُ سُہ کُکرٕ سالن یُس آتھوارِ دۄپہرس آندھرا کیٚن گرَن منٛز بنان چھُ: اَڈِج وول کُکُر مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ لیدرس منٛز مَلِتھ، گاڑھ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گنڈٕ تہٕ ٹماٹرٕ گریوی منٛز رَنِتھ، تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ گرم مسالہٕ ژٕھنِتھ۔ یہ چھُ گرم بَتس سٟتۍ دسترخوانس پیٹھ یِوان، تہٕ بچمُت سالن راتھ ڈوسا یا چپاتی سٟتۍ۔
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi kura is that chicken curry which is made in Andhra homes on Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken rubbed in chilli and turmeric, cooked in thick golden-coloured onion and tomato gravy, and at the end garam masala added. It comes to the table with hot rice, and leftover curry at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: اَتھ منٛز ٹیٚٹھر چھےٚ سانہِ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ سٟتۍ یِوان، گنٹورٕچ سۄ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ مَرچ یۄسہٕ آندھرا کیٚن سالنن تیز مزٕ تہٕ چمکدار وۄزُل رنگ دِوان چھےٚ، تہٕ میرینیڈس منٛز چھُ سون لیدُر پوڈر۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ تہٕ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ مشورن منٛز چھُ لیوکھمُت زِ ٹیٚٹھر کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کم کٔرِو۔
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: In it the heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries a sharp taste and bright red colour, and in the marinade is our turmeric powder. This recipe is for 4 people and quite hot; in the tips it is written how to reduce the heat.

seg.9cb820880217.back: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in thick golden-coloured onion and tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and coriander.

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also turns out well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: کُکرس مَلِو دٔہۍ، تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن۔ 30 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو۔ اگر باورچی خانہٕ گرم آسہِ، تیٚلہِ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز۔
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt on the chicken. Keep 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, then keeping a lid on, keep in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: اَکِس گوٚب پینس یا کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم۔ ژٕھنِو رۄنٛگ، الٲچی تہٕ دال چیٖنی تہٕ دِیِو کیٛنژن سیکنڈن چٹخنہٕ۔
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: In a heavy pan or kadai heat oil on medium flame. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: ژٕھنِو گنڈٕ، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ۔
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: گنڈٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم گاڑھ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن۔ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ چھِ اَتھ 12–15 مِنَٹ لگان؛ بار بار ہِلٲوِو تاکہ یِم برابر بھورٕ گژھن تہٕ زلن نہٕ۔
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry onions in oil until they become deep golden coloured. On medium flame this takes 12–15 minutes; stir again and again so they brown evenly and don't burn.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: ژٕھنِو اَدرَک تہٕ رۄہنٕ پیسٹ، پتہٕ ٹماٹر، تہٕ رَنِو یوٗت تام یِم نرم گژھن۔ پیسٹ بُزِو 1 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام کٔچ بوے گژھِ، پتہٕ رَنِو ٹماٹر 5–6 مِنَٹ، دبٲوان روٗزِو، یوٗت تام یِم گلن تہٕ کنارَن پیٹھ تیل باسہِ۔
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger and garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook until they become soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook tomatoes 5–6 minutes, keep pressing, until they melt and oil appears on the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: ژٕھنِو دَنِوالٕ پوڈر تہٕ بُزِو 30 سیکنڈ۔
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Add coriander powder and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: ژٕھنِو کُکُر تہٕ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ رَنِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام اَڈِجہِ نِش کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ۔ گوڈنیٚک 5 مِنَٹ بُزِو ڈَکنہٕ ورٲے یوٗت تام ٹُکرٕ غیر شفاف گژھن، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو گرم آب، ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ رَنِو تقریباً 20 مِنَٹ، وَقتہٕ وَقتہٕ ہِلٲوان۔
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add chicken and with lid on cook on medium flame until no pink colour remains near the bone. First 5 minutes fry without lid until pieces become opaque, then add hot water, put lid and cook about 20 minutes, stirring from time to time.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: اَکھ موٹ ٹُکرٕ وُچھِو: کُکُر چھُ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ اَڈِجہِ نِش کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ تہٕ رَس صاف نیرِ۔ گریوی ہُند مزٕ وُچھِو تہٕ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو نوٗن۔
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Look at one thick piece: chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear. Taste the gravy and if needed add salt.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: ژٕھنِو گرم مسالہٕ تہٕ دَنِوال۔ ڈَکنہٕ ورٲے 3 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو، یوٗت تام گریوی تۄہہِ پسند گاڑھ گژھِ تہٕ پیٹھہٕ تیلٕچ وۄزٕج تہہ تیرِ۔
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Add garam masala and coriander. Cook 3 minutes on low flame without lid, until gravy becomes thick as you like and a red layer of oil floats on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو سالن 10 مِنَٹ؛ گریوی چھےٚ بیہان تہٕ مزٕ چھُ رَلان۔
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the flame and before serving keep the curry 10 minutes; the gravy settles and the flavour blends.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: گنڈٕ بُزِو گاڑھ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ؛ گریوی ہُند رنگ تہٕ گاڑھر چھُ یِمَوے سٟتۍ یِوان۔
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry onions deep golden coloured; the gravy's colour and thickness come from these.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ۔ درمیانہٕ سالنٕ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا ورتٲوِو سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر یُس وۄزُل رنگ دِوان چھُ تہٕ ٹیٚٹھر کم تھاوان چھُ۔
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium curry take 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder which gives red colour and keeps heat low.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: اَڈِج وٲلۍ ٹُکرٕ ہیٚیِو؛ اَڈِجہٕ چھےٚ گریوی گاڑھ مزٕ دِوان۔
seg.57940a63282d.back: Take pieces with bone; the bones give the gravy deep flavour.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: کُکُر ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو ٹماٹرٕ مسالس نِشہِ تیل الگ گژھنہٕ، نَتہٕ چھُ گریوی ہُند مزٕ کوٚچ باسان۔
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding chicken let oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy tastes raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: کوبّری کوڈی کورا: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ خشخاش تہٕ ذرا آبس سٟتۍ پیٖہِو، تہٕ یہ پیسٹ ژٕھنِو گرم مسالس سٟتۍ؛ گریوی بنِ زیادٕ گاڑھ تہٕ بھرپور۔
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and add this paste with the garam masala; the gravy will become thicker and rich.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: پیٖہمُت مسالہٕ: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ دَنِوالٕ بیول، 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ بادیان، 3 رۄنٛگ تہٕ دال چیٖنی ہُند لۄکٕٹ ٹُکرٕ تیلہٕ ورٲے بُزِتھ پیٖہِو، تہٕ ورتٲوِو یہ دَنِوالٕ پوڈر تہٕ گرم مسالہٕ بدلہٕ۔
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: roast without oil and grind 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, and use this instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: پریشر کُکر: کُکُر تہٕ آب ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ رَنِو 2 سیٖٹی تام تہٕ دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ۔
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water cook up to 2 whistles and let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: آتھوارِ کِس طریقس پٲٹھۍ پیش کٔرِو گرم بَتس تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھُ چپاتی، ڈوسا یا راگی سنگٹی سٟتۍ تہِ جان لگان۔
seg.8b4376996905.back: In the Sunday way serve with hot rice and a spoon of ghee. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز 2 دۄہن تام؛ دوبارٕ کٔرِو یوٗت گرم زِ اندرٕ تام ٹٲرِ نیرِ۔ دۆیمہِ دۄہ چھُ سالنُک مزٕ بیٚیہِ گاڑھ گژھان۔
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keeping lid on keep in the fridge up to 2 days; reheat so hot that steam comes out to the inside. The next day the curry's flavour becomes even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: آندھرا کُکرٕ سالن کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How can we make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر کٔرِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا ورتٲوِو سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، یُس تیوٗے وۄزُل رنگ دِوان چھُ تہٕ ٹیٚٹھر کم تھاوان چھُ۔ آخرس پیٹھ اَکھ چَمچ دٔہۍ رَلاونہٕ سٟتۍ تہِ چھُ تیز مزٕ نرم گژھان۔
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Make Teja chilli powder 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour and keeps heat low. Mixing one spoon of curd at the end also softens the sharp taste.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: آندھرا کُکرٕ سالن کیازِ چھُ یوٗت ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: آندھرا کیٚن کھینَن منٛز چھےٚ تیجا ہِشہٕ گنٹورٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن ورتاونہٕ یِوان، یِم بیٚیَن علاقن کیٚن سالنن ہٕندِس مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ کھۄتہٕ واریاہ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ چھِ۔ یہ ٹیٚٹھر چھےٚ اَمہِ سالنُک حصہٕ۔
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra foods Guntur chillies like Teja are used, which are much hotter than the chilli powder of other regions' curries. This heat is part of this curry.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ پَتہٕ لگِ زِ کُکُر چھُ اندرٕ تام رٔنِتھ؟
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know that chicken is cooked to the inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: سارِوے کھۄتہٕ موٹ ٹُکرٕ ژٹِو اَڈِجہِ نِش۔ کُکُر چھُ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ اَڈِجہِ نِش کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ تہٕ رَس صاف نیرِ۔
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut the thickest piece near the bone. Chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: کیا کوڈی کورا ہیٚکہٕ دٔہۍ ورٲے بٔنِتھ؟
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can kodi kura be made without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: آ۔ کُکُر مَلِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر، نوٗن تہٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ لیمبہٕ رَسس سٟتۍ، تہٕ گریوی منٛز ژٕھنِو اَکھ ٹماٹر بیٚیہِ۔
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Rub the chicken with chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: آندھرا کوڈی کورا · آندھرا کوڈی کورا ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: Andhra Kodi Kura · Andhra Kodi Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: آندھرا کوڈی کورا۔ آندھرا ہُند آتھوارُک کُکرٕ سالن: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس منٛز مَلِتھ کُکُر، گنڈٕ تہٕ ٹماٹرٕ گاڑھ گریوی منٛز گرم مسالس سٟتۍ رَنِتھ۔
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken rubbed in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in onion and tomato thick gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: آندھرا کوڈی کورا: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.ef9179c0bfa9.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، 540 g پیک

seg.732069e7f45f.t: 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 رۄنٛگ، 2 سبز الٲچی، 1 اِنچ دال چیٖنی

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: بیلّم پونگلی چھےٚ سۄ مۄدُر پونگل یۄسہٕ تیلگو گرَن منٛز سنکرانتی ہٕنزِ صُبحِ بنان چھےٚ: تومُل تہٕ بُزمٕژ مۄنٛگ دال واریاہ نرم رَنِتھ، پتہٕ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ مۄدُر تہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ بھرپور بنٲوِتھ۔ تہوارٕچ کھیٚنہٕ برونٛہہ چھےٚ یہ نیویدیم پٲٹھۍ چڑھاونہٕ یِوان، تہٕ واریاہن مندرن تہٕ جُمعہٕ کیٚن پوجاین منٛز چھےٚ یہوے پرساد۔
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is that sweet pongal which is made in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then made sweet with jaggery and rich with ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedyam, and in many temples and Friday pujas this is the prasad.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: گنہٕ گُڑ چھُ اَتھ ہلکہٕ بھورٕ رنگ تہٕ ٹافی ہِش بھرپور مۄدُرر دِوان، تہٕ سانہِ جیڈی پپّو پیکہٕ کۍ گیٖوَس منٛز ترٛٲوِتھ سالِم کاجو چھِ کرکرٕ پن اَنان۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.17053455adbb.back: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and toffee-like rich sweetness, and whole cashews fried in the ghee of our JD Pappu pack bring crunch. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: رَنَنُک وقت چھُ پریشر کُکرُک؛ عام دیگچہِ منٛز لگن تقریباً 15 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ۔
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is of the pressure cooker; in an ordinary pot it will take about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: بُزمٕژ مۄنٛگ دال تہٕ تومُل رَنِو یوٗت تام یِم واریاہ نرم گژھن، ژٕھنِو گلٲوِتھ گنہٕ گُڑ تہٕ رَنِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام یہ چمکدار گژھِ۔ آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو گیٖوَس منٛز ترٛٲوِتھ کاجو، کشمش تہٕ الٲچی۔
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice until they become very soft, add melted cane jaggery and cook on low flame until it becomes glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ کپ مۄنٛگ دال ⟦1⟧پیٖلۍ مۄنٛگ دال (پیسرپپّو)، تقریباً 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ ⟦1⟧ذرا دَبٲوِتھ بٔرِو، تقریباً 150 g؛ زیادٕ مۄدُر پسند آسہِ تیٚلہِ ذرا بیٚیہِ⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧fill pressing a little, about 150 g; if you like sweeter then a little more⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: کھیٚنہٕ وٲلۍ کافورٕچ اَکھ چُٹکی (پچّا کرپورم) ⟦1⟧یژھِو تیٚلہِ؛ واریاہ لۄکٕٹ چُٹکی⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: One pinch of edible camphor (pachha karpooram) ⟦1⟧if you want; very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: مۄنٛگ دال بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ، پتہٕ رَنِو یہ تومُلَن سٟتۍ یوٗت تام یہ واریاہ نرم تہٕ گلمُت گژھِ۔ گوڈٕ بُزِو دال پریشر کُکرس یا گوٚب تلہٕ وٲلِس دیگچس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تیلہٕ ورٲے، ہِلٲوان، یوٗت تام سوندھ خۄشبوے یِیہِ تہٕ ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ، تقریباً 3–4 مِنَٹ۔
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast moong dal until it becomes light golden coloured, then cook it with rice until it becomes very soft and mushy. First roast the dal in the pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low flame without oil, stirring, until a nutty aroma comes and it becomes light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: بُزمٕژ دالِ منٛز ژٕھنِو تومُل، دۄشوَے چھٔلِو 2–3 لٹہٕ آبس منٛز اکٹھے، تہٕ آب کڈِو۔
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add rice to the roasted dal, wash both in 2–3 changes of water together, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: ژٕھنِو 3 کپ آب۔ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو پریشرس منٛز 4–5 سیٖٹی تام تہٕ دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ، یا دیگچس منٛز ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ 25–30 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو، ہۄکھنہٕ لگِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ذرا گرم آب۔
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. On medium flame pressure cook up to 4–5 whistles and let pressure come down by itself, or in a pot with lid cook 25–30 minutes on low flame, if it starts drying add a little hot water.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: کھولِو تہٕ کَفگیرٕ کہِ پتہٕ کِنہِ کٔرِو تومُل تہٕ دال ذرا مَسلِتھ۔ یہ گژھِ نرم تہٕ دلیہٕ ہیوٗ آسُن، ہۄکھ نہٕ۔
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and with the back of a ladle mash the rice and dal a little. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: گُڑ گلٲوِو ¼ کپ آبس منٛز تہٕ ژٕھنِو تومُلَن منٛز۔ گُڑ تہٕ آب کٔرِو لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ گرم، ہِلٲوان، صرف یوٗت تام یہ گلِ، تقریباً 2–3 مِنَٹ؛ گرٛکاونٕچ ضرورت چھےٚ نہٕ۔
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt jaggery in ¼ cup water and add to the rice. Heat jaggery and water in a small pan on low flame, stirring, only until it melts, about 2–3 minutes; no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: ہِلٲوان لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ تہٕ چمکدار گژھِ، 5–7 مِنَٹ؛ ژٕھنِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو۔ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت تہٕ تلس تام ہِلٲوان روٗزِو، کیازِ گُڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ چھےٚ پونگلی جلدی تلس لگان۔
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Stirring, cook on low flame until it becomes thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; add 2 tablespoons ghee. Keep the flame low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after adding jaggery the pongali sticks to the bottom quickly.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: مزٕ وُچھِو، تہٕ زیادٕ مۄدُر یژھِو تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ذرا بیٚیہِ گلٲوِتھ گُڑ۔
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want sweeter add a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: باقی گیٖوَس منٛز ترٛٲوِو کاجو؛ الٲچی سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو۔ بچمُت 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو کٔرِو لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ گرم تہٕ ہِلٲوِو کاجو یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن، تقریباً 1 مِنَٹ، آخری کیٛنژن سیکنڈن منٛز ژٕھنِو کشمش یوٗت تام یِم پھولن۔
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry cashews in the remaining ghee; add with cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee in a small pan on less than medium flame and stir cashews until golden, about 1 minute, in the last few seconds add raisins until they puff.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: کاجو، کشمش تہٕ گیٖو ژٕھنِو پونگلی پیٹھ، الٲچی پوڈر تہٕ اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ کافور تہِ ژٕھکِو، تہٕ جان پٲٹھۍ رَلٲوِو۔
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Add cashews, raisins and ghee over pongali, also sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor if you are using it, and mix well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ گرم گرم پیش کٔرِو۔ تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ پونگلی گاڑھ گژھان؛ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو کیٛنہہ چَمچ گرم آب تہٕ کٔرِو یہ ڈٲلۍ۔
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the flame and serve hot. By keeping the pongali becomes thick; if needed add some spoons of hot water and make it loose.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: تومُل تہٕ دال رَنِو پورٕ پٲٹھۍ نرم؛ گُڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ چھِ نہٕ یِم بیٚیہِ نرم گژھان۔
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook rice and dal fully soft; after adding jaggery they don't become any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: مۄنٛگ دال بُزنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ پونگلی منٛز سوندھ خۄشبوے یِوان؛ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت تاکہ یہ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ، بھورٕ نہٕ۔
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting moong dal brings nutty aroma in the pongali; keep the flame low so it becomes golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: گوٚب تلہٕ وول پین ہیٚیِو تہٕ گُڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ ہِلٲوان روٗزِو؛ یہ چھےٚ جلدی تلس لٲگِتھ زلان۔
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Take a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: پونگلی وٲلِو نارس پیٹھہٕ تیلہِ یُتھ یہ وُنہِ ذرا ڈٲلۍ آسہِ؛ شیہُل گژھنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ یہ جمان۔
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the flame when it is still a little loose; on cooling it sets.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: تاڑ گُڑ: تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ ورتٲوِو؛ پونگلی ہُند رنگ گژھِ گاڑھ تہٕ مۄدُرر آسہِ گاڑھ تہٕ دُہس ہِش۔
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the pongali's colour will become deep and sweetness deep and smoke-like.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: چکّیرا پونگلی: گُڑٕ بدلہٕ ژٕھنِو ¾ کپ چیٖنی؛ پونگلی بنِ ہلکہٕ رنگٕچ تہٕ چیٖنی ہِش مۄدُر۔
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: instead of jaggery add ¾ cup sugar; pongali will become light-coloured and sugar-like sweet.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: سنکرانتی ہٕنزِ صُبحِ چڑھٲوِو یہ نیویدیم پٲٹھۍ، پتہٕ پیش کٔرِو یہ گرم تہوارٕچ کھیٚنہٕ سٟتۍ، پُلیہورا تہٕ گاریلو سٟتۍ۔
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: On Sankranti morning offer it as naivedyam, then serve it hot with the festival meal, with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: بچمٕژ پونگلی تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ ژٕھنِو ذرا گرم آب تہٕ کم گیٖو، تہٕ ہِلٲوان کٔرِو گرم۔
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving add a little hot water and a little ghee, and heat stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: پونگلی تہٕ چکّیرا پونگلی منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: صرف پونگلی ہُند مطلب چھُ اکثر نوٗنہٕ وٲجِنۍ پونگلی یۄسہٕ کالہٕ مریٖژ تہٕ زیٖرس سٟتۍ بنان چھےٚ۔ چکّیرا پونگلی تہٕ بیلّم پونگلی چھےٚ مۄدُر، یِم چیٖنی یا گُڑٕ سٟتۍ بنان چھِ۔
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Plain pongal usually means the salty pongal that is made with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongal and bellam pongal are sweet; these are made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: کیا بیلّم پونگلی ہیٚکہٕ پریشر کُکرس منٛز بٔنِتھ؟
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can bellam pongali be made in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: آ۔ بُزمٕژ دال تہٕ تومُل رَنِو 3 کپ آبس سٟتۍ 4–5 سیٖٹی تام، دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو گلٲوِتھ گُڑ تہٕ رَنِو کھۄلِتھ کُکرس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water up to 4–5 whistles, let pressure come down by itself, then add melted jaggery and cook in the opened cooker on low flame.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: شیہُل گژھنہٕ پتہٕ کیازِ گیہِ میٲنۍ پونگلی سَخ؟
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: پونگلی چھےٚ شیہُل گژھنہٕ سٟتۍ جمان، تہٕ گُڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ زیادٕ کال رَنَنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ یہ بیٚیہِ سَخ گژھان۔ وٲلِو یہ نارس پیٹھہٕ تیلہِ یُتھ یہ وُنہِ ذرا ڈٲلۍ آسہِ، تہٕ بچمٕژ کٔرِو گرم آبس سٟتۍ ڈٲلۍ۔
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali sets on cooling, and cooking long after adding jaggery makes it even harder. Take it off the flame when it is still a little loose, and loosen leftover with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: کیا پونگلی منٛز ہیٚکہٕ تاڑ گُڑ ژٕھنِتھ؟
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can palm jaggery be added to pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: آ۔ تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ (تاٹی بیلّم) ورتٲوِو۔ پونگلی ہُند رنگ گژھِ گاڑھ تہٕ مزٕ گاڑھ تہٕ ذرا دُہس ہیوٗ۔
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali's colour will become deep and taste deep and a little smoke-like.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: بیلّم پونگلی۔ سنکرانتی خٲطرٕ بیلّم پونگلی: تومُل تہٕ بُزمٕژ مۄنٛگ دال نرم رَنِتھ، گنہٕ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ مۄدُر کٔرِتھ تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ گیٖوَس منٛز ترٛٲوِتھ کاجو سٟتۍ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: Bellam Pongali. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, made sweet with cane jaggery and at the end with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: بیلّم پونگلی: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.28c87ea23a5c.t: 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.t: کھیٚنہٕ وٲلۍ کافورٕچ اَکھ چُٹکی (پچّا کرپورم)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: One pinch of edible camphor (pachha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: آندھرا چیپلا پُلوسو ⟦1⟧(آندھرا اِملی وول گاڑٕ سالن)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: چیپلا پُلوسو چھُ ساحلی آندھرا ہُند اِملی وول گاڑٕ سالن، یُس گوداوری ضلعن منٛز خاص دِھیان سان بنان چھُ: گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ ترٛش، وۄزلہِ اِملی گریوی منٛز گنڈٕ، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتن سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِتھ۔ یہ چھُ آتھوارِ دۄپہرٕچ کھیٚنٕچ ڈِش، تہٕ واریاہ گرٕ چھِ یہ مِژِ ہٕنزِ بانہِ منٛز رَنِتھ دۆیمہِ دۄہہ خٲطرٕ تھاوان، یُتھ گریوی گاڑِ منٛز رَچِتھ آسہِ۔
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, which is made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish cooked on low flame in sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a dish of Sunday lunch, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: سون لیدُر پوڈر چھُ میرینیڈس تہٕ گریوی دۄشوَنی منٛز گژھان۔ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ پُلوسوس گاڑھ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ اَکھ برابر ٹیٚٹھر دِوان یۄسہٕ اِملی ہُند توازن بناوان چھےٚ۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into both the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and an even heat which balances the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: تیاری منٛز چھِ میرینیڈٕکۍ 15 مِنَٹ شامِل۔ کیٛنژن گنٛٹن تھاونہٕ پتہٕ چھُ سالنُک مزٕ بیٚیہِ جان گژھان۔
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: Preparation includes 15 minutes of marinade. After keeping a few hours the curry's flavour becomes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: گاڑ مَلِو نوٗن، لیدُر تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ، گنڈٕ تہٕ مسالہٕ بُزِو، یِم گرٛکٲوِو اِملی آبس منٛز، پتہٕ رَنِو گاڑ گریوی منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ہِلاونہٕ ورٲے۔
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then cook the fish in the gravy on low flame without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ ٹُکرٕ ⟦1⟧سَخ ماز وٲجِنہِ گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ: روہو (بوچا)، کورامینو (مَرل) یا سیر فِش (ونجرم)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧thick pieces of firm-fleshed fish: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g اِملی ⟦1⟧لیمبہٕ ہیوٗ گولہٕ، 2 کپ ووشنِس آبس منٛز 15 مِنَٹ بِگرٲوِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-like ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.4fc8455e3190.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ اَدرَک تہٕ رۄہنٕ پیسٹ

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر پوڈر ⟦1⟧¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ میرینیڈٕ خٲطرٕ، ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ گریوی خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for the marinade, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ میرینیڈٕ خٲطرٕ، باقی گریوی خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for the marinade, rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن ⟦1⟧گریوی خٲطرٕ، یا مزٕ وُچھِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or after tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ⟦/1⟧ سٟتۍ تہِ چھُ جان بنان۔
seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also turns out well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ ٹُکرٕ چھٔلِو آبس منٛز آہستہٕ زٕ ترٛےٚ لٹہٕ تہٕ آب کڈِو جان پٲٹھۍ۔
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces in water gently two three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: گاڑِ مَلِو نوٗن، لیدُر تہٕ 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر؛ 15 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو۔ میرینیڈٕ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن تہٕ ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر پوڈر۔
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder; keep 15 minutes. For the marinade take 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: بِگرٲمٕژ اِملی مَلِو جان پٲٹھۍ پنٕنِس آبس منٛز تہٕ چھٲنِو۔ تۄہہِ گژھِ تقریباً 2 کپ پتلہٕ اِملی آب آسُن۔
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its own water and strain. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: اَکِس کھۄلِس پینس یا مِژِ ہٕنزِ بانہِ منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم۔ ژٕھنِو میٚتھۍ دانہٕ، سٔریوٚم تہٕ زیٖرٕ تہٕ دِیِو چٹخنہٕ، دِھیان تھٲوِو زِ میٚتھۍ گژھِ نہٕ کرٛہنۍ۔
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: In a wide pan or clay pot heat oil on medium flame. Add fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin and let crackle, take care that the fenugreek does not become black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: گنڈٕ، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم نرم گژھن؛ مسالن ہٕنز پوڈر ژٕھنِو۔ گنڈٕ بُزِو تقریباً 6–8 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام یِم نرم تہٕ ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن، ژٕھنِو اَدرَک تہٕ رۄہنٕ پیسٹ تہٕ ٹماٹر تہٕ رَنِو 2 مِنَٹ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو باقی لیدُر پوڈر، باقی سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ دَنِوالٕ پوڈر تہٕ ہِلٲوِو 30 سیکنڈ۔
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil until they become soft; add the spice powders. Fry onions about 6–8 minutes until they become soft and light golden, add ginger and garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: ژٕھنِو اِملی آب تہٕ گرٛکٲوِو 10 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام تیل پیٹھ یِیہِ۔ ژٕھنِو گریوی ہُند نوٗن؛ اِملی ہٕنز کٔچ بوے گژھِ ختم گژھٕنۍ تہٕ گریوی ذرا گاڑھ۔
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Add tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil comes on top. Add the gravy's salt; the raw smell of the tamarind should be gone and the gravy a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: گریوی ہُند مزٕ وُچھِو۔ یہ گژھِ صاف ترٛش، نوٗنہٕ وول تہٕ ٹیٚٹھ آسُن، کیازِ گاڑ ہیٚیِ اَمیُک کیٛنہہ حصہٕ پانس منٛز۔
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will take some part of it into itself.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: گاڑ ژٕھنِو آہستہٕ تہٕ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ رَنِو 10–12 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ؛ بانہٕ پھیرِو، چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ ہِلٲوِو نہٕ۔ ٹُکرٕ تھٲوِو اَکِس تہس منٛز، پیٹھہٕ ژٕھنِو گریوی تہٕ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت۔
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Add the fish gently and with lid on cook 10–12 minutes on low flame; turn the vessel, don't stir with a spoon. Keep the pieces in one layer, pour gravy over the top and keep the flame low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: اَکھ ٹُکرٕ وُچھِو سارِوے کھۄتہٕ موٹِس جایہِ: گاڑ چھُ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ ماز اندرٕ تام سفید یا غیر شفاف آسہِ تہٕ آسٲنی سان کنڈَو نِشہِ الگ گژھِ۔
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Look at one piece at the thickest place: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque to the inside and separates easily from the bones.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: دَنِوال ژٕھکِو، نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو پُلوسو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ کم از کم 30 مِنَٹ۔
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander, turn off the flame and before serving keep the pulusu covered at least 30 minutes.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: ہِلاونہٕ بدلہٕ پھیرِو بانہٕ تاکہ گاڑ سالِم روزِ۔
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring turn the vessel so the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: سَخ ماز وٲجِنہِ گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ ہیٚیِو؛ پتلۍ فِلے چھِ ڈیر کال رَنَنہٕ سٟتۍ پُھٹان۔
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Take thick pieces of firm-fleshed fish; thin fillets break with long cooking.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان۔ کم ٹیٚٹھ پُلوسو خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1½ بوٚڑ چَمچ، یا آندھرا کِس عام ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ پورٕ 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ۔
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu take 1½ tablespoons, or for the usual heat of Andhra the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: گاڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ گرٛکٲوِو اِملی گریوی جان پٲٹھۍ؛ گاڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ ہیٚکِو نہٕ یہ زیادٕ کال رٔنِتھ، نَتہٕ پُھٹِ یہ۔
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Before adding the fish boil the tamarind gravy well; after adding the fish you can't cook it long, otherwise it will break.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر: زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پُلوسو خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو گریوی منٛز سنّمٕ بدلہٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ تیجا چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ یقین نہٕ آسہِ تیٚلہِ کٔرِو 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچو سٟتۍ شروٗع۔
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu add in the gravy instead of Sannam 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder. Teja is very hot; if not sure, start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: رویّالا پُلوسو: ہیٚیِو 400 g صاف کرنہٕ آمٕتۍ جھینگہٕ تہٕ رَنِو صرف 5–6 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، یوٗت تام یِم گُلٲبی گژھن تہٕ وَلن۔
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: take 400 g cleaned prawns and cook only 5–6 minutes on low flame, until they become pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: مامیڈیکایا پُلوسو: گرٛیٖشمس منٛز چھِ گوداوری کیٚن گرَن منٛز کٔچہِ اَمبہٕ چِہ ٹُکرٕ ژٕھنان تہٕ اِملی کم ورتاوان۔
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer in Godavari homes pieces of raw mango are added and less tamarind is used.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بَتس تہٕ ژٹِتھ گنڈن سٟتۍ۔ گوداوری کیٚن واریاہن گرَن منٛز چھُ یہ دۆیمہِ دۄہہ پیش کرنہٕ یِوان، یُتھ مزٕ بیٚہِتھ آسن۔
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot rice and chopped onions. In many homes of Godavari it is served the next day, when the flavours have settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: بچمُت سالن تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ پینس منٛز کٔرِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ہِلاونہٕ ورٲے گرم۔
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat in a pan on low flame without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: چیپلا پُلوسو خٲطرٕ کۄسہٕ گاڑ چھےٚ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان؟
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: دریاوٕچ یا سمندرٕچ سَخ ماز وٲجِنۍ گاڑ، موٹین ٹُکرن منٛز ژٹِتھ: روہو (بوچا)، مَرل (کورامینو)، کتلا یا سیر فِش۔ کنڈَو وٲجِنۍ لۄکٕٹۍ گاڑ تہِ چھےٚ چلان مگر یِمن چھُ آہستہٕ سنبالُن پیوان۔
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: River or sea firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Small bony fish also work but they have to be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: چیپلا پُلوسو کیازِ چھُ دۆیمہِ دۄہہ زیادٕ مزٕدار باسان؟
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste tastier the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ گاڑِ اِملی تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن گریوی رَچاونُک وقت میلان، تہٕ ترٛشر تہٕ ٹیٚٹھر چھےٚ برابر گژھان۔ یہِ وجہ چھےٚ زِ واریاہ گرٕ چھِ یہ صُبحِ رَنان، راتھ کِس کھیٚنس یا دۆیمہِ دۄہہ خٲطرٕ۔
seg.566bd302c316.back: By keeping the fish gets time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and sourness and heat become balanced. That is the reason many homes cook it in the morning, for the night's meal or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: سالنس منٛز گاڑ پُھٹنہٕ نِشہِ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بچاوَو؟
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How do we save the fish from breaking in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ ہیٚیِو، یِم ژٕھنِو صرف گریوی گرٛکنہٕ پتہٕ، نار تھٲوِو لوٚت تہٕ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ ہِلاونہٕ بدلہٕ پھیرِو بانہٕ۔
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Take thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the flame low and instead of stirring with a spoon turn the vessel.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: تقریباً 40 g، لیمبہٕ ہیوٗ گولہٕ، 2 کپ ووشنِس آبس منٛز بِگرٲوِتھ۔ اگر ٹماٹر یا کوٚچ اَمب ژٕھنان چھِو تیٚلہِ ہیٚیِو ذرا کم۔
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-like ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If you are adding tomato or raw mango take a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: چیپلا پُلوسو · آندھرا گاڑٕ سالنٕچ ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: Chepala Pulusu · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms
