seg.03c44db05afe.t: چیپلا پُلوسو۔ گوداوری طریقُک گاڑٕ سالن: ترٛش اِملی گریوی منٛز گنڈٕ، سون لیدُر تہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِتھ گاڑ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ، مشورن تہٕ سوالن سٟتۍ۔
seg.03c44db05afe.back: Chepala Pulusu. Godavari-style fish curry: fish cooked on low flame in sour tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: آندھرا چیپلا پُلوسو (آندھرا اِملی وول گاڑٕ سالن) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: آندھرا چیپلا پُلوسو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.2aa804fbf5dd.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، 540 g پیک

seg.03b113f8e60b.t: 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: گونگورا مامسم چھُ گونگورا سٟتۍ رَنِتھ ماز، سُہ ترٛش پَن یُس آندھرا، تہٕ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ گنٹور، پنُن مانان چھُ۔ ماز چھُ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ لیدرس سٟتۍ نرم رَنَنہٕ یِوان، پتہٕ تتھ گونگورا سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنَنہٕ یِوان یُس بُزِتھ گاڑھ رنگُک ترٛش پیسٹ بنیومُت آسہِ، یوٗت تام سالن گاڑھ گژھِ تہٕ تیل پیٹھ یِیہِ۔
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is meat cooked with gongura, that sour leaf which Andhra, and most of all Guntur, considers its own. The meat is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then cooked on low flame with that gongura which has been fried into a dark sour paste, until the curry becomes thick and oil comes on top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: گونگورا ہٕنزِ تیز ترٛشرِ مقابلہٕ خٲطرٕ چھےٚ زوردار ٹیٚٹھر ضروٗری، تہٕ سۄ چھےٚ سانہِ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ سٟتۍ یِوان، گنٹورٕچ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ مَرچ، سٟتۍ سون لیدُر پوڈر۔ بَتس سٟتۍ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To match gongura's sharp sourness strong heat is necessary, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, with our turmeric powder. With rice for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: ماز رَنِو پریشرس منٛز تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹس سٟتۍ، پتہٕ رَنِو یہ گنڈٕ مسالہٕ تہٕ بُزمٕتین گونگورا پَنَن سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ گژھِ تہٕ تیل پیٹھ تیرِ۔
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the meat in pressure with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger garlic paste, then cook it with onion masala and fried gongura leaves on low flame until it becomes thick and oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g ماز ⟦1⟧اَڈِج سان سالنٕکۍ ٹُکرٕ، چھٔلِتھ تہٕ آب کڈِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g meat ⟦1⟧curry pieces with bone, washed and water drained⟦/1⟧

seg.72517604a27c.t: 1½ بوٚڑ چَمچ اَدرَک تہٕ رۄہنٕ پیسٹ

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 کپ گونگورا پَنہٕ ⟦1⟧تقریباً 2 گُتھہٕ (150 g)، ڈٕنٛڈین نِشہِ ژٹِتھ، چھٔلِتھ تہٕ آب جان پٲٹھۍ کڈِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), cut from the stems, washed and water drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل ⟦1⟧عام طور مۄنگ پھلی تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: ماز ژٕھنِو پریشر کُکرس منٛز تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر، اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ، جان پٲٹھۍ رَلٲوِو تہٕ 15 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو۔
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste and salt, mix well and keep 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: ماز رَنِو پریشرس منٛز تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر، اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ، نوٗن تہٕ آبس سٟتۍ۔ ژٕھنِو 1½ کپ آب تہٕ رَنِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ 5–6 سیٖٹی تام، پتہٕ دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ۔
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the meat in pressure with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and cook on medium flame up to 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: کُکر کھولِو تہٕ اَکھ ٹُکرٕ وُچھِو: ماز چھُ تیار تیلہِ یُتھ یہ نرم آسہِ تہٕ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ آسٲنی سان اَڈِجہِ نِشہِ الگ گژھِ۔ اگر نہٕ، تیٚلہِ رَنِو 1–2 سیٖٹی بیٚیہِ۔
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and look at one piece: the meat is ready when it is soft and separates easily from the bone with a spoon. If not, then cook 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: یوٚت تام ماز رَنہٕ، اَکِس پینس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل گرم۔
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the meat cooks, in a pan heat 1 tablespoon oil on medium flame.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: گونگورا بُزِو سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن سٟتۍ ذرا تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یہ گلِتھ گاڑھ رنگُک پیسٹ بنِ۔ اَتھ چھِ 8–10 مِنَٹ لگان؛ بار بار ہِلٲوِو تہٕ ہۄکھان پَنہٕ مَسلِو چَمچہٕ کہِ پتہٕ کِنہِ۔
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts and becomes a dark-coloured paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir again and again and mash the drying leaves with the back of the spoon.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: اَکِس گوٚب کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ 4 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل گرم تہٕ ژٕھنِو رۄنٛگ، الٲچی تہٕ دال چیٖنی۔
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: In a heavy kadai heat 4 tablespoons oil on medium flame and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: گنڈٕ بُزِو سالِم مسالن سٟتۍ یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن۔ گنڈن سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو کڑی پتہٕ، تہٕ دِیِو 10–12 مِنَٹ، بار بار ہِلٲوان۔
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry onions with whole spices until they become golden. Add curry leaves with the onions, and give 10–12 minutes, stirring again and again.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: ژٕھنِو دَنِوالٕ پوڈر تہٕ بُزِو 30 سیکنڈ۔ ژٕھنِو ماز تہٕ تَمیُک یخنہِ آب، پتہٕ گونگورا۔
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Add coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the meat and its stock water, then gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ گژھِ تہٕ تیل پیٹھ تیرِ۔ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت، وَقتہٕ وَقتہٕ ہِلٲوِو، تہٕ دِیِو 12–15 مِنَٹ۔ گونگورا ہٕنز ترٛشر رَلنہٕ پتہٕ وُچھِو وۄنۍ مزٕ تہٕ کٔرِو نوٗن ٹھیک۔
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Cook on low flame until it becomes thick and oil floats on top. Keep the flame low, stir from time to time, and give 12–15 minutes. After gongura's sourness mixes in, now taste and correct the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: ژٕھنِو گرم مسالہٕ۔ رَنِو 2 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ، پتہٕ نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو 10 مِنَٹ۔
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Add garam masala. Cook 2 minutes more, then turn off the flame and before serving keep 10 minutes.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: گونگورا ژٕھنَنہٕ پتہٕ وُچھِو مزٕ؛ اَمہِ ہٕنز ترٛشر چھےٚ پرٛتھ گُتھس منٛز الگ آسان۔
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: After adding gongura taste; its sourness is different in every bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ۔ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر؛ یہ کڈِو نہٕ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ، نَتہٕ چھُ گونگورا ہُند مزٕ پھیکہٕ تہٕ صرف ترٛش باسان۔
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; don't remove it completely, otherwise gongura's taste seems flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: گونگورا خٲطرٕ ورتٲوِو نہٕ ایلومینیمُک پین؛ اَمہِ ہٕنز ترٛشر چھےٚ دھاتس سٟتۍ ردِعمل کٔرِتھ سالنُک رنگ گاڑھ کران۔ ورتٲوِو اسٹیل یا شیٖنہٕ بانہٕ۔
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: For gongura don't use an aluminium pan; its sourness reacts with the metal and makes the curry's colour dark. Use a steel or iron vessel.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: اگر گونگورا واریاہ ترٛش آسہِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو توازنہٕ خٲطرٕ مسالس منٛز 1 گنڈٕ بیٚیہِ۔
seg.d036336075e5.back: If gongura is very sour, then add 1 more onion to the masala for balance.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: گونگورا کُکُر: ہیٚیِو 750 g اَڈِج سان کُکُر، پریشر کُکر ترٲوِو تہٕ گونگورا ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ رَنِو یہ مسالس منٛز ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ 20–25 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام اَڈِجہِ نِش کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ۔
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: take 750 g chicken with bone, leave the pressure cooker and before adding gongura cook it in the masala with lid 20–25 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: گونگورا رویّالو: ہیٚیِو 500 g صاف کرنہٕ آمٕتۍ جھینگہٕ، یِم ژٕھنِو گنڈن پتہٕ تہٕ رَنِو 5–6 مِنَٹ، صرف یوٗت تام یِم گُلٲبی گژھن تہٕ وَلن، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو گونگورا۔
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: take 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, only until they become pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: وۄزٕج مَرچ گونگورا: 6 ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن بُزِو گونگورا سٟتۍ تہٕ پیٖہِو اکٹھے؛ سالن بنِ گاڑھ رنگُک تہٕ زیادٕ تیز۔
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dry red chillies with gongura and grind together; the curry will become dark-coloured and sharper.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بَتس تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، یا جونّا روٹّے سٟتۍ۔ سٟتۍ اَکھ سادٕ کوٚچ گنڈٕ، یہ چھُ گنٹورُک طریقہٕ۔
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. With it a plain raw onion, this is Guntur's way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز 3 دۄہن تام؛ دوبارٕ کٔرِو یوٗت گرم زِ اندرٕ تام ٹٲرِ نیرِ۔ زیادٕ تر ترٛش سالنن ہِشہٕ چھُ یہ تہِ دۆیمہِ دۄہہ زیادٕ مزٕدار باسان۔
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keeping lid on keep in the fridge up to 3 days; reheat so hot that steam comes out to the inside. Like most sour curries this too tastes tastier the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.t: گونگورا کیا چھِ انگریزی منٛز ونان؟
seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: گونگورا چھِ انگریزی منٛز سورل لیوز ونان، اَتھ چھِ روزیل یا ریڈ سورل تہِ ونان (مراٹھی منٛز امباڑی، ہِندی منٛز پٹوا)۔ پَنہٕ چھِ ترٛش آسان تہٕ رَنَنہٕ سٟتۍ گاڑھ رنگُک پیسٹ بنان۔
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is called sorrel leaves in English, it is also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, patwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and on cooking become a dark-coloured paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: کیا گونگورا پَنَن بدلہٕ ہیٚکہٕ گونگورا آچار ژٕھنِتھ؟
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can gongura pickle be added instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: آ، مجبوری منٛز۔ بُزمٕتین پَنَن بدلہٕ ژٕھنِو 3–4 بوٚڑ چَمچ گونگورا آچار تہٕ نوٗن تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر کٔرِو کم، کیازِ آچارس منٛز چھِ دۄنوَے گوڈے۔
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, in compulsion. Instead of fried leaves add 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: گونگورا مامسم خٲطرٕ کوٚتاہ کال رَنَو ماز پریشرس منٛز؟
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long do we cook the meat in pressure for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: اَڈِج سان سالنٕکین ٹُکرن خٲطرٕ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تقریباً 5–6 سیٖٹی۔ یہ چھُ تیار تیلہِ یُتھ ماز آسٲنی سان اَڈِجہِ نِشہِ الگ گژھِ؛ پرانِس مازس ہیٚکن 1–2 سیٖٹی بیٚیہِ لٲگِتھ۔
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry pieces about 5–6 whistles on medium flame. It is ready when the meat separates easily from the bone; old meat can take 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: گونگورا مٹن کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How do we make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر یا اَمہِ بدلہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، تہٕ ہیٚیِو 2 سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن۔ کیٛنہہ ٹیٚٹھر تھٲوِو، کیازِ یہ چھےٚ گونگورا ہٕنزِ ترٛشرِ ہُند توازن بناوان۔
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or instead of it Sannam chilli powder, and take 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it balances gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: گونگورا مامسم۔ گنٹور طریقُک گونگورا مٹن: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس سٟتۍ رَنِتھ ماز، پتہٕ ترٛش گونگورا پَنَن سٟتۍ گاڑھ گژھنہٕ تام لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِتھ۔
seg.df5186f8f459.back: Gongura Mamsam. Guntur-way gongura mutton: meat cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked on low flame with sour gongura leaves until it becomes thick.

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: گونگورا مامسم: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.91eb7853c772.t: گونگورا پچّڑی ⟦1⟧(آندھرا گونگورا پَنَن ہٕنز چٹنی)⟦/1⟧

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: گونگورا پچّڑی چھےٚ سۄ چٹنی یَمہِ کِنہِ آندھرا سارِوے کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ مشہوٗر چھُ: ترٛش گونگورا پَنہٕ تیلس منٛز بُزِتھ بُزمٕتین مسالن، رۄہنہٕ تہٕ وۄزٕجہِ مَرچہِ سٟتۍ پیٖہِتھ۔ گنٹور تہٕ پلناڈو کِس علاقس منٛز چھےٚ یہ تقریباً پرٛتھ دۄہ دسترخوانس پیٹھ آسان، گرم بَتس منٛز اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ رَلٲوِتھ، سٟتۍ ژٹِتھ گنڈٕ۔
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is that chutney for which Andhra is most famous: sour gongura leaves fried in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. In the region of Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed in hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with chopped onion.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ اَتھ گاڑھ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ سۄ تیز ٹیٚٹھر دِوان یۄسہٕ پَنَن ہٕنزِ ترٛشرِ ہُند مقابلہٕ کران چھےٚ۔ یَمہِ ترکیبہِ سٟتۍ چھےٚ تقریباً 1½ کپ بنان، 6 لُکن خٲطرٕ کٲفی۔
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that sharp heat which matches the sourness of the leaves. With this recipe about 1½ cups are made, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھُ پیٖہنہٕ برونٛہہ پَنہٕ تہٕ مسالہٕ شیہُل کرُن تہِ شامِل۔
seg.1689d390a49e.back: Total time also includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: گونگورا پَنہٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم گاڑھ رنگٕچ گوٗدٕ بنن، پتہٕ پیٖہِو یِم بُزمٕتین دَنِوالٕ بیولن، میٚتھۍ، رۄہن، تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ۔ آخرس پیٹھ دِیِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ دالِ ہُند تڑکہٕ۔
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry gongura leaves in oil until they become a dark-coloured pulp, then grind them with roasted coriander seeds, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 کپ گونگورا پَنہٕ ⟦1⟧2 بٔڈین گُتھن نِشہِ ژٹِتھ، تقریباً 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧plucked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تِلہٕ تیل ⟦1⟧پَنہٕ بُزنہٕ خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ میٚتھۍ دانہٕ ⟦1⟧مینتھولو؛ اَمہِ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ نہٕ، نَتہٕ چھےٚ پچّڑی ٹیوٚتھ گژھان⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ کم ٹیٚٹھ پچّڑی خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن ⟦1⟧یا مزٕ وُچھِتھ⟦/1⟧

seg.9c36418bdb13.back: 2 dry red chillies ⟦1⟧broken in the middle⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: گونگورا پَنہٕ ژٹِو ڈٕنٛڈین نِشہِ تہٕ چھٔلِو 2–3 لٹہٕ آبس منٛز۔ یِم پھہلٲوِو اَکِس کپڑس پیٹھ تہٕ تھپتھپٲوِتھ کٔرِو پورٕ پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ؛ پَنَن پیٹھ روزن وول آب چھُ تیلس منٛز چھٹان تہٕ پچّڑی ہُند ٹِکُن کم کران۔
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pluck gongura leaves from the stems and wash in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; the water remaining on the leaves splashes in oil and reduces the keeping of the pachadi.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: دَنِوالٕ بیول، زیٖرٕ تہٕ میٚتھۍ بُزِو یوٗت تام خۄشبوے یِیہِ؛ شیہُل گژھنہٕ دِیِو۔ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ہۄکھ پین ورتٲوِو تہٕ برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو: میٚتھۍ گژھِ اَکھ درجہٕ گاڑھ گژھٕنۍ، تقریباً 2 مِنَٹ، مگر بھورٕ نہٕ۔
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander seeds, cumin and fenugreek until aroma comes; let cool. Use a dry pan on low flame and keep stirring constantly: fenugreek should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: گونگورا پَنہٕ بُزِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم ہۄکھِتھ گاڑھ رنگٕچ گوٗدٕ بنن، 6–8 مِنَٹ۔ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ کھۄلہٕ پین ورتٲوِو تہٕ بار بار ہِلٲوِو؛ پَنہٕ چھِ جلدی سُکڑان، سبزٕ پیٹھہٕ پھیکہٕ زیتوٗنی بھورٕ گژھان، تہٕ تِہُند تقریباً سورُے آب چھُ نیران۔
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil until they dry and become a dark-coloured pulp, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium flame and stir again and again; the leaves shrink quickly, go from green to dull olive brown, and almost all their water goes out.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: پَنہٕ پھہلٲوِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز تہٕ دِیِو پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھنہٕ، تقریباً 10 مِنَٹ۔
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: مسالہٕ پیٖہِو رۄہن، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ، پتہٕ پَنہٕ ژٕھنِتھ دِیِو جھٹکہٕ۔ گوڈٕ پیٖہِو بُزمٕتۍ مسالہٕ، 6 رۄہنٕ دانہٕ، تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن موٹہٕ پوڈرس منٛز۔
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse. First grind the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt into a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: شیہُل پَنہٕ ژٕھنِو تہٕ آبہٕ ورٲے دِیِو 3–4 جھٹکہٕ یوٗت تام موٹ پیسٹ بنِ۔ آندھرا کیٚن واریاہن گرَن منٛز چھِ یہ اَمہِ بدلہٕ کَنہِ کِس اوکھلس (رولو) منٛز کُٹان۔
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cool leaves and without water give 3–4 pulses until a coarse paste forms. In many Andhra homes instead of this it is pounded in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: مزٕ وُچھِو: یہ گژھِ ترٛش، ٹیٚٹھ تہٕ جان نوٗنہٕ وٲجِنۍ آسٕنۍ۔ اگر ترٛشر واریاہ تیز باسہِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو اَکھ چُٹکی نوٗن بیٚیہِ۔
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness seems too sharp, then add one more pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: باقی تیلس منٛز دِیِو سٔریوٚم، دالن، وۄزٕجن مَرچن تہٕ کڑی پتن ہُند تڑکہٕ؛ یہ رَلٲوِو۔ لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز کٔرِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تِلہٕ تیل گرم، سٔریوٚم دِیِو چٹخنہٕ، چنہٕ دال تہٕ ماشہٕ دال بُزِو یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھن، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، کُٹمُت رۄہن، کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ یَنٛگ کیٛنژن سیکنڈن خٲطرٕ۔ یہ ژٕھنِو پچّڑی پیٹھ تہٕ جان پٲٹھۍ رَلٲوِو۔
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: In the remaining oil give a tempering of mustard seeds, dals, red chillies and curry leaves; mix this in. Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a small pan, let mustard seeds crackle, fry chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour this on the pachadi and mix well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: ہیٚکِو تیٚلہِ تھٲوِو پچّڑی 30 مِنَٹ تاکہ مزٕ رَلن، پتہٕ بٔرِو یہ اَکِس صاف، ہۄکھِس شیشہٕ جارس منٛز۔
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If you can, keep the pachadi 30 minutes so the flavours blend, then fill it into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: بُزنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو پَنہٕ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ تاکہ پچّڑی زیادٕ کال ٹِکہِ۔
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Before frying make the leaves completely dry so the pachadi keeps longer.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ۔ کم ٹیٚٹھ پچّڑی خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا اَڈٕ تیجا تہٕ اَڈٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: میٚتھۍ تھٲوِو صرف ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تہٕ بُزِو صرف اَکھ درجہٕ گاڑھ؛ زیادٕ، یا زیادٕ گاڑھ بُزنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ پچّڑی ٹیوٚتھ گژھان۔
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek only ¼ teaspoon and roast only one shade darker; more, or roasting too dark, makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: جھٹکہٕ دِیِو، باریک پیٖہِو نہٕ: گونگورا پچّڑی گژھِ موٹ آسٕنۍ، پَنَن ہٕندۍ ٹُکرٕ گژھن نظرِ یِنۍ۔
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse, don't grind fine: gongura pachadi should be coarse, pieces of the leaves should be visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: تیلس منٛز کٔرِو نہٕ کنجوٗسی؛ پیٹھہٕ تیلٕچ تہہ چھےٚ پچّڑی زیادٕ کال ٹِکنس منٛز مدد کران۔
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Don't be stingy with oil; the oil layer on top helps the pachadi keep longer.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: گنڈٕ سٟتۍ: پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ رَلٲوِو 1 لۄکٕٹ، باریک ژٹِتھ گنڈٕ اَکِس حصس منٛز، تہٕ کھیٚیِو یہ تَمیُے دۄہ۔
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: before serving mix 1 small, finely chopped onion into one portion, and eat it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: سالِم وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن: مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ بدلہٕ بُزِو 12–15 ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن ذرا تیلس منٛز تہٕ پیٖہِو یِم مسالن سٟتۍ۔
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: سبز مَرچ گونگورا: 6–8 سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن بُزِو پَنَن سٟتۍ تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر کٔرِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ؛ ٹیٚٹھر آسہِ زیادٕ تیز تہٕ سبز مَرچہِ ہِش۔
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and make chilli powder 1 teaspoon; the heat will be sharper and like green chilli.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: اَکھ چَمچ رَلٲوِو گرم بَتس تہٕ گیٖوَس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو ژٹِتھ کٔچہِ گنڈٕ سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھےٚ ڈوسا، اِڈلی سٟتۍ تہٕ آندھرا ہٕنزِ کُنہِ تہِ تھالِ منٛز سٟتۍ تہِ جان لگان۔
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoon in hot rice and ghee and eat with chopped raw onion. It also goes well with dosa, idli and alongside in any Andhra thali.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: یہ تھٲوِو اَکِس صاف، ہۄکھِس شیشہٕ جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز 2 ہفتن تام، ہمیشہ ہۄکھ چَمچ ورتٲوِتھ۔ پیٹھہٕ تیلٕچ پتلہٕ تہہ چھےٚ اَتھ زیادٕ کال ٹِکنس منٛز مدد کران۔
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin oil layer on top helps it keep longer.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.t: گونگورا کیا چھِ انگریزی منٛز ونان؟
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: گونگورا چھُ روزیل کُلُک پَن، یُس اکثر سورل لیوز یا ریڈ سورل ناوٕ کِنۍ کِنَنہٕ یِوان چھُ۔ ہِندی تہٕ مراٹھی بولن وٲلین علاقن منٛز چھِ اَتھ امباڑی ونان۔
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, which is often sold by the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: گونگورا پچّڑی کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ترٛش؟
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How do we make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: ژٕھنِو ذرا بیٚیہِ نوٗن تہٕ مَرچ، یا رَلٲوِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گُڑ۔ پَنہٕ جان پٲٹھۍ بُزنہٕ سٟتۍ تہِ چھےٚ تِہنٛز ترٛشر نرم گژھان۔
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well also softens their sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: میٲنۍ گونگورا پچّڑی کیازِ چھےٚ ٹیوٚتھ؟
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: عام طور زیادٕ میٚتھۍ ژٕھنَنہٕ سٟتۍ، یا میٚتھۍ واریاہ گاڑھ بُزنہٕ سٟتۍ۔ یہ تھٲوِو صرف ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تہٕ اَکھ درجہٕ گاڑھ گژھتے کٔرِو بُزُن بنٛد۔
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually from adding too much fenugreek, or from roasting fenugreek too dark. Keep it only ¼ teaspoon and as soon as it becomes one shade darker stop roasting.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.t: گونگورا پچّڑی کوٚتاہ کال ٹِکان چھےٚ؟
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How long does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: ہۄکھِس شیشہٕ جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز تقریباً 2 ہفتہٕ، اگر پَنہٕ جان پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھنٲوِتھ آسن تہٕ تۄہۍ ہمیشہ ہۄکھ چَمچ ورتاوِو۔ فرجہٕ نیبر کھیٚیِو یہ 2–3 دۄہن اندر۔
seg.693b158b80df.back: In a dry glass jar in the fridge about 2 weeks, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge eat it within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: گونگورا پچّڑی۔ گنٹور طریقٕچ گونگورا پچّڑی: پَنہٕ بُزِتھ، بُزمٕتین مسالن، رۄہن تہٕ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ پیٖہِتھ، پتہٕ تڑکہٕ دِتھ۔ 6 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: Gongura Pachadi. Guntur-way gongura pachadi: leaves fried, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.0f19ba49c232.t: گونگورا پچّڑی (آندھرا گونگورا پَنَن ہٕنز چٹنی) · 1acrefarms

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: گونگورا پچّڑی: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: کوڈی گُڈّو پُلوسو ⟦1⟧(اِملی گریوی منٛز آندھرا ٹھۄلٕ سالن)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: کوڈی گُڈّو پُلوسو چھُ آندھرا ہُند سُہ ٹھۄلٕ سالن یُس واریاہ گرٕ تیلہِ بناوان چھِ یُتھ گرس منٛز ماز آسہِ نہٕ: سَخ اُبلٲوِتھ ٹھۄل اِملی تہٕ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ بُزمٕتین گنڈن ہٕنزِ ترٛش گریوی منٛز رَنِتھ۔ یہ چھُ شمالی ہِندوستانُک ٹھۄلٕ سالنٕ کھۄتہٕ پتلہٕ تہٕ زیادٕ ترٛش، تہٕ واریاہس گرم بَتس منٛز رَلٲوِتھ کھیٚنہٕ خٲطرٕ بنان۔
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is that Andhra egg curry which many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs cooked in a sour gravy of tamarind and onions fried on low flame. It is thinner and more sour than north India's egg curry, and is made for eating mixed into plenty of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: سون سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ پُلوسوس وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ اَکھ برابر درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان، تہٕ سون لیدُر پوڈر (پسوپو) چھُ سونہٕ رنگٕچ بُنیاد دِوان۔ ذرا گُڑ چھُ ترٛشرِ ہُند توازن بناوان۔
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and an even medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: ٹھۄل اُبلٲوِو تہٕ تِمن کٔرِو چیر۔ گنڈٕ بُزِو، ژٕھنِو لیدُر، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ اِملی آب، لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو، پتہٕ رَنِو ٹھۄل گریوی منٛز یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ گژھِ۔
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and make slits on them. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, cook on low flame, then cook the eggs in the gravy until it becomes thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: اَکھ چُٹکی لیدُر پوڈر ⟦1⟧ٹھۄل ترٛاونہٕ خٲطرٕ (یژھِو تیٚلہِ)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: One pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (if you want)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g اِملی ⟦1⟧لیمبہٕ ہیوٗ گولہٕ، 1½ کپ ووشنِس آبس منٛز بِگرٲوِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-like ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل ⟦1⟧مۄنگ پھلی یا تِلہٕ تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر؛ کم ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for less heat take 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.654942936ff6.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گُڑ ⟦1⟧یژھِو تیٚلہِ⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: اِملی بِگرٲوِو ووشنِس آبس منٛز 15 مِنَٹ۔ جان پٲٹھۍ مَلِو، چھٲنِو تہٕ اِملی آب تھٲوِو؛ ریشہٕ تہٕ بیول ترٲوِو۔
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak tamarind in lukewarm water 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: ٹھۄل اُبلٲوِو 10 مِنَٹ، تِمن کڈِو پوٚست تہٕ پرٛتھ اَکِس پیٹھ کٔرِو 3–4 ہلکۍ چیر۔ یِم تھٲوِو کمرٕچ حرارتٕچ آبس منٛز تہٕ شروٗع کٔرِو، گرٛکنہٕ پیٹھہٕ گٔنِو 10 مِنَٹ، پتہٕ پوٚست کڈنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو یِم آبس منٛز شیہُل۔ زرٕد گژھِ اندرٕ تام سَخ تہٕ ہلکہٕ پیٖلہِ رنگُک آسُن۔
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 light cuts on each one. Keep them in room-temperature water and start; count 10 minutes from the boil, then before peeling make them cold in water. The yolk should be firm all the way inside and light yellow in colour.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: یژھِو تیٚلہِ: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیل کٔرِو چُٹکی لیدرس سٟتۍ گرم تہٕ ٹھۄل پھیرِو اَتھ منٛز 2 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام تِمن پیٹھ ہلکۍ چھالہٕ پیٚن۔ الگ تھٲوِو۔
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: If you want: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and turn the eggs in it 2 minutes until light blisters form on them. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: باقی تیل کٔرِو کڑاہس منٛز درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ گرم۔ ژٕھنِو میٚتھۍ دانہٕ تہٕ دِیِو ہلکہٕ بھورٕ گژھنہٕ؛ گاڑھ گژھن تیٚلہِ چھِ ٹیوٚتھ گژھان۔
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in a kadai on medium flame. Add fenugreek seeds and let them become light brown; if they become dark they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: سٔریوٚم، کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ گنڈٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم نرم تہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن۔ گوڈٕ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ دِیِو چٹخنہٕ، پتہٕ کڑی پتہٕ، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ یَنٛگ، پتہٕ گنڈٕ تقریباً 8 مِنَٹن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in oil until they become soft and golden. First add mustard seeds and let crackle, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then onions for about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: نار کٔرِو لوٚت۔ ژٕھنِو لیدُر، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن، پتہٕ اِملی آب؛ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو 10 مِنَٹ۔ دَنِوالٕ پوڈر رَلٲوِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ تاکہ یہ گوڈٕ کیٛنژن سیکنڈن بُزِتھ گژھِ۔
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Make the flame low. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then tamarind water; cook 10 minutes on low flame. Mix coriander powder with the chilli powder so it gets fried for the first few seconds.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: اِملی ہٕنز کٔچ بوے گژھِ ختم گژھٕنۍ تہٕ گریوی گژھِ چمکدار باسٕنۍ۔ اگر یہ جلدی گاڑھ گژھِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ½ کپ آب۔
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of the tamarind should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. If it becomes thick quickly, then add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: ٹھۄل ژٕھنِو آہستہٕ تہٕ رَنِو 5 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام گریوی گاڑھ گژھِ۔ وَقتہٕ وَقتہٕ ژٕھنِو ٹھۄلَن پیٹھ گریوی۔
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Add the eggs gently and cook 5 minutes more on low flame until the gravy becomes thick. From time to time pour gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: ژٕھنِو گُڑ، مزٕ وُچھِتھ کٔرِو نوٗن یا ترٛشر ٹھیک، تہٕ ژٕھکِو دَنِوال۔
seg.299781c49104.back: Add jaggery, after tasting correct salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو پُلوسو 10 مِنَٹ تاکہ ٹھۄلَن منٛز گریوی ہُند مزٕ یِیہِ۔
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the flame and before serving keep the pulusu 10 minutes so the gravy's flavour comes into the eggs.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: چیرو سٟتۍ چھےٚ ترٛش گریوی ٹھۄلَن اندر گژھان۔
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Through the slits the sour gravy goes inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: اُبلٲمٕتۍ ٹھۄل کٔرِو چھٔلنہٕ برونٛہہ آبس منٛز شیہُل؛ چھۄکھ چھِ صاف وَسان۔
seg.98394356bb39.back: Before peeling make boiled eggs cool in water; the shells come off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پُلوسو خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو اَمہِ سٟتۍ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہِ۔
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu also add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: پُلوسو چھُ تھاونہٕ پتہٕ زیادٕ مزٕدار باسان، تہٕ دۆیمہِ دۄہہ بیٚیہِ زیادٕ، کیازِ ٹھۄل چھِ اِملی ہُند مزٕ رَچاوان۔
seg.fc1643db807e.back: Pulusu tastes tastier after keeping, and even more the next day, because the eggs soak up the tamarind flavour.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: ٹماٹر: گنڈن پتہٕ ژٕھنِو 1 ژٹِتھ ٹماٹر؛ گریوی بنِ نرم تہٕ کم ترٛش۔
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: after the onions add 1 chopped tomato; the gravy will become softer and less sour.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: تِل: آخری 5 مِنَٹن منٛز رَلٲوِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ بُزمٕتین تِلن ہُند پوڈر؛ گریوی بنِ گاڑھ تہٕ سوندھ۔
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: in the last 5 minutes mix in 1 tablespoon powder of roasted sesame; the gravy will become thick and nutty.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: مامیڈیکایا: گرٛیٖشمس منٛز اَڈٕ اِملی بدلہٕ رَنِو کٔچہِ اَمبہٕ چِہ کیٛنہہ ٹُکرٕ گریوی منٛز۔
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer instead of half the tamarind cook some pieces of raw mango in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بَتس تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، سٟتۍ کانٛہہ کرکرٕ ترٛٲوِتھ چیز یا اپّڈالو۔ یہ چھُ چپاتی یا ڈوسا سٟتۍ تہِ چلان۔
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, with it some crispy fried thing or appadalu. It also goes with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: بچمُت سالن تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ پُلوسو کٔرِو پینس منٛز ذرا آب ژٕھنِتھ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ گرم۔
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan adding a little water on low flame.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: ٹھۄلٕ سالنٕ خٲطرٕ کوٚتاہ کال اُبلاوَو ٹھۄل؟
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long do we boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: آب گرٛکنہٕ وقتہٕ پیٹھہٕ تقریباً 10 مِنَٹ۔ گریوی منٛز ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ گژھِ زرٕد اندرٕ تام سَخ تہٕ ہلکہٕ پیٖلہِ رنگُک آسُن، منٛزس منٛز پوٚن نہٕ۔
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. Before adding to the gravy the yolk should be firm to the inside and light yellow, not liquid in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: پُلوسو خٲطرٕ کیازِ چھِ ٹھۄلَن پیٹھ چیر کران؟
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made on eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: ہلکین چیرن سٟتۍ چھےٚ اِملی گریوی ٹھۄلٕکِس سفید حصس منٛز رَچان۔ یِمن ورٲے چھےٚ گریوی پیٹھے روزان تہٕ ٹھۄلُک مزٕ چھُ پھیکہٕ باسان۔
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: With light slits the tamarind gravy soaks into the white part of the egg. Without them the gravy stays on top and the egg's taste seems bland.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.t: پُلوسوٕچ ترٛشر کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کم کرَو؟
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How do we reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: یہ رَنِو کیٛنہہ مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، ژٕھنِو اَکھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گُڑ، یا رَلٲوِو ذرا آب۔ بیٚیِہ لٹہٕ ہیٚیِو اِملی ہُند لۄکٕٹ گولہٕ۔
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Cook it some minutes more on low flame, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time take a small ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: ٹھۄلٕ پُلوسو تہٕ ٹھۄلٕ سالنس منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: پُلوسو چھےٚ پتلہٕ، ترٛش اِملی گریوی یۄسہٕ بَتس منٛز رَلاونہٕ خٲطرٕ بنان چھےٚ۔ عام ٹھۄلٕ سالن چھُ زیادٕ تر گنڈٕ تہٕ ٹماٹرس پیٹھ بنان، اَتھ منٛز چھےٚ نہٕ اِملی آسان تہٕ مسالہٕ چھُ گاڑھ آسان۔
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy which is made for mixing in rice. Ordinary egg curry is mostly made on onion and tomato, it does not have tamarind and the masala is thick.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: کوڈی گُڈّو پُلوسو · ٹھۄلٕ پُلوسو ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: کوڈی گُڈّو پُلوسو۔ کوڈی گُڈّو پُلوسو، آندھرا ٹھۄلٕ سالن: اُبلٲمٕتۍ ٹھۄل اِملی تہٕ گنڈٕ ترٛش گریوی منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِتھ، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ لیدرس سٟتۍ رنگ دِتھ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs cooked on low flame in tamarind and onion sour gravy, coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: گُتّی ونکایا کورا ⟦1⟧(آندھرا بٔرِتھ وانٛگنَن ہُند سالن)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: گُتّی ونکایا کورا چھُ بٔرِتھ وانٛگنَن ہُند سُہ سالن یُس آندھرا کیٚن گرَن منٛز آتھوارِ کِس کھیٚنس، خاندرن تہٕ مہمان یِنہٕ وِزِ بنان چھُ۔ لۄکٕٹۍ، گول، وۄزٕل-نیٖلۍ وانٛگن چیرِتھ چھِ بُزمٕژ مۄنگ پھلی، تِل تہٕ نارجیٖلٕ مسالس سٟتۍ بٔرِتھ، تہٕ تیلس منٛز آہستہٕ آہستہٕ رَنَنہٕ یِوان یوٗت تام یِم نرم گژھن تہٕ مسالہٕ تِمن سٟتۍ لٲگِتھ روزِ۔
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya kura is that stuffed brinjal curry which is made in Andhra homes for Sunday's meal, weddings and when guests come. Small, round, red-blue (purple) brinjals are slit and filled with roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they become soft and the masala stays stuck to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: سون سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ بٔرنس وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان، تہٕ لیدُر پوڈر چھُ مزٕ پورٕ کران۔ یہ کٔرِو گرم بَتس یا چپاتی سٟتۍ پیش۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes the flavour. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: مۄنگ پھلی، تِل، ہۄکھ نارجیٖل تہٕ دَنِوالٕ بیول بُزِو، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ پیٖہِو، لۄکٕٹۍ وانٛگن بٔرِو تہٕ تیلس منٛز آہستہٕ آہستہٕ رَنِو یوٗت تام یِم نرم گژھن۔
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnut, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff the small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until they become soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ مۄنگ پھلی ⟦1⟧کٔچ، چھۄکلہٕ سان یا ورٲے⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with skin or without⟦/1⟧

seg.8be0f88d515d.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت ہۄکھ نارجیٖل ⟦1⟧کھوپرا⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ سالنٕ خٲطرٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تام⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 لۄکٕٹۍ وانٛگن ⟦1⟧تقریباً 500 g، لۄکٕٹۍ گول وۄزٕل-نیٖلۍ⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ دَنِوال ⟦1⟧ژٹِتھ، آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنَنہٕ خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: مۄنگ پھلی، تِل، نارجیٖل تہٕ دَنِوالٕ بیول بُزِو تیلہٕ ورٲے؛ مسالن سٟتۍ پیٖہِو۔ گوڈٕ بُزِو مۄنگ پھلی درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ 3–4 مِنَٹ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو دَنِوالٕ بیول، زیٖرٕ تہٕ تِل 1 مِنَٹس خٲطرٕ، تہٕ آخری 30 سیکنڈن منٛز نارجیٖل، یوٗت تام یہ ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگُک گژھِ۔ شیہُل گژھنہٕ دِیِو۔
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds without oil; grind with the spices. First roast groundnuts on less than medium flame 3–4 minutes, then add coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and in the last 30 seconds coconut, until it becomes light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: مکسرس منٛز پیٖہِو بُزمُت مسالہٕ رۄہن، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر، نوٗن تہٕ اِملی سٟتۍ آبہٕ ورٲے موٹہٕ پوڈرس منٛز۔ دبٲوِتھ گژھِ یہ جُڑِتھ گولہٕ بنُن۔
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In the mixer grind the roasted masala with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without water into a coarse powder. On pressing it should stick together into a ball.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: وانٛگن چھٔلِو تہٕ سبز ٹوپی ہُند حصہٕ کٔرِو ذرا ژٹِتھ، ڈٕنٛڈ تھٲوِو۔
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and cut a little of the green cap part, keep the stalk.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: پرٛتھ وانٛگُن چیرِو تلہٕ کِنہِ کراسہٕ پٲٹھۍ، ڈٕنٛڈ تھٲوِتھ، تہٕ اَتھ منٛز بٔرِو مسالہٕ۔ ژورن حصن منٛزٕ تقریباً ترٛےٚ حصہٕ پیٹھ تام ژٹِو تاکہ ژوٗرَوے حصہٕ پیٹھہٕ جُڑِتھ روزن۔ پرٛتھ اَکھ ژٹتے ژٕھنِو نوٗنہٕ آبٕکِس پیالس منٛز، پتہٕ آب کڈِو۔
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Cut each brinjal crosswise from the bottom, keeping the stem, and fill masala into it. Cut up to about three of the four parts so that all four parts stay joined at the top. As you cut each one put it into a bowl of salt water, then take out the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: پرٛتھ وانٛگنس منٛز بٔرِو دبٲوِتھ تقریباً 1 بٔرِتھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مسالہٕ۔ بچمُت مسالہٕ تھٲوِو الگ۔
seg.498fc880430b.back: In each brinjal fill, pressing, about 1 heaped teaspoon of masala. Keep the leftover masala aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: اَکِس کھۄلِس، گوٚب پینس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم۔ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ ییلہِ یہ چٹخِ، تیٚلہِ کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ گنڈٕ۔ گنڈٕ بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ نرم گژھِ، تقریباً 3 مِنَٹ۔
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: In a wide, heavy pan heat oil on medium flame. Add mustard seeds and when they crackle, then curry leaves and, if you are using, onion. Fry onion until it becomes soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: بٔرِتھ وانٛگن تھٲوِو پینس منٛز اَکِس تہس منٛز۔
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in one layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: وانٛگن رَنِو گرم تیلس منٛز ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، پرٛتھ 4–5 مِنَٹن پتہٕ آہستہٕ پھیرِتھ۔ چَمچ یا چِمٹہٕ ورتٲوِو تاکہ مسالہٕ اندر روزِ، تہٕ رَنِو 15–18 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام چھۄکلس پیٹھ وٕلۍ پیٚن۔
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in hot oil with lid on low flame, turning gently after every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the masala stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes, until wrinkles form on the skin.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: بچمُت مسالہٕ ژٕھنِو ½ کپ آبس سٟتۍ؛ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ رَنِو یوٗت تام وانٛگن نرم گژھن۔ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ رَنِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ 8–10 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ، یوٗت تام مسالہٕ گاڑھ گژھِ تہٕ کنارَن پیٹھ تیل باسہِ۔
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the leftover masala with ½ cup water; cook on low flame until the brinjals become soft. With lid cook on low flame 8–10 minutes more, until the masala becomes thick and oil appears on the edges.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: وُچھِو زِ رٔنِتھ چھِ: سارِوے کھۄتہٕ موٹِس وانٛگنس منٛز گژھِ ژُھرۍ رُکاوٹہٕ ورٲے اندر گژھٕنۍ۔ ژٕھکِو دَنِوال تہٕ نار کٔرِو بنٛد۔
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check that they are cooked: in the thickest brinjal a knife should go in without resistance. Sprinkle coriander and turn off the flame.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: ڈٕنٛڈ تھٲوِو تاکہ رَنَنہٕ تہٕ پھیرنہٕ وِزِ وانٛگن جُڑِتھ روزن۔
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stalk so that while cooking and turning the brinjals stay joined.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: اَکی سائزٕکۍ لۄکٕٹۍ، چمکدار وانٛگن ژارِو تاکہ یِم برابر رَنہٕ گژھن؛ بٔڈۍ وانٛگن چھِ منٛزس منٛز سَخ روزان۔
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of one size so they cook evenly; big brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: مۄنگ پھلی تہٕ تِل بُزِو درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ؛ زٔلمٕتۍ تِل چھِ سورُے مسالہٕ ٹیوٚتھ کران۔
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast groundnuts and sesame on less than medium flame; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: کم ٹیٚٹھ سالنٕ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تام۔
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry take 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: گنڈٕ مسالس سٟتۍ: 1 لۄکٕٹ گنڈٕ پیٖہِو مسالس منٛز؛ گریوی بنِ نرم تہٕ ذرا مۄدُر۔
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the masala; the gravy will become soft and slightly sweet.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: نارجیٖلہٕ ورٲے: نارجیٖل ترٲوِو تہٕ ہیٚیِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ مۄنگ پھلی تہٕ تِل زیادٕ۔
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and take 1 tablespoon more groundnut and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: گریوی وول طریقہٕ: بَتس منٛز رَلاونہٕ خٲطرٕ پتلہٕ سالنٕ خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو آخری قدمس منٛز ½ کپ بدلہٕ 1 کپ آب۔
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy style: for a thin curry for mixing in rice add in the last step 1 cup water instead of ½ cup.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بَتس تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، یا چپاتی یا جونّا روٹّے سٟتۍ۔
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ ذرا آب ژٕھنِتھ کٔرِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ گرم۔
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat on low flame adding a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: گُتّی ونکایا خٲطرٕ کم وانٛگن چھِ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان؟
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: ٹھۄلس ہِشۍ لۄکٕٹۍ، گول، وۄزٕل-نیٖلۍ وانٛگن، چمکدار چھۄکلہٕ تہٕ سبز ڈٕنٛڈہٕ سان۔ یِم چھِ تیوٗتس کالس منٛز اندرٕ تام رَنہٕ گژھان یوٗت مسالس لگان چھُ، تہٕ مسالہٕ چھِ جان پٲٹھۍ تھاوان۔
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-like small, round, purple brinjals, with shiny skin and green stalks. They get cooked to the inside in as much time as the masala takes, and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ پَتہٕ لگِ زِ وانٛگن چھِ رٔنِتھ؟
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know that the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: چھۄکلن پیٹھ چھِ وٕلۍ پیوان تہٕ یِم چھِ نرم گژھان، تہٕ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ موٹِس وانٛگنس منٛز چھےٚ ژُھرۍ رُکاوٹہٕ ورٲے اندر گژھان۔ کم رٔنِتھ وانٛگن چھِ منٛزس منٛز سَخ تہٕ اسپنجہٕ ہِشۍ باسان۔
seg.c65656faa952.back: Wrinkles form on the skins and they become soft, and in the thickest brinjal a knife goes in without resistance. Undercooked brinjals seem hard and sponge-like in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: کیا گُتّی ونکایا ہیٚکہٕ نارجیٖلہٕ ورٲے بٔنِتھ؟
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can gutti vankaya be made without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: آ۔ نارجیٖلٕ بدلہٕ ہیٚیِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ مۄنگ پھلی تہٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تِل زیادٕ؛ مسالُک مزٕ آسہِ زیادٕ سوندھ۔
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut take 1 tablespoon groundnut and 1 tablespoon sesame more; the masala's taste will be more nutty.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: ڈٕنٛڈ آسُس کڈنہٕ آمُت یا کراسہٕ چیر آسہِ پورٕ آر پار ژٹنہٕ آمُت۔ ڈٕنٛڈ تھٲوِو، چیر روٗکِو پیٹھہٕ تقریباً ژورِم حصہٕ برونٛہہ تہٕ آہستہٕ پھیرِو۔
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stalk had been removed or the cross slit had been cut fully through. Keep the stalk, stop the slit about one fourth before the top and turn gently.

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: گُتّی ونکایا کورا۔ بُزمٕژ مۄنگ پھلی، تِل تہٕ نارجیٖلہٕ سٟتۍ بٔرِتھ لۄکٕٹۍ وانٛگن، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس سٟتۍ پیٖہِتھ، پتہٕ تیلس منٛز آہستہٕ آہستہٕ رَنِتھ۔
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked slowly in oil.

seg.6338aa32f352.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت ہۄکھ نارجیٖل

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: جیڈی پپّو پکوڑی چھُ سُہ کاجو پکوڑا یُس آندھرا کیٚن مِٹھٲیہِ دُکانن تہٕ گرَن منٛز چاے وَقتہٕ، تہوارن تہٕ مہمانن خٲطرٕ ترٛاوان چھِ: سالِم کاجو بیسن تہٕ تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ کہِ پتلہِ، مسالہٕ دار تہس منٛز، کرکرٕ گژھنہٕ تام ترٛٲوِتھ۔ گنڈہٕ ورٲے بنان چھُ، تَوے چھُ جارس منٛز کیٚنژن دۄہن ٹِکان، تہٕ واریاہ گرٕ چھِ دیوالی تہٕ سنکرانتی کیٚن مہمانن خٲطرٕ اَکھ کھیپ ترٛٲوِتھ تھاوان۔
seg.111c74722b7d.back: JD pappu pakodi is that cashew pakora which Andhra sweet shops and homes fry at tea time, for festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced layer of gram flour and rice flour, fried until crisp. It is made without onion, so it keeps in a jar some days, and many homes fry a batch and keep it for Diwali and Sankranti guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: سانہِ جیڈی پپّو پیکٕکۍ سالِم کاجو چھِ تہس اندر کرکرٕ روزان، تہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر تہٕ ہلکہٕ وۄزُل رنگ دِوان۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews of our JD Pappu pack stay crunchy inside the layer, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and light red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھِ پکوڑی شیہُل تہٕ کرکرٕ گژھنٕکۍ 5 مِنَٹ شامِل۔
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: Total time includes 5 minutes of the pakodi becoming cool and crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: سالِم کاجو رَلٲوِو بیسن، تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، نوٗن تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گرم تیلس سٟتۍ، صرف تیوٗت آب ژٕھکِو یوٗت تہہ لگِ، تہٕ ترٛٲوِو یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ کرکرٕ گژھن۔
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with gram flour, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle only as much water as the layer sticks, and fry until they become golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 کپ سالِم کاجو ⟦1⟧تقریباً 150 g؛ واریاہ بٔڈۍ کاجو کٔرِو اَڈٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; halve very big cashews⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ کپ بیسن ⟦1⟧چنہٕ اٹہٕ، تقریباً 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup gram flour ⟦1⟧chickpea flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ ⟦1⟧زیادٕ کرکرٕ تہہ خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper layer⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پکوڑی خٲطرٕ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ بیٚیہِ⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for hotter pakodi ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن ⟦1⟧یا مزٕ وُچھِتھ⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ گرم تیل ⟦1⟧ترٛاونہٕ وٲلِس تیلس منٛزٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: ترٛاونہٕ خٲطرٕ تیل ⟦1⟧عام طور مۄنگ پھلی تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: کاجو چھٔلِو تہٕ آب کڈِو جان پٲٹھۍ؛ ذرا نَمی چھےٚ اٹہٕ لگنس منٛز مدد کران۔
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain the water well; a little moisture helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ ترٛاونہٕ خٲطرٕ تیل گرم۔
seg.0d03259dc451.back: In a kadai heat oil for frying on medium flame.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: رَلٲوِو بیسن، تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، نوٗن، اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ۔ کھۄلہٕ پیالہٕ ورتٲوِو، تہٕ تَمی وقتہٕ ژٕھنِو سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، دَنِوال تہٕ یَنٛگ تہِ۔
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix gram flour, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at that same time also add green chillies, coriander and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ گرم تیل مَلِو، ژٕھنِو کاجو تہٕ آب ژٕھکِو یوٗت تام اٹہٕ صرف تِمن پیٹھ لگِ۔ کڑاہہٕ منٛزٕ گرم تیل ہیٚیِو دِھیان سان چَمچس منٛز تہٕ گوڈٕ مَلِو یہ اوٚنگجین ہٕندین سرن سٟتۍ اٹہٕ مکسچرس منٛز، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو کاجو تہٕ ژٕھکِو آب 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ کٔرِتھ، ہِلٲوان، یوٗت تام پرٛتھ کاجوس پیٹھ اٹہٕ لگِ۔ مکسچر گژھِ نَم بُھربُھرین ٹُکرن ہیوٗ باسُن، گھولہٕ ہیوٗ نہٕ۔
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub 1 tablespoon hot oil, add cashews and sprinkle water until the flour only sticks on them. Take hot oil from the kadai carefully in a spoon and first rub it with the fingertips into the flour mixture, then add cashews and sprinkle water 1 tablespoon at a time, tossing, until flour sticks on every cashew. The mixture should seem like damp crumbly pieces, not like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: تیل وُچھِو: مکسچرٕچ اَکھ چُٹکی ژٕھنَنہٕ سٟتۍ گژھِ 2–3 سیکنڈن منٛز برابر بلبلن سٟتۍ پیٹھ یِنۍ۔ اگر یہ فوراً بھورٕ گژھِ، تیٚلہِ چھُ تیل واریاہ گرم۔
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: on adding a pinch of the mixture it should come up within 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it becomes brown at once, then the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: درمیانہٕ گرم تیلس منٛز ژٕھنِو لۄکٕٹۍ گُچھہٕ۔ اَکہِ لٹہٕ تُلِو 3–4 تہہ لٲگِتھ کاجو اوٚنگجین سٟتۍ تہٕ دِیِو تِمن ڈٲلۍ پٲٹھۍ تیلس منٛز پیٚنہٕ، کڑاہس منٛز بیٖڑ کٔرِو نہٕ۔
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Add small clusters to medium-hot oil. At one time lift 3–4 coated cashews with the fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, don't crowd the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: پھیرٲوان ترٛٲوِو یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ کرکرٕ گژھن، 5–6 مِنَٹ؛ کاغذس پیٹھ کڈِو۔ تیار گژھنہٕ وِزِ چھِ پکوڑی ہٕندۍ بلبلہٕ لۄکٕٹۍ تہٕ آہستہٕ گژھان۔
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Turning, fry until they become golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; take out on paper. When ready the bubbles of the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: باقی تہِ ترٛٲوِو تِتھے پٲٹھۍ کھیپن منٛز، پرٛتھ کھیپہِ درمیان دِیِو تیل دوبارٕ گرم گژھنہٕ۔
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest also the same way in batches, between every batch let the oil become hot again.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: پکوڑی تھٲوِو کاغذس پیٹھ 5 مِنَٹ؛ شیہُل گژھنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ یہ بیٚیہِ کرکرٕ گژھان۔ یژھِو تیٚلہِ ژٕھکِو پیٹھہٕ اَکھ چُٹکی نوٗن یا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.8ab193492427.back: Keep the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; on cooling it becomes even crisper. If you want sprinkle on top a pinch of salt or chilli powder.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: مکسچر تھٲوِو گاڑھ تہٕ ہۄکھ، پتلہٕ نہٕ، نَتہٕ چھےٚ پکوڑی نرم گژھان۔
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the mixture thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi becomes soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ ترٛٲوِو: کاجو چھِ جلدی بھورٕ گژھان، تہٕ تیز نارس پیٹھ چھُ اندرٕ کاجو بُزنہٕ برونٛہہ تہُک رنگ بدلان۔
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium flame: cashews brown quickly, and on high flame the colour of the coating changes before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: اٹس منٛز مَلنہٕ آمُت اَکھ چَمچ گرم تیل چھُ پکوڑی ہلکہٕ تہٕ کرکرٕ بناوان۔
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر تہٕ جان وۄزُل رنگ دِوان؛ شُرین خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ۔
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and good red colour; for children take ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ: اَڈٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر بدلٲوِو تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ سٟتۍ، یُس واریاہ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ چھُ۔
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: گنڈٕ سٟتۍ: کاجون سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو 1 لۄکٕٹ، پتلۍ ژٹِتھ گنڈٕ؛ پکوڑی بنِ نرم تہٕ زیادٕ مۄدُر، تہٕ کھیٚیِو یہ تَمیُے دۄہ۔
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: with the cashews add 1 small, thinly chopped onion; the pakodi will become soft and sweeter, and eat it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: پۄدنہٕ: دَنِوالس سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ ژٹِتھ پۄدنہٕ۔
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: with the coriander add 2 tablespoons chopped mint.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم شامٕچ چاے یا فلٹر کافی سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھےٚ لنچ باکسس منٛز یا بتہٕ تہٕ پپّوٕچ کھیٚنہٕ سٟتۍ تہِ چلان۔
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve hot with evening tea or filter coffee. It also goes in a lunch box or with a meal of rice and pappu.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھنہٕ پتہٕ تھٲوِو یہ ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تہٕ کھیٚیِو 4–5 دۄہن اندر۔ اگر یہ نرم گژھِ، تیٚلہِ کٔرِو یہ ہۄکھِس پینس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ 2–3 مِنَٹ گرم۔
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling completely keep it in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If it becomes soft, then heat it in a dry pan on low flame 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: میٲنۍ کاجو پکوڑی کیازِ گیہِ نرم؟
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: اٹس منٛز زیادٕ آب، یا لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ترٛاوُن۔ مکسچر تھٲوِو نَم بُھربُھرین ٹُکرن ہیوٗ تہٕ ترٛٲوِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام بلبلہٕ آہستہٕ گژھن۔
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low flame. Keep the mixture like damp crumbly pieces and fry on medium flame until the bubbles become slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: کیا پکوڑی بناونہٕ برونٛہہ گژھن کاجو بِگرٲوِنۍ؟
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: بِگراونٕچ ضرورت چھےٚ نہٕ۔ اٹہٕ لگاونہٕ خٲطرٕ چھُ ہلکہٕ چھٔلُن کٲفی؛ ڈیر کال بِگرٲمٕتۍ کاجو چھِ پنُن کیٛنہہ کرکرٕ پن ضایع کران۔
seg.e6e487728264.back: There is no need to soak. For making the flour stick a light wash is enough; cashews soaked long lose some of their crunch.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: کیا کاجو پکوڑی ہیٚکہٕ تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ ورٲے بٔنِتھ؟
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can cashew pakodi be made without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: آ۔ ہیٚیِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ بیسن زیادٕ، یا 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ کارن فلور۔ تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ چھُ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ کرکرٕ تہہ دِوان، تَوے آسہِ پکوڑی اَمہِ ورٲے ذرا نرم۔
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Take 2 tablespoons more gram flour, or 1 tablespoon corn flour. Rice flour gives the crispest layer, so without it the pakodi will be a little soft.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: کاجو پکوڑی کوٚتاہ کال چھےٚ کرکرٕ روزان؟
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز تقریباً 4–5 دۄہ، شرط چھےٚ زِ جارس منٛز ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ گژھِ یہ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھٕنۍ۔
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: In an airtight jar about 4–5 days, the condition is that before putting in the jar it should become completely cool.

seg.60df05d4b9d3.t: جیڈی پپّو پکوڑی · کاجو پکوڑی ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.60df05d4b9d3.back: JD Pappu Pakodi · Cashew pakodi recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
