seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: جیڈی پپّو پکوڑی۔ سانہِ جیڈی پپّو پیکٕکین سالِم کاجون، بیسن، تومُلہٕ اٹہٕ تہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ سٟتۍ بنیمٕژ کرکرٕ کاجو پکوڑی۔ قدم بہ قدم طریقہٕ، مشورٕ تہٕ سوال۔
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: JD Pappu Pakodi. Crisp cashew pakodi made with whole cashews of our JD Pappu pack, gram flour, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and questions.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: جیڈی پپّو پکوڑی: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: JD Pappu Pakodi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.c8d3511fd71e.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر

seg.f99e3a7cfd38.t: جیڈی پپّو اُپما ⟦1⟧(کاجو وول سوجی اُپما)⟦/1⟧
seg.f99e3a7cfd38.back: JD Pappu Upma ⟦1⟧(semolina upma with cashews)⟦/1⟧

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: اُپما چھُ آندھرا ہُند پرٛتھ دۄہُک ناشتہٕ: سوجی، گنڈٕ، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتن ہٕندِس تڑکہٕ آبس منٛز نرم رَنِتھ۔ جیڈی پپّو اُپما چھُ اَمیُک سجٲوِتھ روپ، یَتھ منٛز اَکھ مُٹھ کاجو گیٖوَس منٛز سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ ترٛاونہٕ یِوان چھِ، یِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ مہمانن خٲطرٕ، تہوارٕچ صُبحِ تہٕ خاندرن منٛز بنان چھُ، اکثر پیسرٹّو سٟتۍ یا اَکِس چَمچہٕ چیٖنی سٟتۍ پیش کرنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's every-day breakfast: semolina cooked soft in tempered water of onion, green chillies and curry leaves. JD pappu upma is its decorated form, in which a fistful of cashews is fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, festival mornings and weddings, often served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: سانہِ جیڈی پپّو کاجو چھِ سالِم تہٕ سادٕ، تَوے چھِ یِم برابر ترٛاونہٕ یِوان تہٕ نرم سوجی سٟتۍ کرکرٕ روزان۔ یہ چھُ تقریباً 25 مِنَٹن منٛز تیار گژھان۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 3 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our JD Pappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy with the soft semolina. It becomes ready in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: سوجی بُزِو، کاجو ترٛٲوِو گیٖوَس منٛز، پتہٕ تڑکہٕ دِتھ کٔرِو گنڈٕ تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن نرم۔ آب گرٛکٲوِو نوٗنس سٟتۍ، سوجی رَلٲوِو، ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو کاجو۔
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast semolina, fry cashews in ghee, then give tempering and make onion and chillies soft. Boil water with salt, mix semolina, put lid and at the end add cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 کپ بامبے روا ⟦1⟧درمیانہٕ سوجی، تقریباً 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ کپ آب ⟦1⟧سَخ اُپما خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 2 کپ⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for firm upma take 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ کپ کاجو ⟦1⟧سالِم یا اَڈٕ کٔرِتھ، تقریباً 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو ⟦1⟧یا 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل تہٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن ⟦1⟧منٛزٕ چیرِتھ؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ اُپما خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 3⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit in the middle; for hotter upma take 3⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: گنڈٕ، اَدرَک تہٕ دَنِوال ژٹِو، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن چیرِو، تہٕ آب مینِتھ تھٲوِو۔
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop onion, ginger and coriander, slit green chillies, and keep the water measured.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: سوجی بُزِو ہۄکھِس پینس منٛز یوٗت تام سوندھ خۄشبوے یِیہِ، تقریباً 5 مِنَٹ۔ رنگ تھٲوِو ہلکہٕ۔ درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو، پتہٕ کڈِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز۔
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast semolina in a dry pan until a nutty aroma comes, about 5 minutes. Keep the colour light. On less than medium flame keep stirring constantly, then take out on a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: اَکِس کھۄلِس، گوٚب پینس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ گیٖو گرم۔
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: In a wide, heavy pan heat ghee on less than medium flame.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: کاجو ترٛٲوِو گیٖوَس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن؛ کڈِو۔ اَتھ چھِ تقریباً 1–2 مِنَٹ لگان؛ گیٖو تھٲوِو پینس منٛزے۔
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry cashews in ghee until they become golden; take out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan itself.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: سٔریوٚم، دالن تہٕ کڑی پتن ہُند تڑکہٕ دِیِو۔ گنڈٕ تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن کٔرِو نرم، آب تہٕ نوٗن ژٕھنِو، تہٕ گرٛکٲوِو۔ کڑی پتہٕ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو سٔریوٚم چٹخنہٕ تہٕ دال ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھنہٕ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو گنڈس سٟتۍ اَدرَک تہٕ رَنِو 3–4 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام گنڈٕ نرم گژھِ۔
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Give a tempering of mustard seeds, dals and curry leaves. Make onion and chillies soft, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let mustard seeds crackle and dal become light golden, then add ginger with onion and cook 3–4 minutes until onion becomes soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: آب گرٛکنہٕ پتہٕ وُچھِو مزٕ؛ یہ گژھِ ذرا نوٗنہٕ وول باسُن، کیازِ سوجی ہیٚیِ نوٗن رَچٲوِتھ۔
seg.be01d433ae80.back: After the water boils taste; it should seem a little salty, because semolina will soak up salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: نار کٔرِو لوٚت۔ ہِلٲوان ژٕھنِو سوجی پتلہِ دارِ سٟتۍ۔ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ 3 مِنَٹ ڈَکُن تھٲوِو؛ پیٹھہٕ ژٕھنِو کاجو۔
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Make the flame low. Stirring, add semolina in a thin stream. On low flame keep lid 3 minutes; on top add cashews.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: کاجو ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ وُچھِو اُپما: سوجی گژھِ نرم آسٕنۍ، کانٛہہ سَخ دانہٕ نہٕ، تہٕ اُپما گژھِ پینٕکۍ کنارٕ ترٲوُن۔ اگر یہ وُنہِ دانہٕ دار آسہِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھکِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ گرم آب، ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ رَنِو 1 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ۔
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Before adding cashews check the upma: semolina should be soft, no hard grain, and upma should leave the edges of the pan. If it is still grainy, then sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, put lid and cook 1 minute more.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: زیادٕ تر کاجون سٟتۍ رَلٲوِو اَکھ چَمچ بیٚیہِ گیٖو تہٕ اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ دَنِوال۔
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: With most of the cashews mix one more spoon of ghee and, if you are using, coriander.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: گرم پیش کٔرِو، پیٹھہٕ باقی کاجو ژٕھنِتھ۔
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve hot, adding the remaining cashews on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: ہِلٲوان ژٕھنِو سوجی پتلہِ دارِ سٟتۍ تاکہ گُتھہٕ بنن نہٕ۔
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Stirring, add semolina in a thin stream so lumps don't form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: سوجی گوڈٕ بُزنہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ پرٛتھ دانہٕ الگ روزان؛ یہ ترٲوِو تہٕ اُپما چھُ چپچپہٕ گژھان۔
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting semolina first keeps every grain separate; leave this out and the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: کاجو ترٛٲوِو درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ تہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھتے کڈِو؛ گرم گیٖوَس منٛز چھِ یِم گاڑھ گژھان روزان۔
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry cashews on less than medium flame and take out as soon as golden; in hot ghee they keep becoming dark.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: اُپما چھُ تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ سَخ گژھان، تَوے وٲلِو یہ نارس پیٹھہٕ تیلہِ یُتھ یہ تۄہہِ یژھنہٕ کھۄتہٕ ذرا نرم آسہِ۔
seg.975560a8a158.back: Upma becomes firm by keeping, so take it off the flame when it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: سبزی اُپما: گنڈس سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو ½ کپ ژٹِتھ گازٕر، بینز تہٕ سبز مٔٹر تہٕ آب ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ رَنِو یِم 3–4 مِنَٹ۔
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with onion add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas and cook them 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: ٹماٹر اُپما: گنڈٕ پتہٕ ژٕھنِو 1 ژٹِتھ ٹماٹر تہٕ آب ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ رَنِو یوٗت تام یہ نرم گژھِ۔
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after onion add 1 chopped tomato and cook until it becomes soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: گودھوما روا اُپما: تیوٗتُے کَنکہٕ سوجی ہیٚیِو 3 کپ آبس سٟتۍ تہٕ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ رَنِو 5–6 مِنَٹ۔
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: take the same amount of wheat semolina with 3 cups water and cook with lid 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: ناشتس منٛز پیش کٔرِو گرم نارجیٖلٕ چٹنی، الّم پچّڑی یا اَکِس چَمچہٕ چیٖنی سٟتۍ، یا پیسرٹّو اُپما خٲطرٕ پیسرٹّو سٟتۍ۔
seg.01300d94ad36.back: For breakfast serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or with pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: اُپما چھُ بنٲوِتھے گرم کھیٚنہٕ سٟتۍ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان۔ بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز 1 دۄہس تام تہٕ دوبارٕ گرم کرنہٕ برونٛہہ ژٕھکِو آب۔
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten hot right after making. Keep leftover covered in the fridge up to 1 day and before reheating sprinkle water.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.t: اُپما کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو گُتھو ورٲے؟
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How do we make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: آب تھٲوِو گرٛکان، نار کٔرِو لوٚت تہٕ اَکِہ اَتھہٕ ژٕھنِو سوجی پتلہِ دارِ سٟتۍ تہٕ بیٚیِس اَتھس سٟتۍ ہِلٲوان روٗزِو۔
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, make the flame low and with one hand add semolina in a thin stream and with the other hand keep stirring.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: اُپما خٲطرٕ سوجی تہٕ آبُک ٹھیک تناسب کیا چھُ؟
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the correct ratio of semolina and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: نرم آندھرا طریقٕکِس اُپما خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 کپ بامبے روا خٲطرٕ 2½ کپ آب۔ سَخ تہٕ زیادٕ دانہٕ دار اُپما خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 2 کپ۔
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-way upma take 2½ cups water for 1 cup Bombay rava. For firm and more grainy upma take 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: سوجی آسہِ نہٕ بُزنہٕ آمٕژ، یا آسہِ زیادٕ آب ژٕھنَنہٕ آمُت۔ سوجی بُزِو یوٗت تام سوندھ خۄشبوے یِیہِ، تہٕ پرٛتھ کپس خٲطرٕ روٗزِو 2½ کپ آبس نزدیٖک۔
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The semolina was not roasted, or too much water was added. Roast semolina until a nutty aroma comes, and for every cup stay close to 2½ cups water.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When do we add cashews in upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: گوڈٕ ترٛٲوِو یِم گیٖوَس منٛز تہٕ کڈِو، پتہٕ رَلٲوِو یِم آخرس پیٹھ۔ گوڈے ژٕھنِو تیٚلہِ چھِ یِم اُپما منٛز نرم گژھان۔
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take out, then mix them in at the end. If you add them earlier they become soft in the upma.

seg.6cb14eaca16a.t: جیڈی پپّو اُپما · جیڈی پپّو اُپما ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.6cb14eaca16a.back: JD Pappu Upma · JD Pappu Upma recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: جیڈی پپّو اُپما۔ گیٖوَس منٛز سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ ترٛٲوِتھ جیڈی پپّو کاجون سٟتۍ آندھرا سوجی اُپما، صُبحُک نرم تہٕ جلدی بنن وول ناشتہٕ۔ قدم بہ قدم طریقہٕ، مشورٕ تہٕ سوال۔ 3 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.8b57b24af158.back: JD Pappu Upma. Andhra semolina upma with JD Pappu cashews fried golden in ghee, the morning's soft and quick-to-make breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and questions. For 3 people.

seg.5eecbe415597.t: جیڈی پپّو اُپما (کاجو وول سوجی اُپما) · 1acrefarms
seg.5eecbe415597.back: JD Pappu Upma (semolina upma with cashews) · 1acrefarms

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: جیڈی پپّو اُپما: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.661f01591624.back: JD Pappu Upma: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: کوڈی ویپُڈو چھُ آندھرا ہُند ہۄکھ کُکرٕ فرائی: کُکرٕکۍ لۄکٕٹۍ ٹُکرٕ پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز رَنِتھ، پتہٕ کڑی پتن، سبز مَرچن تہٕ وۄنۍ وۄنۍ بُزمٕتِس مسالس سٟتۍ تیلس منٛز تیز بُزِتھ یوٗت تام یِم گاڑھ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ مسالس سٟتۍ لٲگِتھ گژھن۔ یہ چھُ آندھرا کیٚن خاندرن منٛز اسٹارٹر تہٕ گرس منٛز رَسم بتس یا پپّوس سٟتۍ تھاونہٕ یِنہٕ وٲجِنۍ ڈِش۔
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juice, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and just-roasted masala until they become dark-coloured and stuck with masala. It is a starter in Andhra weddings and at home a dish kept with rasam rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: سون تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ اَتھ گاڑھ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ سۄ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان یَمہِ کِنہِ آندھرا کۍ فرائی مشہوٗر چھِ، سون لیدُر پوڈر چھُ میرینیڈس منٛز گژھان، تہٕ سٲنۍ سالِم کاجو گِری چھےٚ سونہٕ رنگٕچ ترٛٲوِتھ آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنَنہٕ یِوان۔ سٟتۍ کھیٚنہٕ وٲجِنہِ ڈِشہِ پٲٹھۍ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that heat for which Andhra's fries are famous, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels are fried golden and added at the end. As a side dish for 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: کُکُر مَلِو تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر، اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ تہٕ لیمبس سٟتۍ، رَنِو یہ پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز، پتہٕ بُزِو یہ ہۄکھ کڑی پتن، سبز مَرچن، بُزمٕتِس مسالس تہٕ کاجون سٟتۍ۔
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Rub the chicken with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juice, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے کُکُر ⟦1⟧1 اِنچ ٹُکرن منٛز ژٹِتھ؛ یا 600 g اَڈِج سان لۄکٕٹۍ ٹُکرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut in 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small pieces with bone⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 کاجو ⟦1⟧سالِم کاجو گِری؛ بٔڈۍ کاجو کٔرِو اَڈٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve big cashews⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: کُکُر کٔرِو کپڑس سٟتۍ تھپتھپٲوِتھ ہۄکھ تاکہ میرینیڈ لگِ۔
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: کُکُر مَلِو تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر، اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ، لیمبہٕ رَس تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ، 30 مِنَٹ۔ اَتھو سٟتۍ جان پٲٹھۍ رَلٲوِو تاکہ پرٛتھ ٹُکرس لگِ۔
seg.075327f4deca.back: Rub the chicken with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with the hands so it sticks to every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: تَمہِ دوران بُزِو دَنِوالٕ بیول، زیٖرٕ، بادیان، رۄنٛگ تہٕ دال چیٖنی اَکِس لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تیلہٕ ورٲے یوٗت تام خۄشبوے یِیہِ تہٕ اَکھ درجہٕ گاڑھ گژھن، تقریباً 2 مِنَٹ۔ شیہُل کٔرِتھ پیٖہِو موٹہٕ پوڈرس منٛز۔ یہ چھُ فرائی مسالہٕ۔
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low flame without oil until aroma comes and they become one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind into a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: کُکُر ژٕھنِو آبہٕ ورٲے اَکِس گوٚب کڑاہس منٛز، ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ تھٲوِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken without water in a heavy kadai, put lid and keep on medium flame.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: یہ رَنِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز یوٗت تام کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ، تقریباً 12 مِنَٹ۔ اَکھ زٕ لٹہٕ ہِلٲوِو؛ رَنَنہٕ وِزِ چھُ کُکُر آب ترٲوان۔
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook it with lid in its own juice until no pink colour remains, about 12 minutes. Stir one two times; while cooking the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: ڈَکُن تُلِو تہٕ تیز نارس پیٹھ ہِلٲوان رَنِو یوٗت تام آب تقریباً ہۄکھِ، 3–4 مِنَٹ۔ کُکُر کڈِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز تہٕ کڑاہ کٔرِو صاف۔
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Lift the lid and cook on high flame stirring until the water almost dries, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out on a plate and clean the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم۔
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: In the kadai heat oil on medium flame.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: کاجو ترٛٲوِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن؛ کڈِو۔ یِمن چھُ اَکِس مِنَٹس کھۄتہٕ کم لگان، تَوے برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو تہٕ چھانٕنی چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ کڈِو۔
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry cashews in oil until they become golden; take out. They take less than one minute, so keep stirring constantly and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو گنڈٕ تہٕ بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ سونہٕ رنگُک گژھِ۔ بُزِو سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ۔ ذرا پتھ کُن روٗزِو؛ پَنہٕ چھِ چٹخان تہٕ چھٹان۔
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If you are using, then add onion and fry until it becomes golden. Fry green chillies and curry leaves. Stand a little back; the leaves crackle and splash.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: ژٕھنِو کُکُر تہٕ فرائی مسالہٕ۔ تیز نارس پیٹھ بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ ہۄکھ تہٕ گاڑھ رنگُک گژھِ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو کاجو تہٕ اُچھلٲوِو۔ 6–8 مِنَٹ اُچھلٲوان روٗزِو، یوٗت تام مسالہٕ ٹُکرن سٟتۍ لگِ تہٕ کنارٕ گاڑھ تہٕ کرکرٕ گژھن۔
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add chicken and fry masala. Fry on high flame until it becomes dry and dark-coloured, then add cashews and toss. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: مزٕ وُچھِو، ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو نوٗن، دَنِوال ژٕھکِو تہٕ گرم پیش کٔرِو۔
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, if needed add salt, sprinkle coriander and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: آخرس پیٹھ بُزِو تیز نارس پیٹھ تاکہ مسالہٕ پرٛتھ ٹُکرس سٟتۍ لگِ۔
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high flame so the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ۔ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا اَمہِ بدلہٕ ورتٲوِو سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر؛ وۄزُل رنگ روزِ تہٕ ٹیٚٹھر آسہِ کم۔
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or instead use Sannam chilli powder; the red colour will stay and the heat will be less.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: ٹُکرٕ ژٹِو لۄکٕٹۍ تہٕ اَکی ہیوٗ تاکہ یِم اَکی وقتہٕ اندرٕ تام رَنہٕ گژھن تہٕ فرائی منٛز جان پٲٹھۍ کرکرٕ گژھن۔
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and alike so they get cooked to the inside at the same time and become nicely crisp in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: فرائی مسالہٕ پیٖہِو رَنَنہٕ برونٛہہ؛ بُزمٕتین مسالن ہٕنز خۄشبوے چھےٚ جانہِ ویپُڈو ہٕنز جان۔
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala before cooking; the aroma of the roasted spices is the soul of good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: اَڈِج سان: ہیٚیِو 600 g اَڈِج سان لۄکٕٹۍ ٹُکرٕ تہٕ رَنِو یِم پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز 18–20 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام اَڈِجہِ نِش کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ۔
seg.62d6684e446e.back: With bone: take 600 g small pieces with bone and cook them in their own juice 18–20 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: کوبّری ویپُڈو: مسالس سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو فرائی منٛز 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت ہۄکھ نارجیٖل تہٕ اُچھلٲوِو یوٗت تام یہ بھورٕ گژھِ۔
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: with the masala add to the fry 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut and toss until it becomes brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: مٹن ویپُڈو: 500 g اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے ماز رَنِو میرینیڈ تہٕ ½ کپ آبس سٟتۍ پریشرس منٛز 5–6 سیٖٹی تام، پتہٕ بُزِو یہ تِتھے پٲٹھۍ۔
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless meat with the marinade and ½ cup water in pressure up to 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم رَسم بتس، پپّو تہٕ بتس یا سامبر بتس سٟتۍ، یا اسٹارٹر پٲٹھۍ کُنہِ ژٹِتھ گنڈن تہٕ لیمبہٕ قاشن سٟتۍ۔
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or as a starter alone with chopped onions and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز 2 دۄہن تام۔ گرم پینس منٛز تیلٕکین کیٛنژن قطرن سٟتۍ کٔرِو یوٗت گرم زِ اندرٕ تام ٹٲرِ نیرِ؛ یہ چھُ دوبارٕ کرکرٕ گژھان۔
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keeping lid on keep in the fridge up to 2 days. In a hot pan with a few drops of oil heat so hot that steam comes out to the inside; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: آندھرا منٛز کُکرٕ فرائی تہٕ کُکرٕ سالنس منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.551573b4b443.back: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: ویپُڈو چھُ ہۄکھ: کُکُر چھُ پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز رَنَنہٕ یِوان، پتہٕ بُزنہٕ یِوان یوٗت تام مسالہٕ تَتھ پیٹھ لگِ تہٕ کانٛہہ گریوی روزِ نہٕ۔ کوڈی کورا چھُ سالن یَتھ منٛز بتہٕ خٲطرٕ گنڈٕ تہٕ ٹماٹرٕ گریوی آسان چھےٚ۔
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juice, then fried until the masala sticks on it and no gravy remains. Kodi kura is a curry in which there is onion and tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: ویپُڈو خٲطرٕ ہیٚیوٚ اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے کُکُر یا اَڈِج سان؟
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should we take boneless chicken or with bone for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: دۄنوَے چھِ چلان۔ اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے چھُ جلدی رَنہٕ گژھان تہٕ زیادٕ کرکرٕ بنان؛ اَڈِج سان لۄکٕٹین ٹُکرن منٛز چھُ مزٕ زیادٕ مگر پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز چھِ تقریباً 8 مِنَٹ زیادٕ لگان۔
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crisper; small pieces with bone have more flavour but take about 8 minutes more in their own juice.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: سارِوے کھۄتہٕ موٹ ٹُکرٕ ژٹِتھ وُچھِو۔ کُکُر چھُ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ منٛزس منٛز (یا اَڈِجہِ نِش) کانٛہہ گُلٲبی رنگ روزِ نہٕ تہٕ رَس صاف نیرِ۔
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut the thickest piece and look. The chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: کوڈی ویپُڈو کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How do we make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، یا اَمہِ بدلہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، تہٕ چیرِو صرف 2 سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن۔ کاجو تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ چھِ مزٕ بھرپور تھاوان۔
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or instead Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. Cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: کوڈی ویپُڈو · کوڈی ویپُڈو (آندھرا کُکرٕ فرائی) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: Kodi Vepudu · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: کوڈی ویپُڈو۔ آندھرا کُکرٕ فرائی: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس منٛز کُکُر، کڑی پتن، سبز مَرچن، بُزمٕتِس مسالس تہٕ سانہِ کاجون سٟتۍ ہۄکھ بُزِتھ۔
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: Kodi Vepudu. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: کوڈی ویپُڈو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: نِمّکایا پُلیہورا چھُ آندھرا کیٚن گرَن ہُند چمکدار پیٖلہٕ لیمبہٕ وول بتہٕ: رٔنِتھ بتہٕ مۄنگ پھلی، چنہٕ دال، ماشہٕ دال، سٔریوٚم، سبز مَرچن تہٕ کڑی پتن ہٕندِس چٹخن وٲلِس تڑکس منٛز رَلٲوِتھ، پتہٕ لیمبہٕ رَسس سٟتۍ ترٛش کٔرِتھ۔ یہوے بتہٕ چھُ ریلہٕ سفرن، سکوٗلٕکین ٹفن باکسن تہٕ مندرٕکین دۄہن خٲطرٕ گنڈنہٕ یِوان، تہٕ تہوارن تہٕ پوجاین خٲطرٕ واریاہ بنان۔
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice mixed in a crackling tempering of groundnuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. This same rice is packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and is made a lot for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: سون لیدُر پوڈر چھُ کیٛنژن سیکنڈن خٲطرٕ گرم تیلس منٛز گژھان، یَمہِ سٟتۍ پرٛتھ دانہٕ اَکی ہیوٗ سونہٕ رنگُک پیٖلہٕ گژھان چھُ تہٕ اَمیُک کوٚچ پن ختم گژھان چھُ۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into hot oil for a few seconds, by which every grain becomes the same golden yellow and its rawness ends. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھُ بتہٕ رَنُن تہٕ 15 مِنَٹ تھاوُن شامِل تاکہ مزٕ بیٚہن۔
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: Total time includes cooking the rice and keeping 15 minutes so the flavours settle.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: مۄنگ پھلی، دال، سٔریوٚم، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز، ژٕھنِو لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ یَنٛگ، پتہٕ رَلٲوِو یہ شیہُلِس بتس، نوٗنس تہٕ لیمبہٕ رَسس سٟتۍ۔
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnuts, dal, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then mix this with cool rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 کپ تومُل ⟦1⟧سونا مسوری، تقریباً 200 g؛ رَنِتھ چھُ تقریباً 3 کپ بنان⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice (uncooked) ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; cooked it makes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 کپ رٔنِتھ بتہٕ ⟦1⟧ذرا سَخ رٔنِتھ، دانہٕ الگ الگ⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ لیمبہٕ رَس ⟦1⟧تقریباً 2 لیمبن نِشہِ؛ مزٕ وُچھِتھ بیٚیہِ⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; more after tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل ⟦1⟧عام طور مۄنگ پھلی تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.ad3af06df4e4.t: ¼ کپ مۄنگ پھلی ⟦1⟧کٔچ، چھۄکلہٕ سان⟦/1⟧

seg.3165601826cb.back: 2 dry red chillies ⟦1⟧broken in the middle⟦/1⟧

seg.985dfde69f06.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت اَدرَک ⟦1⟧یژھِو تیٚلہِ⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: تومُل چھٔلِو تہٕ رَنِو 2 کپ آبس منٛز صرف یوٗت تام یِم رَنہٕ گژھن، تاکہ دانہٕ الگ روزن۔ تۄہہِ چھُ تقریباً 3 کپ رٔنِتھ بتہٕ ضروٗری۔
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook in 2 cups water only until it gets cooked, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: رٔنِتھ بتہٕ پھہلٲوِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز شیہُل گژھنہٕ خٲطرٕ؛ ژٕھنِو نوٗن۔ کانٹس سٟتۍ کٔرِو یہ ہلکہٕ تہٕ تھٲوِو تقریباً 10 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام یہ ووشن گژھِ، گرم نہٕ، تاکہ رَلاونہٕ وِزِ دانہٕ پُھٹن نہٕ۔
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate for cooling; add salt. Make it light with a fork and keep about 10 minutes until it becomes lukewarm, not hot, so the grains don't break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: تیل کٔرِو گرم؛ بُزِو مۄنگ پھلی، دال، سٔریوٚم، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ۔ گوڈٕ بُزِو مۄنگ پھلی درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تقریباً 2 مِنَٹ یوٗت تام یہ چٹخِ تہٕ چھۄکلہٕ گاڑھ گژھن۔
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry groundnuts, dal, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. First fry groundnuts on medium flame about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins become dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: ژٕھنِو چنہٕ دال تہٕ ماشہٕ دال تہٕ بُزِو یوٗت تام یِم ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھن، تقریباً 1 مِنَٹ۔
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until they become light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ دِیِو چٹخنہٕ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، اَدرَک تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ بُزِو کیٛنژن سیکنڈن یوٗت تام پَنہٕ کرکرٕ گژھن۔
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard seeds and let crackle, then add dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: ژٕھنِو لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ یَنٛگ؛ نار کٔرِو بنٛد۔ صرف 5–10 سیکنڈ ہِلٲوِو تاکہ لیدُر گرم تیلس منٛز رَنہٕ گژھِ مگر زلِ نہٕ۔
seg.6e856356980b.back: Add turmeric powder and asafoetida; turn off the flame. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric gets cooked in the hot oil but doesn't burn.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: یہ ژٕھنِو بتس پیٹھ، ژٕھنِو لیمبہٕ رَس تہٕ آہستہٕ رَلٲوِو۔ اوٚنگجین یا پھٲلِس کَفگیرس سٟتۍ تُلِو بتہٕ تلہٕ کِنہِ تاکہ پرٛتھ دانہٕ پیٖلہٕ گژھِ مگر گلِ نہٕ۔
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour this over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. With fingers or a flat ladle lift the rice from below so every grain becomes yellow but doesn't get mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: مزٕ وُچھِو تہٕ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو بیٚیہِ نوٗن یا لیمبہٕ رَس۔ بتہٕ گژھِ صاف ترٛش تہٕ نوٗنہٕ وول باسُن، کیازِ تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ مزٕ ہلکہٕ گژھان۔
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should seem clearly sour and salty, because by keeping the flavour becomes mild.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو پُلیہورا 15 مِنَٹ تاکہ بتس منٛز لیمبس تہٕ تڑکُک مزٕ یِیہِ۔
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Keep lid and before serving keep the pulihora 15 minutes so the lemon and tempering flavour comes into the rice.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: لیمبہٕ رَس ژٕھنِو نارس پیٹھہٕ وٲلِتھ تاکہ اَمہِ ہٕنز ترٛشر تیز روزِ۔ رٔنِتھ لیمبہٕ رَس چھُ ٹیوٚتھ گژھان۔
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add lemon juice taking off the flame so its sourness stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: بتہٕ رَنِو ذرا سَخ تہٕ رَلاونہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو شیہُل؛ گرم، نرم بتہٕ چھُ لیٚسہٕ ہیوٗ گژھان۔
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook rice a little firm and before mixing make it cool; hot, soft rice becomes paste-like.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: لیدُر پوڈر تھٲوِو تیلس منٛز صرف کیٛنژن سیکنڈن؛ زٔلمُت لیدُر چھُ گاڑھ رنگ تہٕ ٹیوٚتھ مزٕ دِوان۔
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: صُبحُک بچمُت بتہٕ چھُ جان روزان، کیازِ تَمہِ کۍ دانہٕ چھِ گوڈے سَخ تہٕ الگ آسان۔
seg.747474140bbf.back: Morning's leftover rice works well, because its grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: کاجو: تہوارٕکِس پُلیہورا خٲطرٕ ترٛٲوِو مۄنگ پھلی سٟتۍ 10 اَڈٕ کاجو۔
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 halved cashews with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: مامیڈیکایا پُلیہورا: لیمبہٕ رَسٕ بدلہٕ رَلٲوِو تڑکس سٟتۍ 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت کوٚچ اَمب۔
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل: ہلکہٕ مزٕکِس بتس خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو لیمبہٕ رَسس سٟتۍ 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل۔
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for mild-flavoured rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: پیش کٔرِو کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ دٔہۍ، آچار یا اپّڈم سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھُ ٹفن باکس تہٕ سفرُک مشہوٗر بتہٕ۔
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or appadam. This is the famous rice of tiffin box and travel.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: یہ چھُ کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تقریباً 6 گنٛٹہٕ جان روزان، تَوے چھُ سفرس منٛز سٟتۍ نیوان۔ بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو اَکِس دۄہس اندر۔
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It stays good at room temperature about 6 hours, so it is taken along on journeys. Keep leftover covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: میون لیمبہٕ وول بتہٕ کیازِ چھُ ٹیوٚتھ باسان؟
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice seem bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: یا آسہِ لیمبہٕ رَس رَنہٕ گوٚمُت یا آسہِ لیدُر تیلس منٛز زٔلمُت۔ لیدُر ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو چوٗلہٕ بنٛد، تہٕ لیمبہٕ رَس ژٕھنِو نارس پیٹھہٕ وٲلِتھ صرف بتس منٛز۔
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice had got cooked or the turmeric had burnt in the oil. Before adding turmeric turn off the stove, and add lemon juice off the flame only into the rice.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: پُلیہورا تہٕ لیمبہٕ وٲلِس بتس منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: پُلیہورا چھُ ترٛش کرنہٕ آمتِس بتس ہُند تیلگو ناو۔ چنتاپنڈو پُلیہورا چھُ اِملی پیسٹس سٟتۍ ترٛش کرنہٕ یِوان؛ نِمّکایا پُلیہورا چھُ لیمبہٕ وول، جلدی بنان تہٕ رنگ ہلکہٕ۔
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name of soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon one, made quickly and colour light.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: لیمبہٕ وول بتہٕ گلنہٕ نِشہِ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بچاوَو؟
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How do we save lemon rice from getting mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: کم آبس منٛز رَنِو بتہٕ ذرا سَخ، تھالس منٛز کٔرِو شیہُل، تہٕ دبٲونہٕ بدلہٕ تلہٕ کِنہِ تُلِتھ آہستہٕ رَلٲوِو۔
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook rice a little firm in less water, cool on a plate, and instead of pressing mix gently lifting from below.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 کپ بتس خٲطرٕ کوٚتاہ لیمبہٕ رَس؟
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: تقریباً 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ، 2 درمیانہٕ لیمبن ہُند رَس۔ آہستہٕ آہستہٕ ژٕھنِو تہٕ مزٕ وُچھان روٗزِو، کیازِ پرٛتھ لیمبس ہٕنز ترٛشر چھےٚ الگ آسان۔
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and keep tasting, because every lemon's sourness is different.

seg.0251508f9c8b.t: نِمّکایا پُلیہورا · لیمبہٕ وٲلِس بتس ہٕنز ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.0251508f9c8b.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora · Recipe of lemon rice | 1acrefarms

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: نِمّکایا پُلیہورا۔ آندھرا ہُند لیمبہٕ وول بتہٕ: شیہُل بتہٕ مۄنگ پھلی تہٕ دالِ ہٕندِس تڑکس، سانہِ لیدُر پوڈرس تہٕ لیمبہٕ رَسس سٟتۍ رَلٲوِتھ۔ قدم بہ قدم طریقہٕ، مشورٕ تہٕ سوال۔
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora. Andhra's lemon rice: cool rice mixed with groundnut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and questions.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: نِمّکایا پُلیہورا: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.ebc4d47e1a30.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت اَدرَک

seg.bea68001f34a.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Pasupu Annam · Haldi wale chawal (turmeric rice)

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: پسوپو انّم چھُ سادٕ بتہٕ یُس لیدرٕ سٟتۍ چمکدار پیٖلہٕ گژھان چھُ تہٕ سٔریوٚم، چنہٕ دال، کڑی پتن تہٕ سبز مَرچن ہٕندِس چٹخن وٲلِس تڑکس منٛز رَلاونہٕ یِوان چھُ، پیٹھہٕ ترٛٲوِتھ کاجو۔ آندھرا کیٚن گرَن منٛز چھُ یہ لنچ باکسن، عام دۄہن ہٕندِس جلدی کھیٚنس تہٕ پوجاہِ کیٚن دۄہن پرساد پٲٹھۍ بنان، اکثر صُبحٕکِس بچمتِس بتس سٟتۍ۔
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice which becomes bright yellow with turmeric and is mixed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, on top fried cashews. In Andhra homes it is made for lunch boxes, quick everyday meals and as prasad on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: سون پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر (کونڈا پسوپو) چھُ بتس گاڑھ پیٖلہٕ رنگ تہٕ لیدرٕچ مِژِ ہِش خۄشبوے دِوان، تَوے چھُ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ اَڈٕ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ کٲفی۔ تَمی تیلس منٛز ترٛٲوِتھ سالِم کاجو (جیڈی پپّو) چھِ کرکرٕ پن اَنان۔
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice deep yellow colour and turmeric's earth-like aroma, so for 4 people half a teaspoon is enough. Whole cashews (JD Pappu) fried in that same oil bring crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھِ رٔنِتھ بتس شیہُل گژھنٕکۍ تقریباً 15 مِنَٹ شامِل۔
seg.38badedc8d11.back: Total time includes about 15 minutes of the cooked rice cooling.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: بتہٕ رَنِو تہٕ دِیِو شیہُل گژھنہٕ۔ کاجو، سٔریوٚم، چنہٕ دال، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز، ژٕھنِو پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ رَلٲوِو بتہٕ۔
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 کپ تومُل ⟦1⟧سونا مسوری، تقریباً 200 g؛ رَنِتھ چھُ تقریباً 3 کپ بنان⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice (uncooked) ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; cooked it makes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر ⟦1⟧کونڈا پسوپو⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو (یژھِو تیٚلہِ) ⟦1⟧آخرس پیٹھ رَلٲوِو⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (if you want) ⟦1⟧mix in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.afe3b0737680.t: ⟦1⟧لیدُر پوڈرٕ⟦/1⟧ سٟتۍ تہِ چھُ جان بنان۔
seg.afe3b0737680.back: Also turns out well with ⟦1⟧turmeric powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: تومُل چھٔلِو 2–3 لٹہٕ آبس منٛز تہٕ آب کڈِو۔
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: تومُل رَنِو تِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ زِ دانہٕ الگ روزن، پتہٕ پھہلٲوِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز شیہُل گژھنہٕ خٲطرٕ۔ دیگچس یا پریشر کُکرس (2 سیٖٹی) منٛز ہیٚیِو 1 کپ تومُلن خٲطرٕ 2 کپ آب، تہٕ پھہلاونہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو کانٹس سٟتۍ ہلکہٕ۔
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice in such a way that the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate for cooling. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) take 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and before spreading make it light with a fork.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: بتہٕ دِیِو تقریباً 15 مِنَٹ شیہُل گژھنہٕ یوٗت تام یہ صرف ووشن روزِ۔ پیٹھہٕ ژٕھکِو نوٗن۔
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until it stays only lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: اَکِس کھۄلِس کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم۔
seg.48839bd22983.back: In a wide kadai heat oil on medium flame.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: کاجو ترٛٲوِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن؛ کڈِو۔ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ چنہٕ دال۔ کاجو تھٲوِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز؛ یِم چھِ تقریباً 1 مِنَٹس منٛز سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھان۔
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry cashews in oil until they become golden; take out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they become golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: ییلہِ سٔریوٚم چٹخِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ماشہٕ دال تہٕ ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ ہِلٲوِو۔
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard seeds crackle, then add urad dal and dry red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: ییلہِ دال سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ، پتہٕ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ لیدُر۔ کڑی پتن سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو اَدرَک تہٕ یَنٛگ، تہٕ لیدُر ہِلٲوِو صرف 5–10 سیکنڈ۔
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal becomes golden, then add chillies and curry leaves, then turmeric on low flame. With the curry leaves add ginger and asafoetida, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: نار کٔرِو فوراً بنٛد تاکہ لیدُر زلِ نہٕ۔
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the flame immediately so the turmeric doesn't burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: ژٕھنِو بتہٕ، کاجو تہٕ نوٗن تہٕ آہستہٕ رَلٲوِو یوٗت تام سورُے برابر پیٖلہٕ گژھِ۔ پھٲلہٕ کَفگیر ورتٲوِو تہٕ دبٲونہٕ بدلہٕ تُلِتھ پھیرِو، تاکہ دانہٕ سالِم روزن۔
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until everything becomes evenly yellow. Use a flat ladle and instead of pressing turn by lifting, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: نوٗنُک مزٕ وُچھِو، اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ رَلٲوِو گیٖو، ڈَکُن تھٲوِو تہٕ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو 5 مِنَٹ تاکہ بتس منٛز تڑکُک مزٕ یِیہِ۔
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste the salt, if you are using mix in ghee, keep lid and before serving keep 5 minutes so the tempering's flavour comes into the rice.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: گوڈٕ پھہلٲوِتھ کٔرِو بتہٕ شیہُل تاکہ دانہٕ پُھٹن نہٕ۔
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread and cool the rice so the grains don't break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: لیدُر ژٕھنِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تہٕ ہِلٲوِو صرف کیٛنژن سیکنڈن؛ زٔلمُت لیدُر چھُ بتہٕ ٹیوٚتھ کران۔
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low flame and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر چھُ زیادٕ رنگ دِوان؛ 1 کپ تومُلن خٲطرٕ کٔرِو ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ شروٗع تہٕ صرف تیلہِ ژٕھنِو اَکھ چُٹکی بیٚیہِ ییلہِ گاڑھ پیٖلہٕ یژھِو۔
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives more colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and only add one more pinch when you want deep yellow.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: صُبحُک بچمُت بتہٕ چھُ جان روزان، شرط چھےٚ زِ دانہٕ آسن الگ۔
seg.505872469eb9.back: Morning's leftover rice works well, the condition is that the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: لیدُر پوڈر: سون پرٛتھ دۄہُک پسوپو لیدُر پوڈر تہِ چھُ تِتھے پٲٹھۍ کام کران؛ ہیٚیِو تیوٗتُے ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ۔
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; take the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: مۄنگ پھلی: زیادٕ کرکرٕ پن خٲطرٕ ترٛٲوِو کاجون برونٛہہ 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ کٔچ مۄنگ پھلی تیلس منٛز۔
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: لیمبہٕ: ترٛش، پُلیہورا ہِشِس بتس خٲطرٕ مَچِھو بتس سٟتۍ اَڈٕ لیمبہٕ رَس۔
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for sour, pulihora-like rice squeeze half a lemon's juice with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: نارجیٖل: بتس سٟتۍ رَلٲوِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل۔
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: پیش کٔرِو ووشن یا کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ دٔہۍ، اپّڈالو یا اولَن ہٕنزِ ہۄکھ ترٛٲوِتھ ڈِشہِ سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھُ لنچ باکسن تہٕ سفرس خٲطرٕ تہِ جان۔
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry fried dish of potatoes. It is also good for lunch boxes and travel.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: تَمیُے دۄہ کھیٚنہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان۔ بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز 1 دۄہس تام تہٕ ذرا آب ژٕھکِتھ کٔرِو گرم۔
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating the same day is best. Keep leftover covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat sprinkling a little water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?
seg.54acb7b11b4c.t: پسوپو انّم کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ چھِ بناوان؟

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: بتہٕ رَنِو تِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ زِ دانہٕ الگ روزن تہٕ دِیِو شیہُل گژھنہٕ۔ کاجو، سٔریوٚم، چنہٕ دال، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز، لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو کیٛنژن سیکنڈن خٲطرٕ لیدُر، پتہٕ رَلٲوِو نوٗنس سٟتۍ بتہٕ۔
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice in such a way that the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, on low flame add turmeric for a few seconds, then mix rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: لیدرٕ وٲلِس بتس منٛز کوٚتاہ لیدُر پوڈر چھُ گژھان؟
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes in turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 کپ کٔچن تومُلن (تقریباً 3 کپ رٔنِتھ) خٲطرٕ تقریباً ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ۔ پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر چھُ زیادٕ رنگ دِوان، تَوے کٔرِو کم سٟتۍ شروٗع تہٕ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو اَکھ چُٹکی بیٚیہِ۔
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: For 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked) about ½ teaspoon. Hill turmeric powder gives more colour, so start with less and if needed add one more pinch.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: میون لیدرٕ وول بتہٕ کیازِ چھُ ٹیوٚتھ؟
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: لیدُر آسہِ گرم تیلس منٛز زٔلمُت، یا آسہِ زیادٕ ژٕھنَنہٕ آمُت۔ یہ ژٕھنِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، ہِلٲوِو صرف کیٛنژن سیکنڈن تہٕ بتہٕ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو نار بنٛد۔
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric had burnt in hot oil, or too much had been added. Add it on low flame, stir only a few seconds and before adding rice turn off the flame.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: کیا بچمتِس بتس سٟتۍ ہیٚکہٕ پسوپو انّم بٔنِتھ؟
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can pasupu annam be made with leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: آ۔ الگ دانن وول بچمُت بتہٕ چھُ جان روزان۔ تڑکس منٛز ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ پھٕٹرٲوِو اوٚنگجین سٟتۍ گُتھہٕ۔
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Before adding to the tempering break lumps with the fingers.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: پسوپو انّم۔ پسوپو انّم، آندھرا لیدرٕ وول بتہٕ: رٔنِتھ بتہٕ سٔریوٚم، چنہٕ دال تہٕ کڑی پتن ہٕندِس تڑکس منٛز پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ ترٛٲوِتھ کاجون سٟتۍ رَلٲوِتھ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.720281a9dc26.back: Pasupu Annam. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed in a tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal and curry leaves with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: پسوپو انّم: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر

seg.2a596fd9abec.t: ناشتس منٛز چَیَن ہیوٗ · 2 لُکن خٲطرٕ

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: راگی جاوا چھُ آبس منٛز رَنِتھ راگی اٹُک پتلہٕ دلیہٕ یُس چَیہِ ہیٚکِو، آندھرا تہٕ رائلسیما کیٚن واریاہن گرَن ہُند پرٛتھ دۄہُک چَیُن۔ نوٗنہٕ وول جاوا چھُ لسی سٟتۍ بنان؛ یہ مۄدُر جاوا چھُ دودس سٟتۍ پتلہٕ کرنہٕ یِوان تہٕ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ مۄدُر، تہٕ ناشتس یا شامس اسٹیلہٕ ٹمبلرس منٛز گرم چَینہٕ یِوان۔
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a thin porridge of ragi flour cooked in water which you can drink, the everyday drink of many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty java is made with lassi (buttermilk); this sweet java is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and drunk hot in a steel tumbler at breakfast or evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: سون تاٹی بیلّم تاڑ گُڑ چھُ راگی ہٕندِس مِژِ ہِشِس مزس سٟتۍ میل کھیٚوان تہٕ جاوا ٹافی ہیوٗ بھورٕ رنگ دِوان۔ شروٗعہٕ پیٹھہٕ آخرس تام چھِ تقریباً 15 مِنَٹ لگان۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 2 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our thati bellam palm jaggery matches ragi's earth-like flavour and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to end it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھِ گُڑ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ 2 مِنَٹ تھاوُن تہِ شامِل۔
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: Total time also includes keeping 2 minutes before adding jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: راگی اٹہٕ پھیٚنٹِو آبس منٛز، رَنِو گرٛکان آبس منٛز یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ تہٕ چمکدار گژھِ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو دۄد۔ نارس پیٹھہٕ وٲلِتھ رَلٲوِو تاڑ گُڑ تہٕ الٲچی۔
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until it becomes thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the flame mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ کپ راگی اٹہٕ ⟦1⟧منڈوا اٹہٕ، تقریباً 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧mandua flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 کپ آب ⟦1⟧1 کپ اٹہٕ گھولنہٕ خٲطرٕ، 1 کپ گرٛکاونہٕ خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for mixing the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ ⟦1⟧تقریباً 30 g؛ زیادٕ مۄدُر پسند آسہِ تیٚلہِ اَکھ چَمچ بیٚیہِ⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; if you like sweeter then one more spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.t: راگی اٹہٕ ژٕھنِو اَکِس پیالس منٛز۔
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: راگی اٹہٕ پھیٚنٹِو 1 کپ آبس منٛز یوٗت تام یہ ہموار گژھِ، کانٛہہ گُتھ روزِ نہٕ۔ وِسک یا کانٹہٕ ورتٲوِو تہٕ گُتھہٕ پھٕٹرٲوِو پیالٕکِس کنارس سٟتۍ دبٲوِتھ۔
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk ragi flour in 1 cup water until it becomes smooth, no lump remains. Use a whisk or fork and break the lumps pressing them against the edge of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: باقی 1 کپ آب ژٕھنِو گوٚب تلہٕ وٲلِس پینس منٛز تہٕ تھٲوِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Put the remaining 1 cup water in a heavy-bottomed pan and keep on medium flame.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: بیٚیِہ کپ آب گرٛکٲوِو، راگی ژٕھنِو تہٕ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ہِلٲوِو یوٗت تام یہ گاڑھ تہٕ چمکدار گژھِ، 6–8 مِنَٹ۔ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ ہِلٲوِو گھول بیٚیہِ اَکھ لٹہٕ، کیازِ اٹہٕ چھُ پیالٕکِس تلس بیہان۔
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the other cup of water, add ragi and stir on low flame until it becomes thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Before adding stir the mixture once more, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو۔ جاوا چھُ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ یہ پھیکہٕ گُلٲبی بھورٕ رنگہٕ پیٹھہٕ گاڑھ، چمکدار بھورٕ گژھِ تہٕ چَمچہٕ کہِ پتہٕ کِنہِ لگِ۔
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring constantly. The java is cooked when it goes from dull pinkish brown to deep, glossy brown and sticks to the back of the spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: ژٕھنِو دۄد تہٕ رَنِو 2 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ۔ نار کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ تھٲوِو 2 مِنَٹ۔ رَنَنہٕ وِزِ ہِلٲوِو اَکھ زٕ لٹہٕ تاکہ یہ تلس لگِ نہٕ۔
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add milk and cook 2 minutes on low flame. Turn off the flame and keep 2 minutes. While cooking stir one two times so it doesn't stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: یوٚت تام جاوا تھوٚومُت آسہِ، تاڑ گُڑ کٔرِو باریک کدوکش تاکہ یہ جلدی گلِ۔
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java is kept, grate the palm jaggery finely so it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: رَلٲوِو تاڑ گُڑ تہٕ الٲچی۔ گرم پیش کٔرِو۔ ہِلٲوِو یوٗت تام گُڑ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ گلِ، پتہٕ مزٕ وُچھِو تہٕ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ذرا بیٚیہِ۔
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve hot. Stir until the jaggery melts fully, then taste and if needed add a little more.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: ژٕھنِو ٹمبلرن یا پیالن منٛز۔ اگر چَینہٕ خٲطرٕ واریاہ گاڑھ آسہِ، تیٚلہِ رَلٲوِو کیٛنہہ چَمچ گرم دۄد۔
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into tumblers or cups. If too thick for drinking, then mix some spoons of hot milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: ہمیشہ گھولِو راگی اٹہٕ گوڈٕ آبس منٛز؛ سیود گرٛکان آبس منٛز ژٕھنِتھ اٹہٕ چھُ تِژھ گُتھہٕ بناوان یِم پھٕٹرن نہٕ۔
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix ragi flour first in water; flour added straight to boiling water makes such lumps which don't break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: رَنَنس منٛز کٔرِو نہٕ جلدی؛ کم رٔنِتھ راگی ہُند مزٕ چھُ کوٚچ تہٕ اٹہٕ ہیوٗ باسان۔
seg.966098732312.back: Don't hurry in cooking; undercooked ragi's taste seems raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: ٹمبلرس منٛز چَینہٕ خٲطرٕ پتلہِ جاوا خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ راگی اٹہٕ؛ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ کھیٚنہٕ وٲلِس دلیس خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو ⅓ کپ۔
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For thin java for drinking in a tumbler take 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for porridge eaten with a spoon take ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: میوٕ سٟتۍ: آخرس پیٹھ رَلٲوِو کیٛنہہ ژٹِتھ کاجو یا بادام تہٕ اَکھ چَمچ کشمش۔
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With nuts: at the end mix some chopped cashews or almonds and one spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: دودہٕ ورٲے: راگی رَنِو 2½ کپ آبس منٛز تہٕ بلبلہٕ رُکنہٕ پتہٕ رَلٲوِو گُڑ؛ جاوا بنِ پتلہٕ تہٕ گاڑھ رنگُک۔
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: cook ragi in 2½ cups water and after the bubbles stop mix jaggery; the java will become thin and dark-coloured.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم اسٹیلہٕ ٹمبلرس یا پیالس منٛز ناشتس خٲطرٕ، یا شامٕکِس چَینس پٲٹھۍ کیٛنژن بسکٹن یا مُروکولو سٟتۍ۔ کیٛنژن چھُ یہ گرٛیٖشمس منٛز شیہُل پسند۔
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve hot in a steel tumbler or cup for breakfast, or as the evening's drink with some biscuits or murukulu. Some like it cold in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: یَمہِ دۄہ بنِ، تَمی دۄہ چَیُن چھُ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان۔ بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز 1 دۄہس تام تہٕ دوبارٕ گرم کرنہٕ وِزِ نارس پیٹھہٕ وٲلِتھ رَلٲوِو ذرا گرم دۄد۔
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it the same day it is made is best. Keep leftover covered in the fridge up to 1 day and while reheating, taking off the flame, mix a little hot milk.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: راگی جاوا کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو گُتھو ورٲے؟
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How do we make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: گوڈٕ پھیٚنٹِو راگی اٹہٕ کمرٕچ حرارتٕچ آبس منٛز یوٗت تام یہ ہموار گژھِ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو یہ برابر ہِلٲوان گرٛکان آبس منٛز۔
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk ragi flour in room-temperature water until it becomes smooth, then add it into boiling water stirring constantly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ پَتہٕ لگِ زِ راگی جاوا چھُ رٔنِتھ؟
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know that ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: یہ چھُ گاڑھ تہٕ چمکدار گژھان، یوٗت گاڑھ زِ چَمچہٕ کہِ پتہٕ کِنہِ لگِ، تہٕ اَتھ چھُ نہٕ وۄنۍ اٹہٕ ہیوٗ مزٕ یِوان۔ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ چھِ اَتھ تقریباً 6–8 مِنَٹ لگان۔
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep and glossy, so thick that it sticks to the back of the spoon, and no longer has a floury taste. On low flame it takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: کیا راگی جاوا منٛز ہیٚکہٕ تاڑ گُڑ ژٕھنِتھ؟
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can palm jaggery be added to ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: آ۔ تاڑ گُڑ (تاٹی بیلّم) کٔرِو باریک کدوکش تہٕ چوٗلہٕ بنٛد کرنہٕ پتہٕ رَلٲوِو، تاکہ دۄد پُھٹِ نہٕ۔ اَمہِ سٟتۍ چھُ رنگ گاڑھ تہٕ مۄدُرر ذرا دُہس ہِش گژھان۔
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and mix after turning off the stove, so the milk doesn't curdle. With it the colour becomes deep and sweetness a little smoke-like.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: راگی جاوا تہٕ راگی مالٹس منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: یِم چھِ اَکی چیزٕکۍ زٕ ناو۔ راگی جاوا چھُ تیلگو ناو؛ دُکانن تہٕ مینوہن منٛز چھِ اَتھ اکثر راگی مالٹ ونان۔
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: These are two names of one thing. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is often called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: راگی جاوا · مۄدُر راگی جاوا ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: Ragi Java · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: راگی جاوا۔ آندھرا طریقُک مۄدُر راگی جاوا: راگی اٹہٕ آبس منٛز چمکدار گژھنہٕ تام رَنِتھ، دودس سٟتۍ پتلہٕ تہٕ تاٹی بیلّم تاڑ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ مۄدُر کٔرِتھ۔ طریقہٕ تہٕ مشورٕ۔
seg.708e3c523d72.back: Ragi Java. Andhra-way sweet ragi java: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with thati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: راگی جاوا: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.8ee2205b2e8b.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: اِگورو چھُ ماز یا جھینگہٕ گنڈن ہٕندِس گاڑھ مسالس منٛز تقریباً ہۄکھ گژھنہٕ تام رَنَنُک آندھرا طریقہٕ، تاکہ مسالہٕ پرٛتھ ٹُکرس سٟتۍ لگن۔ رویّالا اِگورو چھُ ساحلی ضلعن ہُند، نیلورٕ پیٹھہٕ گوداوری تہٕ سریکاکولم تام، یتہِ بیک واٹر تہٕ سمندرٕکۍ جھینگہٕ آتھوارِ دۄپہرس بتس سٟتۍ کھیٚنہٕ یِوان چھِ۔
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns in thick masala of onions until almost dry, so the spices stick to every piece. Royyala iguru is of the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where backwater and sea prawns are eaten with rice at Sunday lunch.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: سون پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر (کونڈا پسوپو) چھُ گوڈٕ جھینگن پیٹھ مَلنہٕ یِوان تہٕ پتہٕ مسالس منٛز گژھان۔ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ سُہ گاڑھ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ تیز ٹیٚٹھر اَنان یُس ساحلی گرَن پسند چھُ، تَوے کٔرِو مقدار پنٕنِس گرس مطابق۔
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) is first rubbed on the prawns and then goes into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings that deep red colour and sharp heat which coastal homes like, so make the quantity according to your home.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: تیاری منٛز چھُ جھینگہٕ صاف کرُن تہٕ لیدرس سٟتۍ 10 مِنَٹ تھاوُن شامِل۔
seg.885826f68de3.back: Preparation includes cleaning the prawns and keeping 10 minutes with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: جھینگن مَلِو لیدُر تہٕ نوٗن۔ گنڈٕ تہٕ اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ بُزِو، ژٕھنِو تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ دَنِوالٕ پوڈر، پتہٕ رَنِو جھینگہٕ مسالس منٛز یوٗت تام مسالہٕ تِمن پیٹھ لگِ۔
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry onions and ginger garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala sticks on them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g جھینگہٕ ⟦1⟧درمیانہٕ سائزٕکۍ، چھۄکلہٕ تہٕ کرٛہنۍ رَگ کڈِتھ، صاف کرنہٕ پتہٕ توٗلِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black vein removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن ⟦1⟧زٕ حصہٕ کٔرِتھ، یا مزٕ وُچھِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧made into two parts, or after tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.8c4c1b789de7.t: 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل ⟦1⟧عام طور مۄنگ پھلی تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر ⟦1⟧کونڈا پسوپو؛ ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ جھینگن خٲطرٕ، ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مسالس خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، کم ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat take 1 teaspoon, for less heat ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: جھینگن ہُند چھۄکلہٕ تہٕ کرٛہنۍ رَگ کڈِو، جان پٲٹھۍ چھٔلِو تہٕ چھانٕنی منٛز دِیِو آب نیرنہٕ۔
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the prawns' shell and black vein, wash well and let water drain in a sieve.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: جھینگن مَلِو اَڈٕ لیدُر تہٕ ذرا نوٗن؛ 10 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو۔ ہیٚیِو ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر تہٕ ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ نوٗن۔
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; keep 10 minutes. Take ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: اَکِس گوٚب کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تیل گرم تہٕ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم۔ ییلہِ یہ چٹخِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ۔
