seg.9e027c56020d.back: In a heavy kadai heat oil on medium flame and add mustard seeds. When they crackle, then add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: گنڈٕ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یہ سونہٕ رنگُک گژھِ، پتہٕ اَدرَک رۄہنٕ پیسٹ یوٗت تام رٔنِتھ گژھنٕچ خۄشبوے یِیہِ۔ گنڈن چھِ تقریباً 8–10 مِنَٹ لگان؛ پیسٹس تقریباً 1 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام کٔچ بوے گژھِ۔
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry onions in oil until golden, then ginger garlic paste until the cooked aroma comes. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: اگر ٹماٹر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو یہ وۄنۍ تہٕ رَنِو یوٗت تام یہ نرم تہٕ گوٗدٕ ہیوٗ گژھِ، تقریباً 4 مِنَٹ۔
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If you are using tomato, then add it now and cook until it becomes soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: نار کٔرِو لوٚت۔ ژٕھنِو باقی لیدُر، تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ دَنِوالٕ پوڈر؛ 1 مِنَٹ بُزِو۔ ژٕھنِو باقی نوٗن تہٕ ہِلٲوان روٗزِو تاکہ مسالہٕ تلس لگن نہٕ۔
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Make the flame low. Add remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add remaining salt and keep stirring so the spices don't stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: ژٕھنِو آب تہٕ رَنِو مسالہٕ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ یوٗت تام کنارَن پیٹھ تیل الگ گژھُن شروٗع گژھِ، تقریباً 3–4 مِنَٹ۔
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Add water and cook the masala on medium flame until oil starts separating on the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: ژٕھنِو جھینگہٕ تہٕ رَنِو یوٗت تام یِم وَلن تہٕ گُلٲبی گژھن، 5–6 مِنَٹ۔ آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو گرم مسالہٕ۔ درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ تیز نارس پیٹھ بار بار ہِلٲوِو تاکہ مسالہٕ ہۄکھِتھ جھینگن پیٹھ لگِ۔
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add prawns and cook until they curl and become pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. On more than medium flame stir again and again so the masala dries and sticks on the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: وُچھِو زِ رٔنِتھ چھِ: جھینگہٕ چھِ رٔنِتھ تیلہِ یُتھ یِم اندرٕ تام گُلٲبی تہٕ غیر شفاف آسن تہٕ ڈٲلِس C شکلِ منٛز وٕلِتھ آسن۔ یقین نہٕ آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٹِو اَکھ؛ منٛزس منٛز گژھِ نہٕ کانٛہہ سُرمٲیی، آر پار باسن وول حصہٕ آسُن۔
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check they are cooked: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque to the inside and curled in a loose C shape. If not sure, then cut one; in the middle there should be no grey, see-through part.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: نوٗنُک مزٕ وُچھِو، دَنِوال ژٕھکِو تہٕ نار کٔرِو بنٛد۔ جھینگہٕ رٔنِتھ گژھنہٕ پتہٕ رَنِو نہٕ بیٚیہِ، نَتہٕ چھِ یِم ربڑ ہِشۍ گژھان۔
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste the salt, sprinkle coriander and turn off the flame. After the prawns are cooked don't cook more, otherwise they become rubber-like.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: تیجا چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ: 1½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ تِتھ ٹیٚٹھ اِگورو بنان یُتھ ساحلی گرَن پسند چھُ؛ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، یا کم ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ۔
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: with 1½ teaspoons such hot iguru is made as coastal homes like; for medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or for less heat ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: گنڈٕ بُزِو جان پٲٹھۍ سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھنہٕ تام؛ اِگورو ہُند رنگ تہٕ گاڑھر چھُ جان پٲٹھۍ بُزمٕتین گنڈن سٟتۍ یِوان۔
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry onions well until golden; the iguru's colour and thickness come from well-fried onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: جھینگہٕ چھِ جلدی رَنہٕ گژھان۔ ڈٲلۍ C شکلُک مطلب چھُ رٔنِتھ؛ تنگ O شکلُک مطلب چھُ زیادٕ رٔنِتھ تہٕ ربڑ ہِشۍ۔
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. Loose C shape means cooked; tight O shape means overcooked and rubber-like.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: چھٔلنہٕ پتہٕ کٔرِو جھینگہٕ تھپتھپٲوِتھ ہۄکھ تاکہ یِم آبس منٛز گرٛکنہٕ بدلہٕ مسالس منٛز بُزنہٕ یِن۔
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry so they fry in the masala instead of boiling in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: گونگورا رویّالو: جھینگن سٟتۍ رَلٲوِو ½ کپ گونگورا پَنہٕ، ذرا تیلس منٛز ہۄکھنٲوِتھ تہٕ مَسلِتھ۔
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: mix with the prawns ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: نارجیٖل: آخری 2 مِنَٹن منٛز ژٕھنِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل یا 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ گاڑھ نارجیٖلٕ دۄد؛ مسالہٕ بنِ نرم تہٕ بھرپور۔
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: in the last 2 minutes add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk; the masala will become soft and rich.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: گریوی وول طریقہٕ: بتس پیٹھ ژٕھنَنہٕ وٲجِنہِ پتلہِ رویّالا کورا خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو جھینگن پتہٕ ¾ کپ آب۔
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy style: for thin royyala kura for pouring on rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بتس تہٕ اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، یا رَسم یا سامبر بتس سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھُ چپاتی سٟتۍ تہِ جان لگان۔
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot with rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 1 دۄہس اندر۔ پینس منٛز کٔرِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ گرم؛ ڈیر کال گرم کرنہٕ سٟتۍ چھِ جھینگہٕ سَخ گژھان۔
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan on low flame; heating long makes the prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ پَتہٕ لگِ زِ جھینگہٕ چھِ رٔنِتھ؟
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know that the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: یِم چھِ اندرٕ تام گُلٲبی تہٕ غیر شفاف گژھان تہٕ ڈٲلِس C شکلِ منٛز وَلان، عام طور گرم مسالس منٛز 5–6 مِنَٹن منٛز۔ منٛزس منٛز سُرمٲیی، آر پار باسن وول حصہٕ آسہِ تیٚلہِ چھُ یِمن ذرا بیٚیہِ وقت ضروٗری۔
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque to the inside and curl in a loose C shape, usually within 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If in the middle there is a grey, see-through part, then they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: اِگورو تہٕ ویپُڈو منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: اِگورو چھُ گنڈٕ مسالس منٛز گاڑھ تہٕ تقریباً ہۄکھ گژھنہٕ تام رَنَنہٕ یِوان، تہٕ مسالہٕ چھُ جھینگن سٟتۍ لٲگِتھ روزان۔ ویپُڈو چھُ فرائی، یَتھ منٛز گنڈٕ گریوی کم یا بِلکُل نہٕ آسان چھےٚ، تہٕ جھینگہٕ چھِ کنارَن پیٹھ کرکرٕ گژھنہٕ تام رَنَنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, and the masala stays stuck to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, in which onion gravy is little or not at all, and the prawns are cooked until crisp on the edges.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: رویّالا اِگورو کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.d248a2970455.back: How do we make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر یا کم ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ، تہٕ سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن ترٲوِو۔ آخرس پیٹھ اَکھ بوٚڑ چَمچ دٔہۍ یا نارجیٖلٕ دۄد تہِ چھُ ٹیٚٹھر نرم کران۔
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or for less heat ½ teaspoon, and leave out green chillies. At the end a tablespoon of curd or coconut milk also softens the heat.

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: آ۔ یِم کٔرِو فرجس منٛز پِگلاوِتھ نرم، جان پٲٹھۍ آب کڈِو تہٕ لیدُر تہٕ نوٗن مَلنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو تھپتھپٲوِتھ ہۄکھ۔ فروزن جھینگہٕ چھِ زیادٕ آب ترٲوان، تَوے رَنِو مسالہٕ ذرا زیادٕ کال۔
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw them soft in the fridge, drain water well and before rubbing turmeric and salt pat them dry. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: رویّالا اِگورو۔ رویّالا اِگورو، ساحلی آندھرا ہُند جھینگہٕ روسٹ: گنڈٕ مسالس منٛز پہاڑی لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ تیز تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ گاڑھ رَنِتھ جھینگہٕ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: Royyala Iguru. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra's prawn roast: prawns cooked thick in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: رویّالا اِگورو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.0db77ec56eb4.t: 1½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: سُنّنڈلو چھِ آندھرا کۍ ماشہٕ دالِ ہٕندۍ لڈوٗ: ماشہٕ دال سوندھ گژھنہٕ تام بُزِتھ، گُڑٕ سٟتۍ باریک پیٖہِتھ تہٕ گرم گیٖوَس سٟتۍ جوڑِتھ۔ شیرٕ رَنُن چھُ نہٕ پیوان، تَوے چھِ یِم تقریباً اَڈٕ گنٛٹس منٛز تیار گژھان۔ آندھرا کیٚن گرَن منٛز چھُ سنکرانتی تہٕ دیوالی خٲطرٕ اَکھ پوٗرٕ ڈَبہٕ بنان، بیٚیِس مُلکس گژھن وٲلین رِشتہٕ دارن خٲطرٕ گنڈنہٕ یِوان، تہٕ شامس چاے سٟتۍ مِٹھٲیہِ خٲطرٕ تھاونہٕ یِوان۔
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: urad dal roasted until nutty, ground fine with jaggery and bound with hot ghee. Syrup does not have to be cooked, so they become ready in about half an hour. In Andhra homes a whole box is made for Sankranti and Diwali, packed for relatives going to another country, and kept for a sweet with tea in the evening.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: سون تاٹی بیلّم تاڑ گُڑ چھُ سُنّنڈلوَن گاڑھ بھورٕ رنگ تہٕ بھرپور، ذرا دُہس ہِش مۄدُرر دِوان یۄسہٕ بُزمٕژِ دالِ سٟتۍ میل کھیٚوان چھےٚ۔ یَمہِ ترکیبہِ سٟتۍ چھِ تقریباً 15 لڈوٗ بنان۔
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our thati bellam palm jaggery gives the sunnundalu a deep brown colour and rich, slightly smoke-like sweetness which matches the roasted dal. With this recipe about 15 laddus are made.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھُ پیٖہنہٕ برونٛہہ بُزمٕژ دال شیہُل کرُن شامِل۔
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: Total time includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: ماشہٕ دال بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ، شیہُل کٔرِتھ پیٖہِو باریک، پتہٕ تاڑ گُڑ تہٕ الٲچی ژٕھنِتھ پیٖہِو۔ گرم گیٖوَس سٟتۍ رَلٲوِتھ بنٲوِو لڈوٗ۔
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast urad dal until it becomes golden, cool and grind fine, then add palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mixing with hot ghee make laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 کپ سفید ماشہٕ دال ⟦1⟧پھٕٹرٲوِتھ، چھۄکلہٕ ورٲے (مینپپّو)، تقریباً 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, without skin (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ ⟦1⟧تقریباً 180 g، ذرا دَبٲوِتھ بٔرِو؛ گوڈٕ کُٹِو یا کدوکش کٔرِو ٹُکرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, fill pressing a little; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ کپ گیٖو ⟦1⟧گلٲوِتھ تہٕ گرم؛ 1–2 بوٚڑ چَمچ بیٚیہِ تھٲوِو نِش⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons more near⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: ماشہٕ دالِ منٛزٕ ژارِو لۄکٕٹۍ کَنۍ۔ یہ چھٔلِو نہٕ؛ بُزنہٕ خٲطرٕ گژھِ یہ ہۄکھ آسٕنۍ۔
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick small stones out of the urad dal. Don't wash it; for roasting it should be dry.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: دال ژٕھنِو اَکِس گوٚب پینس منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a heavy pan on low flame.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: ماشہٕ دال بُزِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تیلہٕ ورٲے یوٗت تام یہ سونہٕ رنگٕچ تہٕ سوندھ گژھِ، تقریباً 10 مِنَٹ۔ برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو تاکہ پرٛتھ دانُک رنگ برابر بدلِ؛ اَتھ گژھِ بُزمٕژ خۄشبوے یِنۍ تہٕ دانہٕ دَنٛدو سٟتۍ ژٹنہٕ وِزِ کرک کٔرِتھ پُھٹُن۔
seg.65588a76c883.back: Roast urad dal on low flame without oil until it becomes golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Keep stirring constantly so every grain's colour changes evenly; it should give a roasted aroma and a grain should break with a crack when cut with the teeth.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: دال کڈِو اَکِس تھالس منٛز تہٕ پھہلٲوِو۔ شیہُل کٔرِو، پتہٕ پیٖہِو باریک پوڈرس منٛز۔ لۄکٕٹین جھٹکن منٛز پیٖہِو تاکہ مکسر گرم گژھِ نہٕ، تہٕ موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ چھٲنِتھ پیٖہِو دوبارٕ۔
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Take the dal out on a plate and spread. Cool, then grind into a fine powder. Grind in small pulses so the mixer doesn't get hot, and sieve the coarse pieces and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: تاڑ گُڑ کٔرِو باریک کدوکش، یا کُٹِو ٹُکرٕ اوکھلس منٛز، سَخ گُتھہٕ پھٕٹرٲوِتھ۔
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: مکسرٕکِس جارس منٛز دالِ ہٕندِس پوڈرس منٛز ژٕھنِو گُڑ تہٕ الٲچی پوڈر۔ گُڑ تہٕ الٲچی پیٖہِو یوٗت تام یِم برابر رَلن۔ کیٛنہہ جھٹکہٕ چھِ کٲفی؛ سورُے کڈِو اَکِس کھۄلِس پیالس منٛز۔
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind jaggery and cardamom until they mix evenly. Some pulses are enough; take everything out into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: گیٖو کٔرِو اَکِس لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز یوٗت گرم زِ گرم آسہِ مگر دُہ کڈِ نہٕ۔
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Heat ghee in a small pan so hot that it is hot but doesn't give out smoke.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: ژٕھنِو گرم گیٖو، جان پٲٹھۍ رَلٲوِو تہٕ بنٲوِو لۄکٕٹۍ گولہٕ۔ زیادٕ تر گیٖوَس سٟتۍ کٔرِو شروٗع، چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ رَلٲوِو، پتہٕ ییلہِ یہ اَتھ لاگنہٕ لایق شیہُل گژھِ تیٚلہِ رَلٲوِو اَتھو سٟتۍ۔
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Add hot ghee, mix well and make small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then when it becomes cool enough to touch mix with the hands.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: ذرا مکسچر ہیٚیِو مُٹھہِ منٛز تہٕ دبٲوِو زور سان، پتہٕ کٔرِو اَتھن ہٕندِس تلس منٛز گول۔ اگر یہ بِکھرِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو پیالس منٛز اَکھ چَمچ بیٚیہِ گرم گیٖو تہٕ رَلٲوِو۔
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a little mixture in the fist and press with force, then make it round in the palms. If it crumbles, then add one more spoon of hot ghee in the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: تھاونہٕ برونٛہہ تھٲوِو لڈوٗ اَکِس تھالس منٛز 15–20 مِنَٹ تاکہ یِم سَخ گژھن۔
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing keep the laddus on a plate 15–20 minutes so they become firm.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: دال بُزِو لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تاکہ یہ اندرٕ تام بُزِ تہٕ زلِ نہٕ۔
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low flame so it roasts to the inside and doesn't burn.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: دال پیٖہِو صرف پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھنہٕ پتہٕ؛ گرم دال چھےٚ مکسرس منٛز لیٚسہٕ ہِش گژھان۔
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after cooling completely; hot dal becomes paste-like in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: لڈوٗ بنٲوِو تیلہِ یُتھ مکسچر وُنہِ گرم آسہِ؛ گیٖوٕچ گرمی سٟتۍ چھُ یہ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان جُڑان۔
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Make laddus when the mixture is still warm; with the ghee's warmth it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: تاڑ گُڑٕکۍ ٹُکرٕ چھِ کم زیادٕ سَخ آسان، تَوے مکسرس منٛز ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ کٔرِو یِم کدوکش یا کُٹِتھ لۄکٕٹۍ۔
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces are more or less hard, so before putting in the mixer make them small by grating or pounding.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: گنہٕ گُڑ: تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ ورتٲوِو؛ رنگ آسہِ ہلکہٕ تہٕ مۄدُرر کیریمل ہِش۔
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery; colour will be light and sweetness caramel-like.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: چھۄکلہٕ سان: ورتٲوِو چھۄکلہٕ سان کرٛہنۍ ماشہٕ دال؛ سُنّنڈلو بنن گاڑھ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ زیادٕ دانہٕ دار، یِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کیٛنژن گامٕکین گرَن منٛز بنان چھِ۔
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: use black urad dal with skin; sunnundalu will become dark-coloured and more grainy, the way they are made in some village homes.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: چیٖنی سٟتۍ: گُڑٕ بدلہٕ ہیٚیِو ¾ کپ پیٖہمٕژ چیٖنی؛ لڈوٗ بنن ہلکہٕ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ ٲسس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ۔
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: instead of jaggery take ¾ cup powdered sugar; laddus will become light-coloured and melting in the mouth.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: پیش کٔرِو شامس چاے یا کافی سٟتۍ مِٹھٲیہِ پٲٹھۍ، یا سنکرانتی تہٕ دیوالی ہٕنزِ مِٹھٲیہِ تھالِ منٛز۔
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve in the evening with tea or coffee as a sweet, or in the sweet plate of Sankranti and Diwali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: تھٲوِو ہوا بنٛد اسٹیلہٕ ڈبس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 ہفتن اندر۔ گرم موسمس منٛز چھِ یِم فرجس منٛز زیادٕ کال ٹِکان؛ کھیٚنہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو یِمن کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ یِنہٕ۔
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel box at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In hot weather they keep longer in the fridge; before eating let them come to room temperature.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: میٲنۍ سُنّنڈلو کیازِ چھِ نہٕ شکل رٹان؟
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: مکسچرس چھُ بیٚیہِ گرم گیٖو ضروٗری، یا چھُ یہ شیہُل گوٚمُت۔ اَکھ زٕ چَمچ گیٖو کٔرِو گرم، رَلٲوِو تہٕ لڈوٗ بنٲوِو تیلہِ یُتھ مکسچر وُنہِ گرم آسہِ۔
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has become cold. Heat one two spoons of ghee, mix and make laddus when the mixture is still warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: کیا سُنّنڈلو ہیٚکن تاڑ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ بٔنِتھ؟
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can sunnundalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: آ۔ تاڑ گُڑ (تاٹی بیلّم) کٔرِو باریک کدوکش یا کُٹِو تہٕ ہیٚیِو گنہٕ گُڑٕ ہُند تیوٗتُے۔ لڈوٗ چھِ گاڑھ رنگٕکۍ گژھان تہٕ مزٕ گاڑھ تہٕ ذرا دُہس ہیوٗ۔
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate finely or pound palm jaggery (thati bellam) and take the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus become dark-coloured and the flavour deep and a little smoke-like.

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: ہوا بنٛد ڈبس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تقریباً 2 ہفتہٕ، تہٕ فرجس منٛز زیادٕ۔ کڈنہٕ خٲطرٕ ورتٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ یا ہۄکھۍ اَتھ۔
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: In an airtight box at room temperature about 2 weeks, and longer in the fridge. For taking out use a dry spoon or dry hands.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: ماشہٕ دال ہیٚیوٚ چھۄکلہٕ سان یا ورٲے؟
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should we take urad dal with skin or without?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: آندھرا منٛز چھِ دۄنوَے بنان۔ چھۄکلہٕ ورٲے سفید ماشہٕ دالِ سٟتۍ چھِ مۄلٲیم، ہلکہٕ بھورٕ لڈوٗ بنان؛ چھۄکلہٕ سان کرٛہنہِ ماشہٕ دالِ سٟتۍ گاڑھ تہٕ زیادٕ دانہٕ دار۔
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra both are made. With white urad dal without skin smooth, light brown laddus are made; with black urad dal with skin dark and more grainy.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: سُنّنڈلو۔ آندھرا کۍ سُنّنڈلو: بُزمٕژ ماشہٕ دال تاٹی بیلّم تاڑ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ پیٖہِتھ تہٕ گرم گیٖوَس سٟتۍ جوڑِتھ لڈوٗ۔ قدم بہ قدم طریقہٕ، مشورٕ تہٕ سوال۔
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: Sunnundalu. Andhra's sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with thati bellam palm jaggery and bound into laddus with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and questions.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: سُنّنڈلو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.7940a19ab961.t: 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: ٹوماٹو پچّڑی چھےٚ آندھرا کیٚن باورچی خانن ہٕنز پرٛتھ دۄہٕچ چٹنی: پٔکۍ ٹماٹر بُزمٕژن دالن سٟتۍ تیلس منٛز گلٲوِتھ، پتہٕ مَرچ، رۄہن تہٕ ذرا اِملی سٟتۍ موٹ پیٖہِتھ۔ واریاہ گرٕ چھِ یہ وُنہِ تہِ کَنہِ کِس سِلس (روٹی) پیٹھ پیٖہان تاکہ یہ کھردٕر تہٕ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ ہیٚنہٕ لایق بنِ، اگرچہ مکسرس منٛز لۄکٕٹین جھٹکن سٟتۍ تہِ چھُ کام گژھان۔ یہ چھےٚ گرم بتس تہٕ گیٖوَس، ڈوسا، اِڈلی تہٕ پیسرٹّو سٟتۍ چلان۔
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes softened in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on a stone slab (rolu) so it becomes coarse and fit to take with a spoon, although in a mixer with small pulses the work is also done. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: سون سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ اَتھ گاڑھ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ اَکھ برابر درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان، تہٕ ٹماٹرن سٟتۍ چھُ ذرا لیدُر پوڈر گژھان۔ یَمہِ ترکیبہِ سٟتۍ چھےٚ تقریباً 1½ کپ بنان۔
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and an even medium heat, and with the tomatoes a little turmeric powder goes. With this recipe about 1½ cups are made.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھِ پیٖہنہٕ برونٛہہ ٹماٹر شیہُل گژھنٕکۍ 5 مِنَٹ شامِل۔
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: Total time includes 5 minutes of tomatoes cooling before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: دال تہٕ میٚتھۍ بُزِو تیلس منٛز، ٹماٹر گلٲوِو لیدُر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ، پتہٕ پیٖہِو موٹ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، رۄہن تہٕ اِملی سٟتۍ۔ آخرس پیٹھ دِیِو سٔریوٚم تہٕ کڑی پتن ہُند تڑکہٕ۔
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dal and fenugreek in oil, soften tomatoes with turmeric and salt, then grind coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل ⟦1⟧مۄنگ پھلی یا تِلہٕ تیل⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ میٚتھۍ دانہٕ ⟦1⟧میٚتھۍ ہِنٛدۍ بیول؛ اَمہِ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ نہٕ، نَتہٕ چھےٚ پچّڑی ٹیوٚتھ گژھان⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧seeds of fenugreek; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 درمیانہٕ ٹماٹر ⟦1⟧تقریباً 500 g، پٔکۍ تہٕ وۄزٕلۍ، ژٹِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پچّڑی خٲطرٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تام⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: بنٛٹہٕ ہِش اِملی ⟦1⟧تقریباً 5 g، بیول کڈِتھ⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup coriander (if you want) ⟦1⟧coarsely chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: کڑاہس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل گرم۔
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: In a kadai heat 2 tablespoons oil on less than medium flame.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: ماشہٕ دال، چنہٕ دال تہٕ میٚتھۍ بُزِو تیلس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھن؛ کڈِو۔ اَتھ چھِ 2–3 مِنَٹ لگان؛ برابر ہِلٲوان روٗزِو، کیازِ میٚتھۍ چھےٚ جلدی زٔلِتھ ٹیوٚتھ گژھان۔
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil until they become golden; take out. This takes 2–3 minutes; keep stirring constantly, because fenugreek quickly burns and becomes bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: تَمی تیلس منٛز ژٕھنِو ژٹِتھ ٹماٹر تہٕ درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ ہِلٲوِو اَکھ مِنَٹ۔
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In that same oil add the chopped tomatoes and stir one minute on medium flame.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: ٹماٹر رَنِو لیدُر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ یوٗت تام یِم نرم گژھن تہٕ رَس ہۄکھِ۔ گوڈنیٚک 5 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو ڈَکُن، پتہٕ رَنِو ڈَکنہٕ ورٲے، وَقتہٕ وَقتہٕ ہِلٲوان، کُل تقریباً 12–15 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام ٹماٹر گوٗدٕ ہِشۍ گژھن تہٕ کنارَن پیٹھ تیل باسہِ۔
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook tomatoes with turmeric and salt until they become soft and the juice dries. Keep lid the first 5 minutes, then cook without lid, stirring from time to time, total about 12–15 minutes, until the tomatoes become pulpy and oil appears on the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: نار کٔرِو بنٛد، اِملی رَلٲوِو تاکہ یہ گرمی منٛز نرم گژھِ، تہٕ دِیِو سورُے تقریباً 5 مِنَٹ شیہُل گژھنہٕ۔
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the flame, mix the tamarind so it becomes soft in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: کَنہِ کِس سِلس یا مکسرٕکِس جارس منٛز پیٖہِو گوڈٕ بُزمٕژ دال تہٕ میٚتھۍ موٹہٕ پوڈرس منٛز۔
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On a stone slab or in a mixer jar first grind the roasted dal and fenugreek into a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: دال، رۄہن، اِملی، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ ٹماٹر پیٖہِو موٹ۔ مکسرس منٛز ژٕھنِو دالِ ہٕندِس پوڈرس منٛز رۄہن، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ رٔنِتھ ٹماٹر تہٕ آبہٕ ورٲے دِیِو 4–5 جھٹکہٕ؛ تیلہِ روٗکِو یُتھ یہ وُنہِ دانہٕ دار آسہِ۔ اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ رَلٲوِو دَنِوال۔
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind dal, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarse. In the mixer add to the dal powder garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes and without water give 4–5 pulses; stop when it is still grainy. If you are using, mix coriander.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: مزٕ وُچھِتھ کٔرِو ٹھیک: اَکھ چُٹکی نوٗن بیٚیہِ، یا زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ یژھِو تیٚلہِ ذرا بیٚیہِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ژٕھنِتھ اَکھ جھٹکہٕ۔
seg.6675d75425f6.back: After tasting correct: one more pinch of salt, or if you want hotter add a little more chilli powder and one pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: پچّڑی کڈِو اَکِس پیالس منٛز۔ لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز کٔرِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیل گرم تہٕ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم؛ ییلہِ یہ چٹخِ، تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو ماشہٕ دال تہٕ بُزِو یوٗت تام یہ سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھِ۔
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. In a small pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and add mustard seeds; when they crackle, then add urad dal and fry until it becomes golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: ژٕھنِو وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، یَنٛگ تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ ہِلٲوِو کیٛنژن سیکنڈن۔
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: سٔریوٚم، وۄزٕجن مَرچن تہٕ کڑی پتن ہُند تڑکہٕ دِیِو؛ پیٹھہٕ ژٕھنِو۔ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ رَلٲوِو۔
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Give a tempering of mustard seeds, red chillies and curry leaves; pour on top. Before serving mix.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: ٹماٹر رَنِو یوٗت تام رَس ہۄکھِ تاکہ پچّڑی زیادٕ کال ٹِکہِ تہٕ کٔچ باسہِ نہٕ۔
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook tomatoes until the juice dries so the pachadi keeps longer and doesn't seem raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: پٔکۍ، گاڑھ وۄزٕلۍ ٹماٹر چھِ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان رنگ دِوان؛ اگر تُہٕندۍ ٹماٹر ترٛش چھِ، تیٚلہِ کٔرِو اِملی اَڈٕ۔
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, then halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: جھٹکہٕ دِیِو، مکسر چلٲوِو نہٕ برابر: آندھرا کیٚن گرَن چھےٚ موٹ پچّڑی پسند، تہٕ باریک پیسٹس منٛز چھُ سُہ دانہٕ دار پن ختم گژھان۔
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Give pulses, don't run the mixer continuously: Andhra homes like coarse pachadi, and in a fine paste that graininess ends.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر دِوان۔ 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچو سٟتۍ کٔرِو شروٗع تہٕ مزٕ وُچھِتھ ژٕھنِو بیٚیہِ؛ پچّڑی تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ ٹیٚٹھر ذرا کم گژھان۔
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and after tasting add more; by keeping the pachadi's heat becomes a little less.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: سبز مَرچ: مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ بدلہٕ بُزِو 4–5 سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن دالن سٟتۍ۔
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder fry 4–5 green chillies with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: گنڈٕ تہٕ ٹماٹر: ٹماٹر ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ بُزِو 1 ژٹِتھ گنڈٕ یوٗت تام یہ نرم گژھِ۔
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion and tomato: before adding tomatoes fry 1 chopped onion until it becomes soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّمٕ بدلہٕ ہیٚیِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر؛ تیجا چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ، تَوے بڑٲوِو آہستہٕ آہستہٕ۔
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 teaspoon Sannam take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: رۄہنہٕ ورٲے: رۄہن ترٲوِو تہٕ تڑکس منٛز ژٕھنِو اَکھ چُٹکی یَنٛگ زیادٕ۔
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out garlic and add one more pinch of asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: اَکھ چَمچ رَلٲوِو گرم بتس تہٕ ذرا گیٖوَس منٛز، یا پیش کٔرِو ڈوسا، اِڈلی، پیسرٹّو یا اُپما سٟتۍ۔
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoon in hot rice and a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: یہ تھٲوِو اَکِس صاف، ہۄکھِس شیشہٕ جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 4 دۄہن اندر۔ ہمیشہ ورتٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ۔
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.t: آندھرا ٹوماٹو پچّڑی کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ چھِ بناوان؟
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: ماشہٕ دال، چنہٕ دال تہٕ میٚتھۍ بُزِو تیلس منٛز، ژٹِتھ ٹماٹر رَنِو لیدُر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ یوٗت تام رَس ہۄکھِ، پتہٕ پیٖہِو سورُے موٹ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، رۄہن تہٕ اِملی سٟتۍ۔ آخرس پیٹھ دِیِو سٔریوٚم، وۄزٕجہِ مَرچہِ تہٕ کڑی پتن ہُند تڑکہٕ۔
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries, then grind everything coarse with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: میٲنۍ ٹوماٹو پچّڑی کیازِ چھےٚ ٹیوٚتھ؟
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: عام طور آسہِ میٚتھۍ زٔلمٕژ یا آسہِ زیادٕ۔ 500 g ٹماٹرن خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو صرف ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تہٕ بُزِو درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ، سونہٕ رنگٕچ گژھتے کڈِو۔
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek had burnt or was too much. For 500 g tomatoes take only ¼ teaspoon and fry on less than medium flame, take out as soon as golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: کیا ٹوماٹو پچّڑی ہیٚکہٕ اِملی ورٲے بٔنِتھ؟
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can tomato pachadi be made without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: آ، اگر تُہٕندۍ ٹماٹر کٲفی ترٛش آسن۔ رَنَنہٕ پتہٕ وُچھِو مزٕ؛ پٔکین، مۄدُر ٹماٹرن چھُ توازنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِملی ہُند سُہ لۄکٕٹ ٹُکرٕ ضروٗری۔
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are quite sour. After cooking taste; ripe, sweet tomatoes need that small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.t: ٹوماٹو پچّڑی کوٚتاہ کال چھےٚ ٹِکان؟
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How long does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: صاف، ہۄکھِس جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز تقریباً 4 دۄہ، شرط چھےٚ زِ ٹماٹر آسن جان پٲٹھۍ گلٲوِتھ رَنِتھ تہٕ تۄہۍ ورتاوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ۔
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: In a clean, dry jar in the fridge about 4 days, the condition is that the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: ٹوماٹو پچّڑی۔ آندھرا ٹوماٹو پچّڑی: ٹماٹر لیدُر پوڈرس سٟتۍ گلٲوِتھ، سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، رۄہن تہٕ اِملی سٟتۍ موٹ پیٖہِتھ، پتہٕ تڑکہٕ دِتھ۔
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: Tomato Pachadi. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes softened with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: ٹوماٹو پچّڑی: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو چھےٚ آندھرا کیٚن گرَن ہٕنز پرٛتھ دۄہٕچ دال: ارہر دال (کندی پپّو) ٹماٹرن تہٕ سبز مَرچن سٟتۍ نرم رَنِتھ، ہموار مَسلِتھ تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ رۄہنٕ تڑکہٕ دِتھ۔ یہ چھےٚ ہفتس منٛز زیادٕ تر دۄہ بنان تہٕ گرم بتس، اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس تہٕ سٟتۍ اپّڈم یا آچارس سٟتۍ کھیٚنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and at the end given a garlic tempering. It is made most days in the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and alongside appadam or pickle.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: سون لیدُر پوڈر چھُ دالِ سٟتۍ کُکرس منٛز گژھان تہٕ اَتھ گاڑھ پیٖلہٕ رنگ دِوان۔ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ ہلکہٕ وۄزُل رنگ تہٕ اَکھ برابر درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر اَنان یۄسہٕ ترٛش ٹماٹرٕ پتھ کُن روزان چھےٚ۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder brings a light red colour and an even medium heat which stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھُ کُکرٕچ ٹٲرِ نیرنُک وقت شامِل۔
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: Total time includes the time of the cooker's steam coming out.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: ارہر دال رَنِو پریشرس منٛز ٹماٹر، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس سٟتۍ، مَسلِو یہ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ، تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ دِیِو رۄہن تہٕ سٔریوٚم تڑکہٕ۔
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook toor dal in pressure with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end give a garlic and mustard seed tempering.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ کپ ارہر دال ⟦1⟧کندی پپّو، تقریباً 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ لیدُر پوڈر ⟦1⟧کُکرس منٛز گژھان⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧مَسلنہٕ پتہٕ ژٕھنِو؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تام⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧add after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ کپ آب ⟦1⟧تہٕ ½ کپ ضرورت مطابق⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup as needed⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ اِملی آب (یژھِو تیٚلہِ) ⟦1⟧اگر ٹماٹر واریاہ ترٛش آسن نہٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (if you want) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: ارہر دال چھٔلِو 2–3 لٹہٕ آبس منٛز تہٕ آب کڈِو۔
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: دال ژٕھنِو پریشر کُکرس منٛز ٹماٹر، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن، گنڈٕ تہٕ 2½ کپ آبس سٟتۍ۔
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: دال رَنِو پریشرس منٛز ٹماٹر، سبز مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ لیدُر پوڈرس سٟتۍ 4 سیٖٹی تام۔ ڈَکُن بنٛد کرنہٕ برونٛہہ رَلٲوِو لیدُر پوڈر آبس منٛز، پتہٕ رَنِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal in pressure with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder up to 4 whistles. Before closing the lid mix turmeric powder in the water, then cook on medium flame.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ، تقریباً 10 مِنَٹ۔ دال چھےٚ تیار تیلہِ یُتھ اَکھ دانہٕ زٕ اوٚنگجین درمیان پورٕ پٲٹھۍ مَسلہٕ گژھِ۔
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure come down by itself, about 10 minutes. The dal is ready when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: جان پٲٹھۍ مَسلِو؛ ژٕھنِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن۔ لۄکٕڑ مَسلن وول (پپّو گُتّی) یا کَفگیرٕ کہِ پتہٕ کِنہِ مَسلِو دال گرم آسنہٕ وِزِے، یوٗت تام ٹماٹر تہٕ دال رَلِتھ اَکھ ہموار مکسچر بنن۔
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. With a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle mash while the dal is still hot, until tomatoes and dal mix into one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: ذرا آب ژٕھنِتھ رَنِو 5 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ۔ ژٕھنَنہٕ لایق گاڑھرِ خٲطرٕ ژٕھنِو ½ کپ تام آب، تہٕ اگر ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ اِملی آب، تہٕ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت تاکہ یہ تلس لگِ نہٕ۔
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Adding a little water cook 5 minutes on low flame. For a pourable thickness add up to ½ cup water, and if you are using, tamarind water, and keep the flame low so it doesn't stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: نوٗن تہٕ ترٛشرِ ہُند مزٕ وُچھِو، پتہٕ رَلٲوِو دَنِوال تہٕ نار کٔرِو بنٛد۔
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste the salt and sourness, then mix coriander and turn off the flame.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: لۄکٕٹِس پینس منٛز کٔرِو درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ گیٖو گرم تہٕ ژٕھنِو سٔریوٚم؛ دِیِو چٹخنہٕ۔
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: In a small pan heat ghee on medium flame and add mustard seeds; let crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: سٔریوٚم، زیٖرٕ، رۄہن تہٕ کڑی پتہٕ بُزِو گیٖوَس منٛز؛ پیٹھہٕ ژٕھنِو۔ سٔریوٚم پتہٕ ژٕھنِو زیٖرٕ، رۄہن تہٕ ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ بُزِو یوٗت تام رۄہن سونہٕ رنگُک گژھِ، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو کڑی پتہٕ تہٕ یَنٛگ، تہٕ شَرشَران تڑکہٕ ژٕھنِو دالِ پیٹھ۔
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard seeds, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour on top. After the mustard seeds add cumin, garlic and dry red chillies and fry until the garlic becomes golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: 2 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تاکہ تڑکُک مزٕ دالِ منٛز یِیہِ، پتہٕ رَلٲوِتھ پیش کٔرِو گرم۔
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Keep lid 2 minutes so the tempering's flavour comes into the dal, then mix and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: ہموار پپّو خٲطرٕ مَسلِو دال گرم آسنہٕ وِزِے۔ شیہُل گژھنہٕ پتہٕ چھِ دانہٕ جمان تہٕ گُتھہٕ روزان۔
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For smooth pappu mash the dal while it is hot. After cooling the grains set and lumps remain.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھ۔ 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچہٕ سٟتۍ کٔرِو شروٗع؛ زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پپّو خٲطرٕ 2 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تام۔
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: پٔکۍ، ترٛش دیسی ٹماٹر (ناٹو ٹماٹا) چھِ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان مزٕ دِوان؛ ہلکہٕ مزٕکین ہائبرڈ ٹماٹرن سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو اِملی آب۔
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomata) give the best flavour; with mild-flavoured hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: کڑی پتہٕ ژٕھنَنہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو تڑکس منٛز رۄہن سونہٕ رنگُک گژھنہٕ؛ سفید رۄہن چھُ کوٚچ باسان۔
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Before adding curry leaves let the garlic become golden in the tempering; white garlic seems raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر: زیادٕ ٹیٚٹھ پپّو خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو سنّمٕ بدلہٕ ½ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ تیجا چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ، تَوے ژٕھنِو نہٕ 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچہٕ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ۔
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu take ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so don't add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: پالاکورا ٹوماٹو پپّو: مَسلنہٕ پتہٕ ژٕھنِو دالِ منٛز 2 کپ ژٹِتھ پالَکھ تہٕ رَنِو 5 مِنَٹ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ۔
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and cook 5 minutes on low flame.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: پیسرپپّو: یہ بنٲوِو پیٖلہِ مۄنٛگ دالِ سٟتۍ تہٕ رَنِو صرف 2 سیٖٹی تام۔
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook only up to 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: پیش کٔرِو گرم بتس، اَکِس چَمچہٕ گیٖوَس تہٕ سٟتۍ اپّڈم یا آوکایا سٟتۍ۔ یہ چھےٚ چپاتی سٟتۍ تہِ جان لگان۔
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with rice, a spoon of ghee and alongside appadam or avakaya. It also goes well with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: بچمٕژ دال تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ شیہُل گژھنہٕ سٟتۍ چھےٚ دال گاڑھ گژھان؛ پیش کرنہٕ برونٛہہ ژٕھنِو ذرا گرم آب تہٕ کٔرِو جان پٲٹھۍ گرم۔
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftover dal covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On cooling the dal becomes thick; before serving add a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: پریشر کُکرس منٛز ارہر دالِ خٲطرٕ کیٚتۍ سیٖٹی؟
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in the pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: درمیانہٕ نارس پیٹھ تقریباً 4 سیٖٹی، پتہٕ دِیِو پریشر پانَے وَسنہٕ۔ پرانِس دالِ یا جان پٲٹھۍ نہٕ چھٔلنہٕ آمژِ دالِ ہیٚکن 5 لٲگِتھ۔
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium flame, then let the pressure come down by itself. Old dal or not well-washed dal can take 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو تہٕ سامبرس منٛز کیا فرق چھُ؟
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو چھےٚ گاڑھ، مَسلِتھ دال یَتھ منٛز سادٕ تڑکہٕ آسان چھُ، نہٕ سامبر پوڈر تہٕ نہٕ سبزی۔ سامبر چھُ پتلہٕ، تہٕ اَتھ منٛز چھےٚ اِملی، سبزی تہٕ بُزمٕتین مسالن ہُند پوڈر گژھان۔
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal in which there is a simple tempering, neither sambar powder nor vegetables. Sambar is thin, and in it tamarind, vegetables and powder of roasted spices go.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: کیا ٹوماٹو پپّو ہیٚکہٕ پریشر کُکرٕ ورٲے بٔنِتھ؟
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can tomato pappu be made without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: آ۔ دال بِگرٲوِو 30 مِنَٹ تہٕ ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ دیگچس منٛز 3½ کپ آبس سٟتۍ رَنِو تقریباً 40–45 مِنَٹ، وَقتہٕ وَقتہٕ ہِلٲوان، یوٗت تام یہ آسٲنی سان مَسلہٕ گژھِ۔
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring from time to time, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: میٲنۍ ٹوماٹو پپّو کیازِ چھےٚ واریاہ ترٛش؟
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: کیٛنہہ ٹماٹر چھِ واریاہ ترٛش آسان۔ دال رَنِو کیٛنہہ مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تہٕ توازنہٕ خٲطرٕ رَلٲوِو اَکھ چُٹکی گُڑ یا اَکھ چَمچ بیٚیہِ مَسلِتھ دال۔
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Cook the dal some minutes more on low flame and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or one more spoon of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو · آندھرا ٹماٹرٕ دالِ ہٕنز ترکیب | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: Tomato Pappu · Recipe of Andhra tomato dal | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو۔ آندھرا ٹماٹرٕ دال: ارہر دال ٹماٹر تہٕ سبز مَرچن، سانہِ لیدُر تہٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ نرم رَنِتھ، تہٕ رۄہنٕ تڑکہٕ۔ 4 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: Tomato Pappu. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: ٹوماٹو پپّو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.87c5b474feae.t: پوڈی · تقریباً ¾ کپ چھُ بنان
seg.87c5b474feae.back: Podi · about ¾ cup is made

seg.ad6a2d550d34.t: ویلّولّی کارم ⟦1⟧(آندھرا رۄہن تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر)⟦/1⟧
seg.ad6a2d550d34.back: Vellulli Karam ⟦1⟧(Andhra garlic and chilli powder)⟦/1⟧

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ویلّولّی کارم · لہسن کی سوکھی چٹنی
seg.9078b361da10.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Karam · Lehsun ki sookhi chutney

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: ویلّولّی کارم چھےٚ رۄہن تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگنٕچ سۄ پوڈی یۄسہٕ آندھرا کیٚن کھیٚنٕکین میزن پیٹھ تھاونہٕ یِوان چھےٚ: وۄزٕج مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر واریاہ رۄہنہٕ، بُزمٕتین دَنِوالٕ بیولن، زیٖرس تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ کُٹِتھ۔ گرم بتٕکین گوڈنیٚکین نیٚوالن منٛز گیٖوَس سٟتۍ رَلٲوِتھ، یا اِڈلی تہٕ ڈوسا پیٹھ ذرا تیلس سٟتۍ ژٕھکِتھ، چھےٚ یہ مصروف دۄہن جلدی کھیٚن تہٕ ٹفن باکسن ہٕنز پرٛتھ دۄہٕچ چیز۔
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is that garlic and chilli podi which is kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander seeds, cumin and salt. Mixed with ghee in the first mouthfuls of hot rice, or sprinkled on idli and dosa with a little oil, it is the quick meal of busy days and an everyday thing of tiffin boxes.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: سون تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ اَتھ گاڑھ وۄزُل تہٕ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ بناوان، یِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ گنٹورٕکین گرَن پسند چھُ۔ کم ٹیٚٹھرِ خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو اَڈٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like. For less heat take half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: کُل وقتس منٛز چھُ پیٖہنہٕ برونٛہہ بیول تہٕ رۄہن شیہُل کرُن شامِل۔
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: Total time includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: دَنِوالٕ بیول تہٕ زیٖرٕ بُزِتھ پیٖہِو، پتہٕ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، نوٗن تہٕ ذرا گرم کٔرِتھ رۄہن ژٕھنِتھ دِیِو جھٹکہٕ تہٕ بنٲوِو موٹ پوڈی۔ یہ کھیٚیِو گرم بتس تہٕ گیٖوَس، اِڈلی یا ڈوسا سٟتۍ۔
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin and grind, then add Teja chilli powder, salt and slightly warmed garlic, pulse and make a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 رۄہنٕ دانہٕ ⟦1⟧تقریباً ½ کپ، چھٔلِتھ؛ اندرٕم پتلہٕ چھۄکلہٕ ہیٚکہٕ روزِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the inner thin skin can stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ کپ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ⟦1⟧واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ کم ٹیٚٹھ بناونہٕ خٲطرٕ وُچھِو مشورٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; to make less hot see the tips⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 لۄکٕٹِس بنٛٹس ہِش اِملی (یژھِو تیٚلہِ) ⟦1⟧ہۄکھ، بیول کڈِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: Tamarind like 1 small marble (if you want) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: گیٖو یا تیل ⟦1⟧پرٛتھ حصس خٲطرٕ 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for each portion⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: رۄہن چھٔلِو تہٕ دانہٕ کٔرِو کپڑس سٟتۍ تھپتھپٲوِتھ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ؛ ذرا آب تہِ چھُ پوڈی ہُند ٹِکُن کم کران۔
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; even a little water reduces the keeping of the podi.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: دَنِوالٕ بیول تہٕ زیٖرٕ بُزِو تیلہٕ ورٲے یوٗت تام خۄشبوے یِیہِ؛ شیہُل گژھنہٕ دِیِو۔ درمیانہٕ کھۄتہٕ کم نارس پیٹھ ورتٲوِو لۄکٕٹ پین؛ اَتھ چھِ 1–2 مِنَٹ لگان، تہٕ دَنِوالٕ بیول گژھن اَکھ درجہٕ گاڑھ گژھِنۍ، بھورٕ نہٕ۔
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin without oil until aroma comes; let cool. Use a small pan on less than medium flame; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander seeds should become one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: رۄہن کٔرِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ تیلس منٛز 2 مِنَٹ گرم۔ نار تھٲوِو لوٚت تہٕ ہِلٲوِو؛ دانن ہٕندۍ کنارٕ گژھن ذرا نرم گژھِنۍ مگر بھورٕ نہٕ۔ شیہُل گژھنہٕ دِیِو۔
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil 2 minutes. Keep the flame low and stir; the edges of the cloves should become a little soft but not brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: بیول پیٖہِو پوڈرس منٛز، پتہٕ دِیِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ جھٹکہٕ۔ اگر اِملی ورتاوان چھِو تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو یہ بیولن سٟتۍ تاکہ یہ برابر پیٖہنہٕ یِیہِ۔
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds into powder, then pulse with chilli powder and salt. If you are using tamarind, then add it with the seeds so it grinds evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: ژٕھنِو رۄہن تہٕ لۄکٕٹین جھٹکن منٛز بنٲوِو موٹ، نَم پوڈر۔ پرٛتھ 2–3 جھٹکن پتہٕ روٗکِتھ کھرچِو جارٕکۍ کنارٕ، کیازِ رۄہن چھُ دیوارن سٟتۍ لگان۔
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add garlic and in small pulses make a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 pulses stop and scrape the jar's edges, because garlic sticks to the walls.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: کَنہِ کِس اوکھلس منٛز کُٹِو گوڈٕ بیول، پتہٕ نوٗنس سٟتۍ رۄہن، تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ رَلٲوِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar pound first the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: اَکھ چُٹکی مزٕ وُچھِو ذرا بتس تہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، تہٕ ضرورت آسہِ تیٚلہِ ژٕھنِو نوٗن۔
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: پوڈی پھہلٲوِو 10 مِنَٹ اَکِس تھالس منٛز تاکہ ٹٲرِ نیرِ، پتہٕ بٔرِو یہ اَکِس صاف، ہۄکھِس جارس منٛز۔
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi 10 minutes on a plate so the steam comes out, then fill it into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: تیجا چھُ واریاہ ٹیٚٹھ؛ کم ٹیٚٹھ پوڈی خٲطرٕ ہیٚیِو اَڈٕ سنّم، یا تیوٗتس رۄہنس خٲطرٕ کٔرِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ۔
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi take half Sannam, or for the same garlic make the chilli powder 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: رۄہن کٔرِو جان پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ تہٕ تیلس منٛز گرم؛ نَم رۄہن چھُ پوڈی جلدی خراب کران۔
seg.948075d5f572.back: Make the garlic well dry and warm it in oil; moist garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: جھٹکہٕ دِیِو، مکسر چلٲوِو نہٕ برابر: ڈیر کال چلٲوِو تیٚلہِ چھُ رۄہن پیسٹ بنان۔
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Give pulses, don't run the mixer continuously: if you run it long the garlic becomes paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: اَکِس کپس گرم بتس منٛز رَلٲوِو 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ پوڈی تہٕ 1 لۄکٕٹ چَمچ گیٖو؛ مزٕ مطابق کٔرِو کم زیادٕ۔
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: In one cup of hot rice mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee; make less or more according to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: دالن سٟتۍ: زیادٕ سوندھ تہٕ ذرا کم ٹیٚٹھ پوڈی خٲطرٕ بُزِو بیولن سٟتۍ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ چنہٕ دال تہٕ 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ ماشہٕ دال تیلہٕ ورٲے۔
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: for a more nutty and slightly less hot podi roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal with the seeds without oil.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: کوٚچ رۄہن: زیادٕ تیز مزٕ خٲطرٕ کٔرِو نہٕ رۄہن گرم، تہٕ کھیٚیِو یہ اَکِس ہفتس اندر۔
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper flavour don't warm the garlic, and eat it within one week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: درمیانہٕ ٹیٚٹھر: ہیٚیِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ تیجا تہٕ 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: take 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: رَلٲوِو گرم بتٕکین گوڈنیٚکین نیٚوالن تہٕ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ، یا ژٕھکِو اِڈلی، ڈوسا یا پیسرٹّو پیٹھ ذرا تیل یا گیٖوَس سٟتۍ۔
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with the first mouthfuls of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle on idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: تھٲوِو صاف، ہۄکھِس، ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تقریباً 2 ہفتہٕ، یا فرجس منٛز اَکھ رٮ۪تھ۔ ہمیشہ ورتٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ۔
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge one month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?
seg.c58bc6538b2f.t: ویلّولّی کارم کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ چھِ بناوان؟

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: دَنِوالٕ بیول تہٕ زیٖرٕ بُزِتھ پیٖہِو، ژٕھنِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن، پتہٕ چھٔلِتھ رۄہنٕ دانہٕ ژٕھنِتھ دِیِو جھٹکہٕ تہٕ بنٲوِو موٹ، نَم پوڈر۔ آندھرا کیٚن گرَن منٛز چھِ یہ اکثر کَنہِ کِس اوکھلس منٛز کُٹان۔
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin and grind, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves, pulse and make a coarse, moist powder. In Andhra homes it is often pounded in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: رۄہنٕ پوڈی کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ بناوَو کم ٹیٚٹھ؟
seg.727d415cb888.back: How do we make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: اَڈٕ تیجا بدلہٕ ہیٚیِو اَڈٕ سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، یا کُل ہیٚیِو 3 بوٚڑ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ واریاہ گیٖوَس سٟتۍ کھیٚنہٕ سٟتۍ تہِ چھےٚ ٹیٚٹھر کم گژھان۔
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Instead of half the Teja take half Sannam chilli powder, or in total take 3 tablespoons chilli powder. Eating with plenty of ghee also reduces the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.t: ویلّولّی کارم کوٚتاہ کال چھُ ٹِکان؟
seg.982e854e4417.back: How long does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: ہۄکھِس، ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تقریباً 2 ہفتہٕ، یا فرجس منٛز اَکھ رٮ۪تھ۔ رۄہن کٔرِو جان پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ تہٕ گوڈٕ تیلس منٛز گرم تاکہ یہ زیادٕ کال ٹِکہِ۔
seg.a620f29950c0.back: In a dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge one month. Make the garlic well dry and first warm it in oil so it keeps longer.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: کیا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕ بدلہٕ ہیٚکہٕ سالِم ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن ورتٲوِتھ؟
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can whole dry red chillies be used instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: آ۔ تقریباً 20 ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن بُزِو تیلٕکین کیٛنژن قطرن سٟتۍ یوٗت تام یِم کرکرٕ گژھن، شیہُل کٔرِتھ پیٖہِو، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو رۄہن۔
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dry red chillies with a few drops of oil until they become crisp, cool and grind, then add the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: ویلّولّی کارم۔ آندھرا رۄہن تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈی: بُزمٕتۍ دَنِوالٕ بیول تہٕ زیٖرٕ رۄہن، نوٗن تہٕ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس سٟتۍ کُٹِتھ۔ رَلٲوِتھ کھیٚیِو گرم بتس تہٕ گیٖوَس، یا اِڈلی تہٕ ڈوسا سٟتۍ۔
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: Vellulli Karam. Andhra garlic and chilli podi: roasted coriander seeds and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Eat mixed with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.5a3c1bf438cc.t: ویلّولّی کارم (آندھرا رۄہن تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر) · 1acrefarms
seg.5a3c1bf438cc.back: Vellulli Karam (Andhra garlic and chilli powder) · 1acrefarms

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: ویلّولّی کارم: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.a09662135f29.t: ¼ کپ تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر

seg.2b0c8026598d.back: Tamarind like 1 small marble (if you want)

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: کُکرس مَلِو دٔہۍ، تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر، لیدُر پوڈر تہٕ نوٗن۔ 30 مِنَٹ تھٲوِو۔ برتن تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ، تہٕ یوٚت تام یہ تھوٚوُمُت آسہِ، تھٲوِو یہ فرجس منٛز۔
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt on the chicken. Keep it 30 minutes. Keep the vessel covered, and for as long as it is kept, keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ ٹُکرٕ ⟦1⟧سَخ ماز وٲجِنہِ گاڑِ ہِنٛدۍ موٹۍ ٹُکرٕ: روہو، کتلا (بوچّا)، کورامینو (مَرل) یا سیر فِش (ونجرم)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧thick pieces of firm-fleshed fish: rohu, katla (bochha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g اِملی ⟦1⟧لیمبہٕ ہِوۍ تقریباً زٕ گولہٕ، 2 کپ ووشنِس آبس منٛز 15 مِنَٹ بِگرٲوِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of warm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ پینس منٛز کٔرِو لوٚتہِ پٲٹھۍ، ہِلٲوِتھ ورٲے، یوٗت تام گرم زِ اندرٕ تام پوٗرٕ پٲٹھۍ ٹٲرِ نیرِ۔
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Keep the leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Do it in a pan slowly, without stirring, until hot so that steam comes out fully all the way to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: دریاوٕچ یا سمندرٕچ سَخ ماز وٲجِنۍ گاڑ، موٹین ٹُکرن منٛز ژٹِتھ: روہو، کتلا (بوچّا)، مَرل (کورامینو) یا سیر فِش۔ کنڈَو وٲجِنۍ لۄکٕٹۍ گاڑ تہِ چھےٚ چلان مگر یِمن چھُ آہستہٕ سنبالُن پیوان۔
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, katla (bochha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Small fish with bones also work but they have to be handled gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: بچمُت سالن تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 2 دۄہن اندر۔ پُلوسو کٔرِو پینس منٛز ذرا آب ژٕھنِتھ یوٗت تام گرم زِ اندرٕ تام پوٗرٕ پٲٹھۍ ٹٲرِ نیرِ۔
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Keep the leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan adding a little water until hot so that steam comes out fully all the way to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: مٹن ویپُڈو: 500 g اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے ماز رَنِو میرینیڈ تہٕ ½ کپ آبس سٟتۍ پریشرس منٛز 5–6 سیٖٹی تام، یوٗت تام یہ نرم گژھِ، پتہٕ بُزِو یہ تِتھے پٲٹھۍ۔
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless meat with the marinade and ½ cup water in the pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, until it becomes soft, then fry it the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: دۄنوَے چھِ چلان۔ اَڈِجہٕ ورٲے چھُ جلدی رَنہٕ گژھان تہٕ زیادٕ کرکرٕ بنان؛ اَڈِج سان لۄکٕٹین ٹُکرن منٛز چھُ مزٕ زیادٕ مگر پنٕنِس رَسس منٛز چھِ 6–8 مِنَٹ زیادٕ لگان۔
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but take 6–8 minutes more in their own juice.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: لنچ باکسس منٛز یا لۄکٕٹِس سفرس خٲطرٕ پیک کٔرِتھ کھیٚیِو یہ تقریباً 4 گنٛٹن اندر۔ بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو اَکِس دۄہس اندر۔
seg.d20a641bec03.back: Packed in a lunch box or for a short journey, eat it within about 4 hours. Keep the leftover covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: یا آسہِ لیمبہٕ رَس رَنہٕ گوٚمُت یا آسہِ لیدُر تیلس منٛز زٔلمُت۔ لیدُر ژٕھنِو سارِوٕے پتہٕ، تمہِ پتہٕ کٔرِو فوراً چوٗلہٕ بنٛد تہٕ ہِلٲوِو صرف 5–10 سیکنڈ؛ لیمبہٕ رَس ژٕھنِو نارس پیٹھہٕ وٲلِتھ بتس منٛز۔
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice has got cooked or the turmeric has burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric at the very end, after that immediately turn off the stove and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice after taking it off the fire.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: باقی اَکھ کپ آب ژٕھنِو گوٚب تلہٕ وٲلِس پینس منٛز؛ پَتلِس پینس منٛز چھےٚ راگی تلس لگان۔
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Put the remaining one cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: کیا راگی جاوا منٛز ہیٚکہٕ گنہٕ گُڑ ژٕھنِتھ؟
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be added to ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: آ۔ ہیٚیِو تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ (چیرُکو بیلّم) تہٕ چوٗلہٕ بنٛد کرنہٕ پتہٕ رَلٲوِو، تاکہ دۄد پُھٹِ نہٕ۔ اَمہِ سٟتۍ چھُ رنگ ہلکہٕ تہٕ مۄدُرر ہلکہٕ، کیریمل ہِش گژھان۔
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after turning off the stove, so that the milk does not split. With this the colour becomes lighter and the sweetness light, caramel-like.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: بچمُت تھٲوِو ڈَکُن تھٲوِتھ فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 1 دۄہس اندر۔ پینس منٛز کٔرِو صرف تیوٗت گرم زِ اندرٕ تام پوٗرٕ پٲٹھۍ ٹٲرِ نیرِ؛ زیادٕ کال گرم کرنہٕ سٟتۍ چھِ جھینگہٕ سَخ گژھان۔
