seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Keep the leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only so much that steam comes out fully all the way to the inside; heating for a long time makes the prawns hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: کیا سُنّنڈلو ہیٚکن گنہٕ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ بٔنِتھ؟
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: آ۔ گنہٕ گُڑ (چیرُکو بیلّم) کٔرِو باریک کدوکش تہٕ ہیٚیِو تاڑ گُڑٕ ہُند تیوٗتُے۔ لڈوٗ چھِ ہلکہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھان، تہٕ مۄدُرر ہلکہٕ، کیریمل ہِش۔
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate the sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and take the same amount as the palm jaggery. The laddus become light in colour, and the sweetness light, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: کوٚچ رۄہن: زیادٕ تیز مزٕ خٲطرٕ کٔرِو نہٕ رۄہن گرم؛ یہ تھٲوِو فرجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو 3 دۄہن اندر۔
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not heat the garlic; keep it in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: یہ تھٲوِو اَکِس صاف، ہۄکھِس، ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز تہٕ ورتٲوِو 2 ہفتن اندر۔ ہمیشہ ورتٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ۔
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep it in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: ہۄکھِس، ہوا بنٛد جارس منٛز فرجس منٛز 2 ہفتن تام۔ رۄہن کٔرِو جان پٲٹھۍ ہۄکھ تہٕ گوڈٕ تیلس منٛز گرم، تہٕ ہمیشہ ورتٲوِو ہۄکھ چَمچ۔
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight jar. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: آ۔ تقریباً 20 ہۄکھۍ وۄزٕجہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن بُزِو تیلٕکین کیٛنژن قطرن منٛز یوٗت تام یِم کرکرٕ گژھن، شیہُل کٔرِتھ پیٖہِو، پتہٕ ژٕھنِو رۄہن۔
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until they become crisp, cool and grind them, then add the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.t: بیلّم اٹوکولو ⟦1⟧(تاڑ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ مۄدُر پوہا)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet poha with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: بیلّم اٹوکولو چھےٚ تیلگو گرن ہٕنز 10 مِنَٹن ہٕنز مِٹھٲے۔ یہ چھُ سُہ پوہا یُس کرشناشٹمی پیٹھ کرشنس چڑھاونہٕ چھُ یِوان، کُچیلا سٕنٛدِ تحفُک یاد کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ، تہٕ یہ چھےٚ سکوٗلہٕ پتہٕ شُرن خٲطرٕ جلدی بنن وٲجِنۍ مِٹھٲے تہِ۔ پوہا چھُ صرف چھلنہٕ یِوان، آبس منٛز کُنہِ تہِ رنٛنہٕ یِوان نہٕ، پتہٕ چھُ گُڑٕ کِس گرم شیرس منٛز ہلکہٕ پٲٹھۍ رَلاونہٕ یِوان۔
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. This is that poha which is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, to remember Kuchela's gift, and this is also a quickly-made sweet for children after school. The poha is only washed, it is never cooked in water, then it is mixed lightly into the warm syrup of jaggery.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: سون تاٹی بیلّم یعنی تاڑ گُڑ چھُ اَتھ گاڑھ بھورٕ رنگ تہٕ بھرپور، ذرا دُہس ہِش مِٹھاس دِوان۔ یہ ترکیب چھےٚ 2 لُکن خٲطرٕ۔
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our taati bellam, that is palm jaggery, gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoke-like sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: تیاری منٛز چھِ چھلنہٕ آمتِس پوہس نرم گژھنہٕ خٲطرٕ 5 مِنَٹ تہِ شامِل۔
seg.25e28614accb.back: In the preparation the 5 minutes for the washed poha to become soft are also included.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: موٹ پوہا کٔرِو نرم، اَتھ رَلٲوِو نارجیٖل تہٕ الٲچی سٟتۍ تاڑ گُڑٕ کِس گرم شیرس منٛز ہلکہٕ پٲٹھۍ، تہٕ آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو گیٖو۔
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Make the thick poha soft, mix it lightly with coconut and cardamom into the warm syrup of palm jaggery, and at the end put in ghee.

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ ⟦1⟧تقریباً 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل ⟦1⟧صرف سفید حصہٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ الٲچی پوڈر ⟦1⟧یا 2–3 الٲچیَن ہٕندۍ پِشمٕتۍ دانہٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or ground seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.t: 6–8 کاجو، مرضی مطٲبق ⟦1⟧گیٖوس منٛز سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ تٔلِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.5f1854fd1277.back: 6–8 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧fried golden-coloured in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: پوہا ژٕھنِو چھلنی منٛز تہٕ چارِتھ کڈِو بُھسہٕ کیٛن ٹُکرن۔
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out the pieces of husk.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: پوہا چھلِو چھلنی منٛز پکوٚن آبس تَل کیٛنہہ سیکنڈ، آب کڈِو، تہٕ تراوِو 5 مِنَٹ نرم گژھنہٕ خٲطرٕ۔ دَباونہٕ سٟتۍ پَزِ نرم باسُن، مگر ووٚد پَزِ نہٕ آسُن۔
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the poha in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, take out the water, and leave 5 minutes to become soft. On pressing it should feel soft, but it should not be wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: تاڑ گُڑ کٔرِو باریک کدوکش، تہٕ سخت ڈَلہٕ پھٕٹرِو۔
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, and break the hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: تاڑ گُڑ گلٲوِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ آبس سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، پتہٕ چھٲنِو۔ پین کٔرِو صاف تہٕ شیرٕ ترٲوِو واپس اَتھ منٛز۔
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low fire, then strain. Clean the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: اگر توٚہہ کاجو ورتٲوان چھِو، تیٚلہِ تٔلِو یِم ذرا گیٖوس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن۔
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If you are using cashews, then fry them a little in ghee until they become golden-coloured.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: پوہا، نارجیٖل تہٕ الٲچی ژٕھنِو گرم شیرس منٛز تہٕ رَلٲوِو ہلکہٕ اَتھہٕ سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ 1–2 مِنَٹ، یوٗت تام پوہُک پرٛتھ دانہٕ شیرس سٟتۍ ووٚلِتھ گژھِ۔ اَتھ تھٲوِو ہلکہٕ تاکہ دانہٕ پھٕٹن نہٕ۔
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Put the poha, coconut and cardamom in the warm syrup and mix with a light hand on low fire 1–2 minutes, until every grain of poha gets wrapped in the syrup. Keep the hand light so that the grains do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: یِتھے دانہٕ شیرس سٟتۍ ووٚلِتھ گژھن، پین وٲلِو نارِ پیٹھہٕ؛ زیادٕ رنٛنہٕ سٟتۍ گژھن یِم ژاپنس منٛز ربڑ ہِوۍ۔
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the grains get wrapped in syrup, take the pan off the fire; by cooking more they become rubber-like in chewing.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: آخرس پیٹھ ژٕھنِو گیٖو تہٕ کاجو۔ گرم یا کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ کٔرِو پیش۔
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: At the end put in ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: موٹ پوہا ورتٲوِو۔ پتلہٕ پوہا چھُ شیرس منٛز گلِتھ لیٚس گژھان۔
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick poha. Thin poha melts in the syrup and becomes mush.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: پوہا مہٕ تھٲوِو آبہٕ پیالس منٛز ترِتھ؛ جلدی چھلُن چھُ کٲفی، نتہٕ گژھِ یہ نرم تہٕ چِپچِپہٕ۔
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not keep the poha soaked in a bowl of water; quickly washing is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: پوہا ژٕھناونہٕ وِزِ تھٲوِو شیرٕ گرم، گرٛکان نہٕ، تاکہ سارنٕے دانن پیٹھ لگِ برابر۔
seg.972f174730fe.back: When putting in the poha keep the syrup warm, not boiling, so that it sticks evenly on all the grains.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: دودٕ سٟتۍ: زیادٕ نرم مِٹھٲیہِ خٲطرٕ ترٲوِو تیار پوہس پیٹھ 2–3 بوٚڑ چَمچ گرم دودٕ۔
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, pour 2–3 big spoons of warm milk on the ready poha.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: تِلن سٟتۍ: نارجیٖلس سٟتۍ ژٕھنِو 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ بُزمٕتۍ تِل۔
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: with the coconut put in 1 big spoon of roasted sesame.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: یہ کٔرِو کرشناشٹمی پیٹھ نیویدیم ہِیُو پیش، یا سکوٗلہٕ پتہٕ شُرن خٲطرٕ جلدی بنن وٲجِنۍ مِٹھٲے ہِش۔
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve this like naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or like a quickly-made sweet for children after school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: یُس دۄہ بنٲوِو تمی دۄہ کھیٚیُن چھُ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان۔ بچیومُت تھٲوِو ڈھٲکِتھ فرِجس منٛز تہٕ کھیٚیِو دوٚیِمِس دۄہ؛ تھاونہٕ سٟتۍ چھُ پوہا سخت گژھان۔
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Eating it the same day you make it is best of all. Keep the leftover covered in the fridge and eat on the second day; by keeping, the poha becomes hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: بیلّم اٹوکولو خٲطرٕ کُس پوہا چھُ سارِوے کھۄتہٕ جان؟
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which poha is best of all for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: موٹ پوہا (اٹوکولو)۔ یہ چھُ گرم شیرس منٛز پنٕنۍ شکل برقرار تھاوان؛ پتلہٕ پوہا چھُ گلِتھ لیٚس گژھان۔
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick poha (atukulu). It keeps its own shape in warm syrup; thin poha melts and becomes mush.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: کیا بہٕ ہیٚکہٕ بیلّم اٹوکولو گنہٕ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ بنٲوِتھ؟
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can I make Bellam Atukulu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: آ۔ تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ (چیروکو بیلّم) ورتٲوِو۔ رنگ گژھِ ہلکہٕ، تہٕ مِٹھاس کیریمل ہِش۔
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). The colour will become lighter, and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: میون بیلّم اٹوکولو کیازِ چھُ چِپچِپہٕ؟
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why is my Bellam Atukulu sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: پوہا اوس ترِتھ تھوومُت یا واریاہ وقت رٔنِتھ۔ اَتھ چھلِو صرف کیٛنہہ سیکنڈ، تہٕ یِتھے پرٛتھ دانہٕ شیرس سٟتۍ ووٚلِتھ گژھِ، پین وٲلِو نارِ پیٹھہٕ۔
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The poha was kept soaked or cooked for a long time. Wash it only a few seconds, and as soon as every grain gets wrapped in syrup, take the pan off the fire.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.t: یہ کیازِ چھُ کرشناشٹمی پیٹھ بنٲونہٕ یِوان؟
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: یہ چھُ کُچیلا سٕنٛز کَتھ یاد پاوان، یُس پنٕنِس دوست کرشنس نِش اَکھ مُٹھ پوہا پنٕنِس واحد تحفس ہِیُو اَنِتھ گوو۔
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: This brings to mind the story of Kuchela, who went to his friend Krishna bringing a fistful of poha as his only gift.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. آندھرا ہُند بیلّم اٹوکولو: موٹ پوہا، تاٹی بیلّم یعنی تاڑ گُڑٕ کِس گرم شیرس منٛز نارجیٖل، الٲچی تہٕ گیٖوس سٟتۍ رَلاونہٕ آمُت۔ 10 مِنَٹن ہٕنز مِٹھٲے، مشورن تہٕ عام سوالن سٟتۍ۔
seg.5080241b3883.back: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra's Bellam Atukulu: thick poha, mixed in the warm syrup of taati bellam, that is palm jaggery, with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and common questions.

seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: بیلّم اٹوکولو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with materials and method

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: کوبّری اُنڈلو چھِ نارجیٖلٕکۍ تِم لڈوٗ یِم آندھرا کیٛن گرن منٛز تہوارن، نیویدیم تہٕ روزٕچ مِٹھٲیہِ خٲطرٕ بنان چھِ۔ یِمن خٲطرٕ چھُ صرف نارجیٖل، گُڑ، الٲچی تہٕ اَکھ چَمچ گیٖو ضروٗری۔ گُڑ چھُ گلٲوِتھ چھٲننہٕ یِوان، نارجیٖل چھُ اَتھ منٛز لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ تیٚلہِ تام رنٛنہٕ یِوان یوٗت تام مکسچر جُڑِ، تہٕ لڈوٗ چھِ گرم آسنہٕ وِزِے اَتھو سٟتۍ بنٲونہٕ یِوان۔
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu are those coconut laddoos which are made in Andhra homes for festivals, naivedyam and daily sweet. For these only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and one spoon of ghee is necessary. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on low fire until the mixture binds, and the laddoos are made by hand while still warm.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: سون چیروکو بیلّم چھُ یِمن ہلکہٕ سونہٕ رنگ تہٕ نرم، کیریمل ہیوٗ مزٕ دِوان۔ یَتھ ترکیبہِ سٟتۍ چھِ تقریباً 14 لڈوٗ بنان۔
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our cheruku bellam gives them a light golden colour and a soft, caramel-like taste. With this recipe about 14 laddoos are made.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: تھاونہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو لڈوٗ بیٚیہِ 15 مِنَٹ شیہُل گژھنہٕ۔
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Before storing, give the laddoos another 15 minutes to become cool.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: گنہٕ گُڑ گلٲوِو، اَتھ رٔنِو کدوکش کرنہٕ آمتِس نارجیٖلس سٟتۍ یوٗت تام یہ جُڑِ، الٲچی تہٕ گیٖو ژٕھنِو، تہٕ بنٲوِو لڈوٗ۔
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut until it binds, put in cardamom and ghee, and make laddoos.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل ⟦1⟧1 درمیانہٕ نارجیٖل؛ صرف سفید حصہٕ کٔرِو کدوکش⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 کپ کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت گنہٕ گُڑ ⟦1⟧تقریباً 180 g؛ ٹُکرٕ کٔرِو گۄڈٕ کُٹِتھ یا کدوکش⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 بوٚڑ چَمچ گیٖو ⟦1⟧تہٕ ذرا بیٚیہِ اَتھن پیٹھ مَلنہٕ خٲطرٕ⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 big spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little more for rubbing on the hands⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10 کاجو، مرضی مطٲبق ⟦1⟧پھٕٹرِتھ گیٖوس منٛز سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ تٔلِتھ⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden-coloured in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: نارجیٖل کٔرِو کدوکش، بھورٕ چھوٚل تراوِو تاکہ لڈوٗ ہُند رنگ روزِ ہلکہٕ۔
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leave the brown skin so that the laddoos' colour stays light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: گنہٕ گُڑ کٔرِو کُٹِتھ یا کدوکش کٔرِتھ لۄکٕٹۍ ٹُکرٕ تاکہ یہ گلِ برابر۔
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Pound or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: گُڑ گلٲوِو 2 بوٚڑ چَمچ آبس سٟتۍ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ، پتہٕ چھٲنِو باریک چھلنی منٛز۔ اَمہِ سٟتۍ چھُ ڈَلہِ منٛز موجوٗد کانٛہہ کَنہِ ذرٕ یا گنہٕ کیٛن ریزہٕ چھلنی منٛز روزان۔
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low fire, then strain in a fine sieve. With this any stone particles or bits of cane present in the lump stay in the sieve.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: یہ ترٲوِو واپس پینس منٛز، نارجیٖل ژٕھنِو تہٕ رٔنِو درمیانہٕ تہٕ لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ ہِلٲوِتھ، یوٗت تام مکسچر پینٕکۍ کنارٕ ترٲوِ تہٕ جُڑِ، 12–15 مِنَٹ۔ ہِلٲوان روٗزِو تاکہ یہ تَلس منٛز لگِ نہٕ۔
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Pour it back into the pan, put in the coconut and cook stirring on medium and low fire, until the mixture leaves the pan's edges and binds, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: اگر توٚہہ کاجو ورتٲوان چھِو، تیٚلہِ تٔلِو یِم مکسچر رنٛنہٕ دوران ذرا گیٖوس منٛز یوٗت تام یِم سونہٕ رنگٕکۍ گژھن۔
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If you are using cashews, then fry them a little in ghee during the mixture's cooking until they become golden-coloured.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: الٲچی، گیٖو تہٕ کاجو رَلٲوِو۔ پین وٲلِو نارِ پیٹھہٕ۔
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the fire.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: یہ دِیِو تیوٗت شیہُل گژھنہٕ زِ توٚہہ ہیٚکِو اَتھہٕ لٲگِتھ، اَتھن پیٹھ مَلِو گیٖو تہٕ بنٲوِو لۄکٕٹۍ گول لڈوٗ۔ پرٛتھ اَکھ دَبٲوِو زورٕ سٟتۍ تاکہ یہ روزِ جُڑِتھ۔
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: Let it become cool enough that you can touch it with the hand, rub ghee on the hands and make small round laddoos. Press each one with force so that it stays bound.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: لڈوٗ تھٲوِو گیٖو مَلمٕتِس تھالس پیٹھ تہٕ تھاونہٕ برونٛہہ دِیِو یِم پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھنہٕ۔
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Keep the laddoos on a ghee-rubbed plate and before storing let them become fully cool.

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: اگر مکسچر شکل نہٕ رٹہِ، تیٚلہِ رٔنِو 2 مِنَٹ بیٚیہِ۔ اگر یہ واریاہ سخت گژھِ، تیٚلہِ چھٕکرِو اَکھ چَمچ گرم دودٕ تہٕ دَبٲوِو بیٚیہِ۔
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the mixture does not take shape, then cook 2 minutes more. If it becomes very hard, then sprinkle one spoon of warm milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: نار تھٲوِو درمیانہٕ تہٕ لوٚتہِ؛ تیز نارس پیٹھ گژھِ گُڑٕ رنگ گاڑھ تہٕ لڈوٗ گژھن سخت۔
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the fire medium and low; on high fire the jaggery's colour becomes dark and the laddoos become hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: مکسچر گرم آسنہٕ وِزِے بنٲوِو لڈوٗ؛ پورٕ پٲٹھۍ شیہُل گژھنہٕ پتہٕ جُڑِ نہٕ یہ۔
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Make the laddoos while the mixture is still warm; after becoming fully cool it will not bind.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: تاڑ گُڑ: تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ ورتٲوِو؛ لڈوٗ گژھن گاڑھ رنگٕکۍ تہٕ یِمن آسہِ ذرا دُہس ہِش مِٹھاس۔
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the laddoos will become dark-coloured and they will have a slightly smoke-like sweetness.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: ہۄکھ نارجیٖل: تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت ہۄکھ نارجیٖل (کوپرا) ورتٲوِو؛ مکسچر چھُ جلدی جُڑان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ رٹِو اَتھ پیٹھ نظر۔
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mixture binds quickly, so keep an eye on it.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: کوبّری برفی: لڈوٗ بنٲونہٕ بدلہٕ وَہرٲوِو رٔنِتھ مکسچر گیٖو مَلمٕتِس تھالس پیٹھ، دِیِو ذرا جمنہٕ تہٕ ژٹِو چوکور ٹُکرٕ۔
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari burfi: instead of making laddoos spread the cooked mixture on a ghee-rubbed plate, let it set a little and cut square pieces.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: روزٕچ مِٹھٲے ہِش کٔرِو پیش، نیویدیم ہِیُو چڑھٲوِو، یا تہوارٕچ مِٹھٲیہِ ہٕنزِ تھالہِ منٛز ژٕھنِو۔
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve like a daily sweet, offer like naivedyam, or put in a festival sweet platter.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: ہوا بنٛد ڈبس منٛز تھٲوِو تہٕ کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ 3 دۄہن اندر کھیٚیِو، یا فرِجس منٛز تھاونہٕ صورتس منٛز اَکِس ہفتس اندر۔
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an airtight box and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or in case of keeping in the fridge, within one week.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: میانۍ کوبّری اُنڈلو کیازِ چھِنہٕ شکل رٹان؟
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why are my Kobbari Undalu not taking shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: مکسچرس چھُ ذرا بیٚیہِ رنٛنُک ضروٗرت۔ یہ تھٲوِو واپس لوٚتہِ نارس پیٹھ 2 مِنَٹ ہِلٲوِتھ، یوٗت تام یہ پینٕکۍ کنارٕ ترٲوِ، پتہٕ بنٲوِو لڈوٗ گرم آسنہٕ وِزِے۔
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The mixture needs a little more cooking. Keep it back on low fire 2 minutes stirring, until it leaves the pan's edges, then make laddoos while still warm.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddoos become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: گُڑ اوس واریاہ وقت یا واریاہ تیز نارس پیٹھ رٔنِتھ۔ اَکھ چَمچ گرم دودٕ چھٕکرِو، رَلٲوِو تہٕ دَبٲوِو بیٚیہِ۔ بییِہ لٹہِ، یِتھے مکسچر جُڑِ، پین وٲلِو نارِ پیٹھہٕ۔
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery was cooked for a long time or on very high fire. Sprinkle one spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, as soon as the mixture binds, take the pan off the fire.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: کیا بہٕ ہیٚکہٕ کوبّری اُنڈلو تاڑ گُڑٕ سٟتۍ بنٲوِتھ؟
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can I make Kobbari Undalu with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.813bf680c8a8.t: آ۔ تیوٗتُے کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت تاڑ گُڑ (تاٹی بیلّم) ورتٲوِو۔ لڈوٗ گژھن گاڑھ رنگٕکۍ، تہٕ مِٹھاس آسہِ ذرا دُہس ہِش۔
seg.813bf680c8a8.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (taati bellam). The laddoos will become dark-coloured, and the sweetness will be slightly smoke-like.

seg.ea6121eb3993.src: How long do kobbari undalu keep?
seg.ea6121eb3993.t: کوبّری اُنڈلو کوٚتاہ وقت چھِ روزان؟
seg.ea6121eb3993.back: How long do Kobbari Undalu keep?

seg.26aba27412dc.src: About 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature, and up to a week in the fridge.
seg.26aba27412dc.t: ہوا بنٛد ڈبس منٛز کمرٕچ حرارتس پیٹھ تقریباً 3 دۄہ، تہٕ فرِجس منٛز اَکِس ہفتس تام۔
seg.26aba27412dc.back: In an airtight box at room temperature about 3 days, and in the fridge up to one week.

seg.0156a887ba6f.src: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra kobbari undalu: grated coconut cooked with Cheruku Bellam cane jaggery, cardamom and ghee, then rolled into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.0156a887ba6f.t: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. آندھرا کۍ کوبّری اُنڈلو: کدوکش کرنہٕ آمُت نارجیٖل، چیروکو بیلّم یعنی گنہٕ گُڑ، الٲچی تہٕ گیٖوس سٟتۍ رٔنِتھ، پتہٕ لڈوٗ بنٲوِتھ۔ قدم بہٕ قدم طریقہٕ، مشورٕ تہٕ عام سوال۔
seg.0156a887ba6f.back: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra's Kobbari Undalu: grated coconut, cooked with cheruku bellam, that is sugarcane jaggery, cardamom and ghee, then made into laddoos. Step-by-step method, tips and common questions.

seg.fc0444bcc4df.src: Kobbari Undalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.fc0444bcc4df.t: کوبّری اُنڈلو: 1acrefarms ہُند ترکیب کارڈ، سامان تہٕ طریقس سٟتۍ
seg.fc0444bcc4df.back: Kobbari Undalu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with materials and method

seg.13ab70df1ad4.src: How to check chilli powder at home
seg.13ab70df1ad4.t: گرِ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کٔرِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕچ جانچ
seg.13ab70df1ad4.back: At home, how to do a check of chilli powder [lit. marchawangun = red chilli]

seg.1841c397898f.src: FSSAI's standard says chilli powder must be dry and free from dirt, added colouring matter, flavouring matter and mineral oil. Its testing manual has methods for finding brick powder, added starch, added colour, colours that dissolve in oil, and the dyes Sudan III and Rhodamine B.
seg.1841c397898f.t: FSSAI ہُند معیار چھُ وَنان زِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر پَزِ ہۄکھ آسُن، تہٕ اَتھ منٛز پَزِ نہٕ مٮ۪ژ گَنٛد، رَلاونہٕ آمُت رنگ، مزٕ دِنہٕ وول مواد تہٕ مِنرل تیل آسُن۔ اَمِیُک جانچہٕ مینوئل چھُ اینٹن ہُند پوڈر، رَلاونہٕ آمُت نشاستہٕ، رَلاونہٕ آمُت رنگ، تیلس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ رنگ، تہٕ سوڈان III تہٕ روڈامین B ڈائی ژھانڈنٕکۍ طریقہٕ وَنان۔
seg.1841c397898f.back: FSSAI's standard says that chilli powder should be dry, and in it there should not be soil-dirt [unsure: mets gand = mud/dirt], mixed-in colour, taste-giving material and mineral oil. Its testing manual tells methods for finding brick powder, mixed-in starch, mixed-in colour, colours that dissolve in oil, and Sudan III and Rhodamine B dye.

seg.a0af610174e4.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen with a glass of water, your fingers and a few drops of iodine. Some, like Sudan dyes, only a lab can find. This guide covers both. Try the checks on any chilli powder you buy.
seg.a0af610174e4.t: یِمن منٛزٕ ہیٚکِو کیٛنہہ پنٕنِس باورچی خانس منٛز اَکِس گلاس آبس، پنٕنین اونٛگجن تہٕ آیوڈینٕکین کیٛنژن قطرن سٟتۍ جانچِتھ۔ کیٛنہہ، یِتھہٕ کٕن سوڈان ڈائی، ہیٚکہِ صرف لیب ژھانڈِتھ۔ یہ گائیڈ چھُ دۄشوَنُے مُتعلق۔ یِم جانچہٕ آزماوِو کُنہِ تہِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس پیٹھ یُس تۄہۍ ہیٚیِو۔
seg.a0af610174e4.back: Of these, you can check some in your own kitchen with one glass of water, your fingers and some drops of iodine. Some, like Sudan dye, only a lab can find. This guide is about both. Try these checks on any chilli powder that you buy.

seg.b356a193952e.src: ⟦1⟧Our two chilli powders⟦/1⟧Left: Sannam chilli powder. Right: Teja chilli powder. Both from chillies grown in Palnadu and Guntur, sun-dried and packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.b356a193952e.t: ⟦1⟧سانۍ زٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر⟦/1⟧کھوٚور: سنّم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ دۄچھُن: تیجا مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ دۄنوَے پلناڈو تہٕ گنٹور منٛز کاشت کرنہٕ آمٕتین مَرچہٕ وانٛگنَو پیٹھہٕ، تاپھس منٛز ہۄکھنٲوِتھ تہٕ نرساراؤپیٹ منٛز پیک کرنہٕ آمٕتۍ۔
seg.b356a193952e.back: ⟦1⟧Our two chilli powders⟦/1⟧Left: Sannam chilli powder. Right: Teja chilli powder. Both from chillies cultivated in Palnadu and Guntur, dried in the sunshine and packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.a574ced14407.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of chilli powder on a glass of water and do not stir. Colour streaks running down at once point to added colour, and bits still floating after the powder sinks point to sawdust or bran. Rub the sediment: grit points to brick powder or sand, a soapy feel to soapstone. Iodine turning the powder blue points to added starch. Dyes such as Sudan I do not show in water; for those, use a lab.
seg.a574ced14407.t: اَکِس گلاس آبس پیٹھ ژھٕکٲوِو اَکھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ مہٕ ہِلٲوِو۔ اگر فوراً رنگہٕ دار لکیرہٕ بۄن وَسن، تیٚلہِ چھُ یہ رَلاونہٕ آمتِس رنگس کُن اِشارٕ، تہٕ پوڈر بۄن وَسنہٕ پتہٕ تہِ پیٹھ تران ٹُکرٕ چھِ لکڑی بُرادٕ یا چوکرس کُن اِشارٕ۔ تَلس بیٖٹھمُت مواد مَلِو: کِرکِرٕ باسہِ تیٚلہِ اینٹن ہٕنٛدِس پوڈرس یا ریتس کُن، تہٕ صابنہٕ ہیوٗ چِکٕن باسہِ تیٚلہِ سوپ سٹونس کُن اِشارٕ۔ اگر آیوڈین پوڈرس نیٖل کرِ، تیٚلہِ چھُ یہ رَلاونہٕ آمتِس نشاستس کُن اِشارٕ۔ سوڈان I ہِوۍ ڈائی چھِ نہٕ آبس منٛز باسان؛ تِمن خٲطرٕ کرٲوِو لیبس منٛز جانچ۔
seg.a574ced14407.back: Sprinkle one small spoon [teaspoon] of chilli powder over one glass of water and do not stir [lit. do not shake]. If coloured lines descend immediately, then this is a pointer towards mixed-in colour, and pieces floating on top even after the powder descends are a pointer towards sawdust [lit. wood sawdust] or bran. Rub the material settled at the bottom: if it feels gritty, then a pointer towards brick powder or sand, and if it feels smooth [or: slippery] like soap, then a pointer towards soapstone. If iodine makes the powder blue, then this is a pointer towards mixed-in starch. Dyes like Sudan I are not seen in water; for them get a check done in a lab.

seg.11caa5f871e4.src: What FSSAI checks chilli powder for
seg.11caa5f871e4.t: FSSAI کیا کیا چھُ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز جانچان
seg.11caa5f871e4.back: What all FSSAI checks in chilli powder

seg.7d346e39c41e.src: FSSAI's chilli powder standard does not allow added colouring matter. FSSAI's tests look for colours that dissolve in water, colours that dissolve in oil, and the dyes Sudan III and Rhodamine B.
seg.7d346e39c41e.t: FSSAI ہُند مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرُک معیار چھُ نہٕ رَلاونہٕ آمتِس رنگس اِجازت دِوان۔ FSSAI کیٛن ٹیسٹن منٛز چھِ آبس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ رنگ، تیلس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ رنگ، تہٕ سوڈان III تہٕ روڈامین B ڈائی ژھانڈنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.7d346e39c41e.back: FSSAI's chilli powder standard does not give permission to mixed-in colour. In FSSAI's tests, colours that dissolve in water, colours that dissolve in oil, and Sudan III and Rhodamine B dye are searched for.

seg.dab0f1b06607.src: Sudan I is used to colour oils, fats, waxes, and shoe and floor polish. The Indian Standard on quick tests for adulterants says Sudan III, much used in wax polishes, has been used to make chilli pods shine, and so finds its way into chilli powder.
seg.dab0f1b06607.t: سوڈان I چھُ تیلن، چربی، موم، تہٕ بوٗٹن تہٕ فرشن ہٕنٛز پالِش رنگنہٕ خٲطرٕ ورتاونہٕ یِوان۔ مِلاوٹی چیزن ہٕنٛدین جلدی ٹیسٹن مُتعلق ہِندوستٲنی معیار چھُ وَنان زِ سوڈان III، یُس موم وٲلہِ پالِشہِ منٛز واریاہ ورتاونہٕ یِوان چھُ، چھُ سالِم مَرچہٕ وانٛگن چمکاونہٕ خٲطرٕ ورتاونہٕ آمُت، تہٕ یِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ چھُ یہ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز واتان۔
seg.dab0f1b06607.back: Sudan I is used for colouring oils, fat, wax, and the polish of boots and floors. The Indian standard about quick tests of adulterated things says that Sudan III, which is used a lot in wax polish, has been used for making whole chillies shine, and in this way it reaches into chilli powder.

seg.65d2132b3a71.src: Brick powder, sand, salt, talc and soapstone
seg.65d2132b3a71.t: اینٹن ہُند پوڈر، ریت، نوٗن، ٹیلک تہٕ سوپ سٹون
seg.65d2132b3a71.back: Brick powder, sand, salt, talc and soapstone

seg.eaaa28049f76.src: FSSAI's household tests list these for chilli powder. The Indian Standard says brick powder is mixed in to increase bulk.
seg.eaaa28049f76.t: FSSAI کیٛن گرٕکین ٹیسٹن منٛز چھِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس خٲطرٕ یِم چیز گنزرنہٕ آمٕتۍ۔ ہِندوستٲنی معیار چھُ وَنان زِ مقدار ہُرراونہٕ خٲطرٕ چھُ اینٹن ہُند پوڈر رَلاونہٕ یِوان۔
seg.eaaa28049f76.back: In FSSAI's home tests these things have been counted [listed] for chilli powder. The Indian standard says that for increasing quantity, brick powder is mixed in.

seg.591f55c64be8.src: FSSAI's manual tests powdered spices other than turmeric for added starch. The Indian Standard notes that colour is also added to chilli powder to hide added starch.
seg.591f55c64be8.t: FSSAI ہُند مینوئل چھُ لیدرٕ ورٲے بیٚین پیٖہمٕتین مسالن منٛز رَلاونہٕ آمتِس نشاستس ہٕنٛز جانچ کران۔ ہِندوستٲنی معیار چھُ وَنان زِ رَلاونہٕ آمُت نشاستہٕ چھپاونہٕ خٲطرٕ چھُ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز رنگ تہِ رَلاونہٕ یِوان۔
seg.591f55c64be8.back: FSSAI's manual does a check of mixed-in starch in ground spices other than turmeric. The Indian standard says that to hide mixed-in starch, colour is also mixed into chilli powder.

seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.src: Both float on water, which is how FSSAI's household tests spot them.
seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.t: دۄنوَے چھِ آبس پیٹھ تران، تہٕ FSSAI کیٛن گرٕکین ٹیسٹن منٛز چھِ یِم یِتھے پٲٹھۍ ژھانڈنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.back: Both float on water, and in FSSAI's home tests these are found in just this way.

seg.2ad2a1900226.src: Check 1: the water glass and the rub test
seg.2ad2a1900226.t: جانچ 1: آبُک گلاس تہٕ مَلنٕچ جانچ
seg.2ad2a1900226.back: Check 1: Glass of water and rubbing check

seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.src: Sprinkle one teaspoon of chilli powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.t: پیٹھ کِنۍ ژھٕکٲوِو اَکھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔ مہٕ ہِلٲوِو۔
seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.back: From above sprinkle one small spoon [teaspoon] of chilli powder. Do not stir [lit. do not shake].

seg.e11be0844965.src: Watch the first minute. Look for coloured streaks running down from the powder.
seg.e11be0844965.t: گۄڈنیُک اَکھ مِنَٹ وُچھِو۔ وُچھِو زِ پوڈرٕ پیٹھہٕ چھا رنگہٕ دار لکیرہٕ بۄن وَسان۔
seg.e11be0844965.back: Watch the first one minute. See whether coloured lines are descending from the powder.

seg.14ad43586f91.src: Leave it until most of the powder has sunk. Look at the surface for bits still floating.
seg.14ad43586f91.t: یہ ترٲوِو یوت تام زیادٕ تر پوڈر بۄن وَسہِ۔ وُچھِو زِ پیٹھ کِنۍ چھا وُنہِ تہِ ٹُکرٕ تران۔
seg.14ad43586f91.back: Leave it until most of the powder descends. See whether pieces are still floating on top.

seg.379262f468f1.src: Pour off most of the water and rub the sediment at the bottom between your fingers.
seg.379262f468f1.t: زیادٕ تر آب ہٲرِو، تہٕ تَلس بیٖٹھمُت مواد مَلِو اونٛگجن درمیان۔
seg.379262f468f1.back: Pour off [unsure: haaryu = spill/drain] most of the water, and rub the material settled at the bottom between the fingers.

seg.7455fbe1d38d.t: تۄہۍ کیا چھِو وُچھان یا مَلنہٕ سٟتۍ کیا چھُ باسان
seg.7455fbe1d38d.back: What you see or what it feels like on rubbing

seg.5ddc9ed4a863.t: یہ ہیٚکہِ کتھ کُن اِشارٕ کٔرِتھ
seg.5ddc9ed4a863.back: What this can give a pointer to

seg.9d20132af7ae.src: Colour streaks running down at once
seg.9d20132af7ae.t: فوراً بۄن وَسن وٲلۍ رنگہٕ دار لکیرہٕ

seg.4dd6d7d4418f.src: Added colour that dissolves in water
seg.4dd6d7d4418f.t: آبس منٛز گلن وول رَلاونہٕ آمُت رنگ
seg.4dd6d7d4418f.back: Mixed-in colour that dissolves in water

seg.99d03e1725f4.src: Bits still floating after the powder sinks
seg.99d03e1725f4.t: پوڈر بۄن وَسنہٕ پتہٕ تہِ پیٹھ تران ٹُکرٕ
seg.99d03e1725f4.back: Pieces floating on top even after the powder descends

seg.0778aeb79734.src: White sediment that feels soapy and smooth
seg.0778aeb79734.t: سفید مواد یُس صابنہٕ ہیوٗ چِکٕن تہٕ ملائم باسہِ
seg.0778aeb79734.back: White material that feels smooth [or: slippery] like soap and soft

seg.92ba3085667d.src: No sign of what this check can find.
seg.92ba3085667d.t: یُس چیز یہ جانچ ژھانڈِتھ ہیٚکہِ، تَمِیُک کانٛہہ نِشان نہٕ۔
seg.92ba3085667d.back: No sign of the thing that this check can find.

seg.e4f5d2924afa.src: Possible adulteration. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.e4f5d2924afa.t: ہیٚکہِ مِلاوٹ آسِتھ۔ تَتھ بیچُک پوڈر ورتاوُن کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ کرٲوِو اَمِیٚچ جانچ۔
seg.e4f5d2924afa.back: There can be adulteration. Stop using that batch's powder and get its check done.

seg.e5e493d4cb12.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Colours that dissolve in water leave the powder and run down as streaks. Brick powder is heavy and settles to the bottom, while sawdust and bran float.
seg.e5e493d4cb12.t: ⟦1⟧یہ کیازِ چھُ کام کران۔⟦/1⟧ آبس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ رنگ چھِ پوڈرٕ منٛزٕ نیران تہٕ لکیرن ہٕنٛدِس صورتس منٛز بۄن وَسان۔ اینٹن ہُند پوڈر چھُ گۄب آسان تہٕ تَلس بیہان، تہٕ لکڑی بُرادٕ تہٕ چوکر چھِ پیٹھ تران۔
seg.e5e493d4cb12.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Colours that dissolve in water come out of the powder and descend in the form of lines. Brick powder is heavy and sits at the bottom, and sawdust and bran float on top.

seg.551c97147aa3.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Dyes that do not dissolve in water stay in the powder. Sudan I is one: it does not dissolve in water, and it is used to colour oils, fats and waxes. Chilli powder coloured with such dyes can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.551c97147aa3.t: ⟦1⟧یہ کیا چھُ نہٕ ژھانڈان۔⟦/1⟧ یِم ڈائی آبس منٛز چھِنہٕ گلان، تِم چھِ پوڈرس منٛزے روزان۔ سوڈان I چھُ اَکھ یِتھُے: یہ چھُ نہٕ آبس منٛز گلان، تہٕ تیلن، چربی تہٕ موم رنگنہٕ خٲطرٕ چھُ ورتاونہٕ یِوان۔ یِتھین ڈائین سٟتۍ رنگنہٕ آمُت مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر ہیٚکہِ یَتھ جانچہِ منٛز پاس گٔژِھتھ۔ صرف لیب ٹیسٹ ہیٚکہِ وَنِتھ زِ یِم چھِنہٕ اَتھ منٛز۔
seg.551c97147aa3.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not find.⟦/1⟧ Dyes that do not dissolve in water stay in the powder itself. Sudan I is one such: it does not dissolve in water, and is used for colouring oils, fat and wax. Chilli powder coloured with such dyes can pass in this check. Only a lab test can say that these are not in it.

seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.src: Wash your hands after the rub test, before you touch your eyes.
seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.t: مَلنٕچہِ جانچہِ پتہٕ، اَچھن اَتھ لاگنہٕ برونٛہہ چھلِو اَتھہٕ۔
seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.back: After the rubbing check, before touching the eyes, wash the hands.

seg.36726998b551.src: Check 2: the iodine test for starch

seg.3d76d0b2a476.src: FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, so chilli powder can take it. ⟦1⟧Our turmeric guide⟦/1⟧ explains why turmeric is left out.
seg.3d76d0b2a476.t: FSSAI ہُند مینوئل چھُ آیوڈین ٹیسٹ لیدرٕ ورٲے بیٚین پیٖہمٕتین مسالن خٲطرٕ ورتاوان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ ہیٚکہِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس یہ ٹیسٹ کرنہٕ یِتھ۔ لیدُر کیازِ چھُ ترٛاونہٕ آمُت، یہ چھُ ⟦1⟧سون لیدرٕچ گائیڈ⟦/1⟧ وَنان۔
seg.3d76d0b2a476.back: FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric, therefore this test can be done on chilli powder. Why turmeric has been left out, this ⟦1⟧our turmeric guide⟦/1⟧ tells.

seg.c7d23b036696.src: Put half a teaspoon of chilli powder on a white saucer.
seg.c7d23b036696.t: اَکِس سفید لۄکٕٹِس پلیٹس منٛز تھٲوِو اَڈ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر۔
seg.c7d23b036696.back: In one small white plate put half a small spoon [teaspoon] of chilli powder.

seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.src: Add a few drops of tincture of iodine from a chemist.
seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.t: کیمسٹ سٕنٛزِ دُکانہِ پیٹھہٕ اَنِتھ ٹِنکچر آیوڈینٕکۍ کیٛنہہ قطرٕ ترٲوِو۔
seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.back: Drop a few drops of tincture iodine brought from a chemist's shop.

seg.2d93dfc80312.src: Look at the colour where the drops land.
seg.2d93dfc80312.t: یتہِ قطرٕ پیٚیہِ، تتہِ کُس رنگ چھُ، سُہ وُچھِو۔
seg.2d93dfc80312.back: Where the drops fell, what colour is there, see that.

seg.2f88b779aa2b.t: رَلاونہٕ آمتِس نشاستُک کانٛہہ نِشان نہٕ۔

seg.0db85a4ff58c.src: Points to added starch. Stop using that batch and get it tested. On red powder a faint change is hard to judge, so if you are not sure, let a lab decide.
seg.0db85a4ff58c.t: رَلاونہٕ آمتِس نشاستس کُن اِشارٕ۔ تَتھ بیچُک پوڈر ورتاوُن کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ کرٲوِو اَمِیٚچ جانچ۔ وۄزلِس پوڈرس پیٹھ چھُ معمولی بدلاو پرٛزناوُن مُشکل، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ اگر تۄہۍ پَکہٕ چھِونہٕ، تیٚلہِ دِیِو لیبس فیصلہٕ کرنہٕ۔
seg.0db85a4ff58c.back: Pointer towards mixed-in starch. Stop using that batch's powder and get its check done. On red powder, recognising a slight change is difficult, therefore if you are not sure, let the lab decide.

seg.ed4a959013d8.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Iodine turns blue when it meets starch.
seg.ed4a959013d8.t: ⟦1⟧یہ کیازِ چھُ کام کران۔⟦/1⟧ آیوڈین چھُ نشاستس سٟتۍ مِلنہٕ پتہٕ نیٖل گژھان۔
seg.ed4a959013d8.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Iodine becomes blue after meeting with starch.

seg.9e0f62706054.src: Acid and solvent tests at home
seg.9e0f62706054.t: گرِ تیزاب تہٕ سالوینٹ وٲلۍ ٹیسٹ
seg.9e0f62706054.back: Acid and solvent tests at home

seg.f5e28e97055b.src: The methods in FSSAI's manual for brick powder, added colour, oil-soluble colours, Sudan III and Rhodamine B in chilli powder use strong acids and solvents such as chloroform, petroleum ether, hexane and acetone. The acids can cause burns, and several of the solvents catch fire easily. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.f5e28e97055b.t: مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز اینٹن ہُند پوڈر، رَلاونہٕ آمُت رنگ، تیلس منٛز گلن وٲلۍ رنگ، سوڈان III تہٕ روڈامین B ژھانڈنہٕ خٲطرٕ FSSAI کِس مینوئلس منٛز دِتمتین طریقن منٛز چھِ تیز تیزاب تہٕ کلوروفارم، پیٹرولیم ایتھر، ہیکسین تہٕ ایسیٹون ہِوۍ سالوینٹ ورتاونہٕ یِوان۔ تیزاب ہیٚکن زالِتھ، تہٕ یِمن منٛزٕ کیٛنژن سالوینٹن چھُ آسٲنی سان نار لگان۔ یِہنٛز جاے چھےٚ لیب، باورچی خانہٕ نہٕ۔
seg.f5e28e97055b.back: In the methods given in FSSAI's manual for finding brick powder, mixed-in colour, colours that dissolve in oil, Sudan III and Rhodamine B in chilli powder, strong acid and solvents like chloroform, petroleum ether, hexane and acetone are used. Acids can burn, and some of these solvents catch fire easily. Their place is the lab, not the kitchen.

seg.1e30ce9ef855.src: For a sure answer, send a sample to a NABL-accredited food testing lab. Ask it to test for added colours, including Sudan dyes, and against FSSAI's chilli powder standard. Its limits include moisture up to 11%, total ash up to 8%, and ash insoluble in dilute hydrochloric acid up to 1.3%, all by weight, with both ash limits on a dry basis. Keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack.
seg.1e30ce9ef855.t: پَکہِ جوابہٕ خٲطرٕ سوٗزِو اَکھ نمونہٕ NABL سٟتۍ منظوٗر شُدہ فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیبس۔ تَمِس وٲنِو زِ سوڈان ڈائی تہِ شٲمِل کٔرِتھ رَلاونہٕ آمتین رنگن ہٕنٛز جانچ کرِ، تہٕ FSSAI ہٕنٛدِس مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕکِس معیارس مُطٲبق جانچ کرِ۔ اَمِیٚکین حدن منٛز چھُ نَمی 11% تام، کُل راکھ 8% تام، تہٕ ہلکِس ہائیڈروکلورک تیزابس منٛز نہٕ گلن وٲج راکھ 1.3% تام، سٲری وزنس مُطٲبق، تہٕ راکھہِ ہٕنٛدۍ دۄنوَے حد ہۄکھ بنیادس پیٹھ۔ پوڈر تھٲوِو اَمِیٚکِس بنٛد پیکس منٛز یا اَکِس صاف بنٛد تھیلہِ منٛز، تہٕ پیکس پیٹھ چھاپنہٕ آمُت بیچ نمبر لیٚکھِو۔
seg.1e30ce9ef855.back: For a certain [sure] answer, send one sample to a food testing lab approved by NABL. Tell it to do a check of mixed-in colours including Sudan dye too, and to do the check according to FSSAI's chilli powder standard. In its limits are moisture up to 11%, total ash up to 8%, and ash that does not dissolve in light [dilute] hydrochloric acid up to 1.3%, all according to weight, and both limits of ash on a dry basis. Keep the powder in its closed pack or in one clean closed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack.

seg.8ef59aeeebe4.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number.

seg.f90b0f258a47.src: Net quantity, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.f90b0f258a47.t: نیٹ مقدار، بیچ یا لاٹ نمبر، تہٕ بیسٹ بیفور تٲریخ۔
seg.f90b0f258a47.back: Net quantity, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.fa3907160dbb.src: The ingredients. FSSAI allows up to 2% edible vegetable oil by weight in chilli powder, but only if the label says which oil and how much.
seg.fa3907160dbb.t: سامان۔ FSSAI چھُ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز وزنس مُطٲبق 2% تام کھیٚنہٕ لایق نباتاتی تیل رَلاونٕچ اِجازت دِوان، مگر صرف تیٚلہِ یَلہِ لیبلس پیٹھ لیٚکھِتھ آسہِ زِ کُس تیل چھُ تہٕ کوٚتُت۔
seg.fa3907160dbb.back: Goods [lit. saamaan = stuff; meaning ingredients]. FSSAI gives permission for mixing up to 2% by weight of edible vegetable [plant] oil in chilli powder, but only then when it is written on the label which oil it is and how much.

seg.616cb55edf33.src: Where it was grown, and the chilli variety if named. Our ⟦1⟧Sannam⟦/1⟧ and ⟦2⟧Teja⟦/2⟧ packs say Palnadu and Guntur.
seg.616cb55edf33.t: یہ کتہِ چھُ کاشت کرنہٕ آمُت، تہٕ اگر ناو دِنہٕ آمُت آسہِ تیٚلہِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگنٕچ قِسم۔ سانین ⟦1⟧سنّم⟦/1⟧ تہٕ ⟦2⟧تیجا⟦/2⟧ پیکن پیٹھ چھُ پلناڈو تہٕ گنٹور لیٚکھِتھ۔
seg.616cb55edf33.back: Where it has been cultivated, and if a name has been given, then the variety of chilli. On our ⟦1⟧Sannam⟦/1⟧ and ⟦2⟧Teja⟦/2⟧ packs Palnadu and Guntur is written.

seg.5766b566dbba.src: Use a dry spoon, and keep the jar away from steam from the stove.
seg.5766b566dbba.t: ہۄکھ چَمچ ورتٲوِو، تہٕ جار تھٲوِو دانہٕ کِس بھاپہِ نِشہِ دور۔
seg.5766b566dbba.back: Use a dry spoon, and keep the jar away from the steam of the stove [lit. daan = hearth].

seg.ae76fa3c0a37.src: Keep it in a cool, dry place, out of direct sunlight.
seg.ae76fa3c0a37.t: یہ تھٲوِو شیہلہِ تہٕ ہۄکھ جایہِ، سیود تاپھہٕ نِشہِ دور۔
seg.ae76fa3c0a37.back: Keep it in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunshine.

seg.cee32139c40b.src: Use it within the best-before date on the pack, in dishes such as ⟦1⟧vellulli kaaram⟦/1⟧, ⟦2⟧gongura pachadi⟦/2⟧ or ⟦3⟧tomato pachadi⟦/3⟧.
seg.cee32139c40b.t: پیکس پیٹھ لیٚکھمژِ بیسٹ بیفور تٲریخہِ اندر کٔرِو یہ استعمال، ⟦1⟧ویلّولّی کارم⟦/1⟧، ⟦2⟧گونگورا پچّڑی⟦/2⟧ یا ⟦3⟧ٹوماٹو پچّڑی⟦/3⟧ ہِوین کھیٚنن منٛز۔
seg.cee32139c40b.back: Use it within the best-before date written on the pack, in foods like ⟦1⟧vellulli karam⟦/1⟧, ⟦2⟧gongura pachadi⟦/2⟧ or ⟦3⟧tomato pachadi⟦/3⟧.

seg.13c76694dc1e.src: How do I check chilli powder for brick powder at home?
seg.13c76694dc1e.t: گرِ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کٔرِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز اینٹن ہٕنٛدِس پوڈرٕچ جانچ؟
seg.13c76694dc1e.back: At home, how to do a check of brick powder in chilli powder?

seg.3e87e1d30613.src: Put a teaspoon of chilli powder in a glass of water and let it settle. Pour off most of the water and rub the sediment between your fingers: grit points to brick powder or sand, and a white residue that feels soapy and smooth points to soapstone.
seg.3e87e1d30613.t: اَکِس گلاس آبس منٛز ترٲوِو اَکھ لۄکٕٹ چَمچ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر تہٕ دِیِو بیٖہنہٕ۔ زیادٕ تر آب ہٲرِو تہٕ تَلس بیٖٹھمُت مواد مَلِو اونٛگجن درمیان: کِرکِرٕ باسُن چھُ اینٹن ہٕنٛدِس پوڈرس یا ریتس کُن اِشارٕ، تہٕ سفید مواد یُس صابنہٕ ہیوٗ چِکٕن تہٕ ملائم باسہِ، چھُ سوپ سٹونس کُن اِشارٕ۔
seg.3e87e1d30613.back: In one glass of water drop one small spoon [teaspoon] of chilli powder and let it settle. Pour off [unsure: haaryu = spill/drain] most of the water and rub the material settled at the bottom between the fingers: feeling gritty is a pointer towards brick powder or sand, and white material that feels smooth [or: slippery] like soap and soft is a pointer towards soapstone.

seg.f609f5773557.src: Can the water test detect Sudan dye in chilli powder?
seg.f609f5773557.t: کیا آبٕچ جانچ ہیٚکہِ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس منٛز سوڈان ڈائی ژھانڈِتھ؟
seg.f609f5773557.back: Can the water check find Sudan dye in chilli powder?

seg.7bd8af24de2f.src: No. Sudan I does not dissolve in water, so it cannot run out as streaks. FSSAI's manual tests for Sudan III and for oil-soluble colours with solvents such as hexane and petroleum ether, so those tests need a lab.
seg.7bd8af24de2f.t: نہٕ۔ سوڈان I چھُ نہٕ آبس منٛز گلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ ہیٚکہِ نہٕ یہ لکیرن ہٕنٛدِس صورتس منٛز نیٖرِتھ۔ FSSAI ہُند مینوئل چھُ سوڈان III تہٕ تیلس منٛز گلن وٲلین رنگن ہٕنٛز جانچ ہیکسین تہٕ پیٹرولیم ایتھر ہِوین سالوینٹن سٟتۍ کران، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھےٚ تِمن ٹیسٹن خٲطرٕ لیبٕچ ضروٗرت۔
seg.7bd8af24de2f.back: No. Sudan I does not dissolve in water, therefore it cannot come out in the form of lines. FSSAI's manual does the check of Sudan III and colours that dissolve in oil with solvents like hexane and petroleum ether, therefore for those tests there is need of a lab.

seg.d63c02ec2e5c.src: Does the iodine test work on chilli powder?
seg.d63c02ec2e5c.t: کیا آیوڈین ٹیسٹ چھُ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرس پیٹھ کام کران؟
seg.d63c02ec2e5c.back: Does the iodine test work on chilli powder?

seg.01e86c518d41.src: Yes. FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, and chilli powder is one of them. A blue colour points to added starch.
seg.01e86c518d41.t: آ۔ FSSAI ہُند مینوئل چھُ آیوڈین ٹیسٹ لیدرٕ ورٲے بیٚین پیٖہمٕتین مسالن خٲطرٕ ورتاوان، تہٕ مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ تِمن منٛزٕ اَکھ۔ نیٖل رنگ چھُ رَلاونہٕ آمتِس نشاستس کُن اِشارٕ۔
seg.01e86c518d41.back: Yes. FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric, and chilli powder is one of them. Blue colour is a pointer towards mixed-in starch.

seg.75e20911cd47.src: Is bright red chilli powder a sign of adulteration?
seg.75e20911cd47.t: کیا چمکہٕ دار وۄزُل مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈر چھُ مِلاوٹُک نِشان؟
seg.75e20911cd47.back: Is shiny red chilli powder a sign of adulteration?

seg.dcfec3eff0b8.src: Colour alone does not tell you. The water check looks for colour that leaves the powder and runs down as streaks, not for how red the powder looks, and a lab can test for added colours.
seg.dcfec3eff0b8.t: صرف رنگہٕ سٟتۍ چھُنہٕ پتاہ لگان۔ آبٕچ جانچ چھےٚ نہٕ یہ وُچھان زِ پوڈر کوٚتاہ وۄزُل باسان چھُ، بلکہ یہ زِ رنگ چھا پوڈرٕ منٛزٕ نیٖرِتھ لکیرن ہٕنٛدِس صورتس منٛز بۄن وَسان، تہٕ لیب ہیٚکہِ رَلاونہٕ آمتین رنگن ہٕنٛز جانچ کٔرِتھ۔
seg.dcfec3eff0b8.back: Only by colour it is not known. The water check does not see how red the powder looks, rather this, whether colour comes out of the powder and descends in the form of lines, and the lab can do a check of mixed-in colours.

seg.54f85d34859f.src: Stop using that batch and keep the pack. Contact the seller with the batch number, or send a sample to a NABL-accredited food testing lab for a sure answer.
seg.54f85d34859f.t: تَتھ بیچُک پوڈر ورتاوُن کٔرِو بنٛد تہٕ پیک تھٲوِو۔ بیچ نمبرس سٟتۍ کٔرِو کِنن وٲلِس سٟتۍ رابطہٕ، یا پَکہِ جوابہٕ خٲطرٕ سوٗزِو اَکھ نمونہٕ NABL سٟتۍ منظوٗر شُدہ فوڈ ٹیسٹنگ لیبس۔
seg.54f85d34859f.back: Stop using that batch's powder and keep the pack. Contact the seller with the batch number, or for a certain [sure] answer send one sample to a food testing lab approved by NABL.

seg.a7d8a3890045.src: Both are grown in Palnadu and Guntur and packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.a7d8a3890045.t: دۄنوَے چھِ پلناڈو تہٕ گنٹور منٛز کاشت کرنہٕ یِوان تہٕ نرساراؤپیٹ منٛز پیک کرنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.a7d8a3890045.back: Both are cultivated in Palnadu and Guntur and packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.20f494d041fc.t: کارم کلتینی اِنٹلونے ایلا گُرتِنچالی۔ گرِ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کٔرِو مَرچہٕ وانٛگن پوڈرٕچ جانچ: آبُک گلاس، مَلنٕچ تہٕ آیوڈین جانچ، یِم کیا چھِ نہٕ ژھانڈان، تہٕ لیبٕچ ضروٗرت کر چھےٚ پیوان۔

seg.0e55b39feef1.src: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) or turmeric: the difference
seg.0e55b39feef1.t: پہاڑی لیدُر (کونڈا پسوپو) یا لیدُر: فرق کیا چھُ
seg.0e55b39feef1.back: Hill turmeric (Konda pasupu) or turmeric: what is the difference

seg.8b7a90a6aed6.src: Konda pasupu means hill turmeric: turmeric grown in hill country. In Andhra Pradesh that includes the agency hills of the Eastern Ghats around Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, where most tribal farmers grow turmeric. Plains turmeric grows on farmland in districts such as Guntur.
seg.8b7a90a6aed6.t: کونڈا پسوپو چھُ پہاڑی لیدُر: پہاڑی علاقن منٛز کاشت کرنہٕ یِوَن وول لیدُر۔ آندھرا پردیشس منٛز چھِ اَتھ منٛز اراکو وٲدی، چنتاپلّے تہٕ پاڈیرو کِس آس پاس مشرقی گھاٹن ہٕنٛدۍ ایجنسی پہاڑ شٲمِل، یتہِ قبایلی کاشتکارَو منٛزٕ زیادٕ تر لیدُر کاشت چھِ کران۔ میدٲنی لیدُر چھُ گنٹور ہِوین ضلعن ہٕنٛدین کھیتن منٛز کاشت گژھان۔
seg.8b7a90a6aed6.back: Konda pasupu is hill turmeric: turmeric that is cultivated in hilly areas. In Andhra Pradesh this includes the Eastern Ghats agency hills around Araku valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, where most of the tribal farmers cultivate turmeric. Plains turmeric is cultivated in the fields of districts like Guntur.

seg.404d008584f4.src: FSSAI's standard for turmeric powder is the same wherever it grew. What changes is the place, the variety, and how it is grown and dried. This guide covers each of those, what curcumin is, how to cook with each and how to compare two turmerics fairly. There is a Telugu section further down.
seg.404d008584f4.t: لیدُر پوڈرٕ خٲطرٕ FSSAI ہُند معیار چھُ اَکُے، لیدُر یُتہِ تہِ کاشت آسہِ گوٚمُت۔ فرق چھُ جایہِ، قِسمہِ، تہٕ یہ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ چھُ کاشت تہٕ ہۄکھناونہٕ یِوان، اَتھ منٛز۔ یہ گائیڈ چھُ یِمن پرٛتھ اَکہِ مُتعلق، کرکیومن کیا چھُ، پرٛتھ اَکہِ سٟتۍ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ رَنُن تہٕ زٕ لیدرن ہُند منصفانہٕ مُقابلہ کِتھہٕ پٲٹھۍ کرُن، یہ وَنان۔ بۄن چھُ تیلگو زبانہِ منٛز اَکھ حصہٕ تہِ۔
seg.404d008584f4.back: FSSAI's standard for turmeric powder is one, wherever the turmeric may have been cultivated. The difference is in the place, the variety, and how it is cultivated and dried. This guide tells about each one of these, what curcumin is, how to cook with each one, and how to do a fair comparison of two turmerics. Below there is also a section in the Telugu language.

seg.2e709bd87897.src: ⟦1⟧Our two turmerics⟦/1⟧Left: hill turmeric from the Araku and Maredumilli hills. Right: turmeric grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Both packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.2e709bd87897.t: ⟦1⟧سانۍ زٕ لیدُر⟦/1⟧کھوٚور: اراکو تہٕ ماریڈومِلی کیٛن پہاڑن پیٹھہٕ پہاڑی لیدُر۔ دۄچھُن: پلناڈو تہٕ گنٹور منٛز کاشت کرنہٕ آمُت لیدُر۔ دۄنوَے نرساراؤپیٹ منٛز پیک کرنہٕ آمٕتۍ۔
seg.2e709bd87897.back: ⟦1⟧Our two turmerics⟦/1⟧Left: hill turmeric from the hills of Araku and Maredumilli. Right: turmeric cultivated in Palnadu and Guntur. Both packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.10eec083bb3d.src: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) grows in hill country, such as the Eastern Ghats around Araku, where most tribal farmers grow it. Plains turmeric grows on farmland in districts such as Guntur. Both are boiled, dried and ground, and FSSAI holds both to the same standard. Curcumin, the yellow pigment in turmeric, changes with variety, soil, climate and processing, so the word hill or plains does not tell you how much a turmeric has. Cook with both the same way.
seg.10eec083bb3d.t: پہاڑی لیدُر (کونڈا پسوپو) چھُ پہاڑی علاقن منٛز کاشت گژھان، یِتھہٕ کٕن اراکو کِس آس پاس مشرقی گھاٹ، یتہِ قبایلی کاشتکارَو منٛزٕ زیادٕ تر یہ کاشت چھِ کران۔ میدٲنی لیدُر چھُ گنٹور ہِوین ضلعن ہٕنٛدین کھیتن منٛز کاشت گژھان۔ دۄنوَے چھِ اُبالنہٕ، ہۄکھناونہٕ تہٕ پیٖہنہٕ یِوان، تہٕ FSSAI چھُ دۄشوَنی خٲطرٕ اَکُے معیار تھاوان۔ کرکیومن، لیدرُک زرد رنگ، چھُ قِسمہِ، مِٹی، آب و ہوا تہٕ پروسیسنگ سٟتۍ بدلان، اَمِیٚ کِنۍ چھُ نہٕ پہاڑی یا میدٲنی لفظ یہ وَنان زِ کُنہِ لیدرس منٛز کوٚتُت کرکیومن چھُ۔ دۄشوَنی سٟتۍ رٔنِو اَکے طریقے۔
seg.10eec083bb3d.back: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) is cultivated in hilly areas, such as the Eastern Ghats around Araku, where most of the tribal farmers cultivate it. Plains turmeric is cultivated in the fields of districts like Guntur. Both are boiled, dried and ground, and FSSAI keeps one standard for both. Curcumin, the yellow colour of turmeric, changes with variety, soil, climate and processing, so the word hill or plains does not say how much curcumin is in any turmeric. Cook with both in the same way.

seg.a9e5b44e1be6.src: ⟦1⟧Hill turmeric.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's report on the Paderu agency, the tribal hill country of the Eastern Ghats that takes in Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, says turmeric is grown there by most tribal farmers.
seg.a9e5b44e1be6.t: ⟦1⟧پہاڑی لیدُر۔⟦/1⟧ پاڈیرو ایجنسی، یعنی مشرقی گھاٹن ہُند قبایلی پہاڑی علاقہٕ یَتھ منٛز اراکو وٲدی، چنتاپلّے تہٕ پاڈیرو شٲمِل چھِ، تَمِیُک مُتعلق چھےٚ ICAR-IISR ہٕنٛز رِپورٹ وَنان زِ تتہِ چھِ قبایلی کاشتکارَو منٛزٕ زیادٕ تر لیدُر کاشت کران۔
seg.a9e5b44e1be6.back: ⟦1⟧Hill turmeric.⟦/1⟧ About Paderu agency, that is the tribal hill area of the Eastern Ghats in which Araku valley, Chintapalle and Paderu are included, the ICAR-IISR report says that there most of the tribal farmers cultivate turmeric.

seg.736e66a0b5de.src: ⟦1⟧Plains turmeric.⟦/1⟧ Guntur district lists turmeric among its commercial crops, with cotton, chillies and tobacco. Duggirala, in Guntur, has a turmeric processing cluster that makes processed turmeric and turmeric powder. In 2022, Guntur district was divided into three districts: Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla.
seg.736e66a0b5de.t: ⟦1⟧میدٲنی لیدُر۔⟦/1⟧ گنٹور ضلع چھُ کپاس، مَرچہٕ وانٛگن تہٕ تمباکو سٟتۍ لیدُر تہِ پنٕنین تجارتی فصلن منٛز گنزران۔ گنٹور کِس دُگّیرالا منٛز چھُ لیدُر پروسیسنگ کلسٹر، یُس پروسیس کرنہٕ آمُت لیدُر تہٕ لیدُر پوڈر چھُ بناوان۔ 2022 منٛز آو گنٹور ضلع ترٛێن ضلعن منٛز بٲگرنہٕ: گنٹور، پلناڈو تہٕ باپٹلا۔
seg.736e66a0b5de.back: ⟦1⟧Plains turmeric.⟦/1⟧ Guntur district counts turmeric too among its commercial crops along with cotton, chillies and tobacco. In Duggirala of Guntur there is a turmeric processing cluster, which makes processed turmeric and turmeric powder. In 2022 Guntur district was divided into three districts: Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla.

seg.0f26c0785ed1.src: Turmeric can be grown either way: ICAR-IISR says it can be grown rain-fed or irrigated, from sea level up to 1,500 m.
seg.0f26c0785ed1.t: لیدُر ہیٚکہِ دۄشوَنی طریقن کاشت گٔژِھتھ: ICAR-IISR چھُ وَنان زِ یہ ہیٚکہِ رودٕ پیٹھ منحصر یا آبپاشی سٟتۍ، سمندرٕچہِ سطحہِ پیٹھہٕ 1,500 میٹر تام کاشت گٔژِھتھ۔
seg.0f26c0785ed1.back: Turmeric can be cultivated in both ways: ICAR-IISR says that it can be cultivated depending on rain or with irrigation, from the sea's surface up to 1,500 metres.

seg.b687346df428.src: Our ⟦1⟧hill turmeric⟦/1⟧ comes from the Araku and Maredumilli hills, and our ⟦2⟧turmeric⟦/2⟧ is grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Both are packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.b687346df428.t: سون ⟦1⟧پہاڑی لیدُر⟦/1⟧ چھُ اراکو تہٕ ماریڈومِلی کیٛن پہاڑن پیٹھہٕ یِوان، تہٕ سون ⟦2⟧لیدُر⟦/2⟧ چھُ پلناڈو تہٕ گنٹور منٛز کاشت گژھان۔ دۄنوَے چھِ نرساراؤپیٹ منٛز پیک کرنہٕ یِوان۔
seg.b687346df428.back: Our ⟦1⟧hill turmeric⟦/1⟧ comes from the hills of Araku and Maredumilli, and our ⟦2⟧turmeric⟦/2⟧ is cultivated in Palnadu and Guntur. Both are packed in Narasaraopet.
